203008.description:
At the boys' school attended by the main character, there is a rumor spreading that girls will have sex with them in the toilets on the third floor of the annex.
The main character's friends laugh at him, saying that the annex is just a hangout for delinquents, but he goes there to find out the truth. The main character is full of hope, but just as his friends said, the annex has become a hangout for delinquents, and he is found by the delinquents. The main character is told to hand over his wallet, and the delinquents then say something unexpected...

title.native: 別館3階男子トイレの肉便姫

203009.description: Note: Chapters 2 to 13 were split into three parts in the original serialization.

title.native: 黒豚王子は前世を思いだして改心する 悪役キャラに転生したので死亡エンドから逃げていたら最強になっていた
title.romaji: Kurobuta Ouji wa Zense wo Omoidashite Kaishin Suru: Akuyaku Chara ni Tensei Shita node Shibou End kara Nigeteitara Saikyou ni Natteita

203010.description:
"I think I like Esero." After losing her parents at an early age, Lize was taken in by her uncle. Her stepsister tries to steal her fiancé, and she's caught up in the schemes of her uncle and brother-in-law. She has troubles at school and with her fiancé, and it seems her days will continue to be the worst...or so she thought. But then someone reaches out to help her! (Note: That hand is fluffy---!!!) A furry fantasy set in another world, featuring a plain young lady who's loved by animals and the solitary son of a black panther!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: こんなはずじゃなかった？それは残念でしたね～私は自由気ままに暮らしたい～
title.romaji: Konna Hazu ja Nakatta? Sore wa Zannen Deshita ne: Watashi wa Jiyuu Kimama ni Kurashitai

203011.description:
Cassidy is nine months pregnant. Donovan, the vice-president of a massive corporation, can't stand children. He broke their relationship off before she had the opportunity to reveal she was pregnant with his baby. But now he's appeared out of the blue to visit her. Donovan sees how pregnant Cassidy is and is shocked... He then goes on to proclaim that he will marry her and become the child's father! The truth is, Cassidy is still deeply in love with him, and his sincere words open her heart. While still puzzled about Donovan's change of heart, she accepts his proposal... If only she had realized that, for him, it was only a marriage of convenience to help him land the CEO position!

(Source: Renta!)

203012.description:
The year is 1938. Dee is studying to become a nurse. Her breath catches when she meets her beautiful sister's boyfriend, Mark, for the first time. She has never met a handsome, cheerful man with such a booming voice before. Even while dating her sister, Mark treats Dee as a lady, and she falls for him and the way he takes her seriously. Dee hopes that he will hurry up and marry her sister so she can forget about her feelings for him. But Dee has no idea what her sister is feeling. She also doesn't know about Mark's uninhibited relationships or his rash and reckless dream.

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 愛をたどる系譜 Ⅱ 花嫁までの距離

203013.description:
Viveka's sister was supposed to marry Mikolas Petrides, a Greek millionaire who is connected to the mafia. But at the last minute, Viveka takes her sister's place. Her plan was to buy some time so her sister could marry the man she truly loves, but Mikolas immediately realizes she isn't his bride. With his real bride on the run, Mikolas takes Viveka on his boat and demands that she compensate him for the damage her sister caused, heartlessly telling Viveka that any daughter of the Stamos family will do as recompense.

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 大富豪と偽りのベール

203014.description:
Every day at 5:00 p.m., Ariana gets to spend time with Grant, a lawyer nicknamed Mr. Perfect. Though her fiance recently left her pregnant with twins, Grant has dutifully stepped in to give her rides to and from work. But Ariana knows she can't overstep her boundaries. Grant's intentions are simply to give Ariana legal support. But there's a growing attraction happening on both sides!

(Source: Renta!)

203015.description:
Jemima, who is raising the child her late twin sister left in her care, is approached by Italian billionaire Luciano Vitale and treated with contempt. He demands to know where his eight-month-old child is, naming Jemima's sister as the surrogate who gave birth to the baby and stole him. Jemima fears Luciano will take her nephew away if he discovers that she isn't her sister. So Jemima pretends to be her sister and travels with him to his mansion. She must somehow maintain her secret or risk losing her adopted son forever.

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: シチリア大富豪の誤算

203016.description:
Shortly after Rachel quits her dream job as a ballerina, she meets Nikolai, a billionaire, at her friend's wedding. She is immediately attracted to his sad and mysterious eyes. He's tried to keep his personal life a secret by distancing himself from the friends he grew up with in the orphanage. Rachel tries to get Nikolai to stay at the wedding, since she can see that he is in pain. She herself has been wondering whether she deserves to love and be loved. But while Rachel is talking about her dream of being a ballet critic, he suddenly presses his lips against hers.

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 氷の掟Ⅲ 過去を捨てた億万長者

title.native: 過去を捨てた億万長者

203017.description:
Jacqui, a magazine writer, met Asim, a sultan, in his country when she visited Jazeer. They met in the harem, which had gone unused for a long time. The extremely confident Asim looked at Jacqui with great interest-their personalities were complete opposites and he was fascinated by her. It didn't take long for Jacqui to be entirely captivated by Asim's charm, either. She was filled with happiness when Asim made love to her...until she learned that the king had been meeting with a number of potential princesses...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: スルタンと愛妾のハーレム

203018.description:
“Please pretend to be my wife. If you do, I will help you pay off your debt…” Harry’s unusual offer is a unique blessing for Laurie, who finds herself between a rock and a hard place. Her father is dead and, thanks to her mother’s wanton spending, their home is about to be auctioned off. Laurie needs to make more money or she also won’t be able to graduate college. Laurie is already talented at acting, so she doesn’t hesitate to take the job. The contract will last for three months. In order to play the perfect wife, kisses are a necessity, but the handsome Harry makes her pulse race. What should she do now?

(Source: Harlequin)

203019.description:
Luzeria, the daughter of a duke, fell in love with King Edward, married him, and became queen. However, this was a sham marriage, as the king summoned his childhood friend, the daughter of a baron, Airi, to his castle and became infatuated with her. Tired of her love for the king, Luzeria took a "love-erasing medicine" given to her by Akil, a well-known foreign pharmacist, and divorced the king. After her divorce and Luzeria returned to the dukedom, Akil began visiting her for some reason... As they got to know each other, Akil revealed that he was actually the crown prince of a great country, traveling in search of something, and that the thing he was looking for was Luzeria, and he suddenly proposed to her...!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 恋心に苦しむ王妃は、異国の薬師王太子に求愛される
title.romaji: Koigokoro ni Kurushimu Ouhi wa, Ikoku no Kusushi Outaishi ni Kyuuai Sareru

203020.description:
Seonjoo was a guy–a GUY–chillin’ in South Korea until pizza-kun sent him to Shirley-Pleehen, a game-like world. Summoneds from all universes run amok, using their Systems to adventure in dungeons for cash. But Seonjoo was summoned by the dragon god himself… into a genderless angel?!@?! He’s a GUY, I swear!! Say hello to Shirley-Pleehen’s first-ever healer class—equipped with a fairy, blessed by a dragon, and comfortable with violence! This petty fighter isn’t your average angel.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 悪魔どもを絞り上げてやる

203023.description:
Chen mo is an invisible student. He longed to keep low-key but unexpectedly made acquaintance with dynamic girl and Prince Charming... From then on, his peaceful life ended.

(Source: WebComics)

203025.description:
What if one day… beloved family and friends suddenly vanished?

What if most of those who failed to make it to the rapture became insane and threatened the lives of others? How would the surviving boys and girls adapt and survive in their new surroundings? Do they truly have the strength to save this world from peril and start a new one?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: includes two extra chapters.

203026.description:
Method actor Park Se-Ha and flop idol Sohn Ji-Eon are cast as lovers in a queer crime film. What begins as open hostility born from clashing backgrounds slowly transforms through forced rehearsals and intimate method acting. As Ji-Eon’s sincerity and relentless effort break down Se-Ha’s defenses, professional boundaries blur into dangerous attraction. Determined to call their growing closeness a “mistake,” both men struggle to separate acting from reality. Caught between obsession and devotion, they must decide whether their connection is merely part of the role… or something real.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.native: 助っ人見参！！ウェンディの祝日

203033.description:
Twenty-two-year-old Beta Yoon Ha-Seong struggles as the bassist for an unknown indie band. After a failed performance and being dumped by his girlfriend, he's left in tears when he runs into famous actor Go Ye-Han. Ye-Han, claiming to be his fan, offers him a job and connects him with a famous composer to learn composition. Ha-Seong actively supports him and treats him with affection. Despite feeling a sense of unease, he finds himself drawn to Ye-Han. To repay the favor, he helps Ha-Seong with his rut, which involves managing his pheromones.

"Huh, Ma-an... I'm not even an omega," he says. " Ha-Seong, you're overflowing with talent. You'd be better off with me than most omegas."

What started as a simple attempt to help him somehow leads to a rut partner. And perhaps he shouldn't have ignored the initial sense of unease.

"It's true I wanted to have sex with you. But... is that really that problematic?"

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

203034.description:
"I wish this life that has lasted for a hundred years could continue unchanged for a thousand years..."

Ever since being picked up on a whim, succubus Yuine has been living quietly with vampire Roz. He takes care of Roz, a novelist, and gives him blood as needed. At some point, he began to develop feelings for him, but Yuine was happy to be of help, and that alone was enough to satisfy him. Then, one day, they decided to go to the city together for work, and from then on, their relationship began to waver little by little...

(Source: B.Pilz, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: つよギャル☆スプラッシュ
小鳥遊ちゃんは困ったちゃん

203037.description:
Han-Sol, a 24-year-old kindergarten teacher, has one ultimate goal in life: to snag a wealthy Prince Charming. Enter Yu-Shin—the tall, handsome, and successful father of one of Han-Sol's students. After an awkward first date, the two are soon caught up in a fairytale romance with a kinky twist!

(Source: Manta)

203038.description:
It really seems like the guy next door is a completely insane, crazy bastard.

Baek Gang-Hyeon, the fourth son of the chairman of the Baekcheong Group and its hidden successor, has one secret: he possesses a rare genetic trait—99% alpha characteristics and 1% omega. He has lived his whole life as an overwhelmingly dominant alpha, but then a storm named Kwon Hae-il enters his life.

“I think I’m gonna die from how much I like you, Baek Gang-Hyeon.”

203039.description:
"Lee Yu," who has lived a life of insignificance, longs to become someone special, even just once. However, at the moment of his final resolution, frustrated by constant frustration, a mysterious being appears before him. And it grants his every wish...

The mysterious "being" and the "Lee Yu" who summoned it!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

203040.description:
Yeon-Woo, who's better at yapping than baking, is often a victim of Chef Woo's scolding at his uncle's cafe... and he likes it! A masochist at heart, Yeon-Woo would rather be whipped than whip cream. Tasked with creating a new menu, the two get close. Is this the start of a sweet-yet-spicy new recipe?

(Source: Manta)

203041.description:
After grinding it out at a tiny firm, Sun-Woo finally lands a job at a corporate giant. Armed with good looks, smooth flattery, and maxed-out social skills, he's sure he'll fit right in—until the deadpan rookie he lectures on day one turns out to outrank him. So much for the dream corporate life!

(Source: Manta)

203042.description:
Albert, the youngest son of a family of noble warriors called the Falconers, has a secret—he’s been reincarnated into the world of a video game! Unfortunately, his memories of the game are hazy, and he’s merely a nameless background character who shouldn’t have any effect on the world at all. As Al begins to question his own existence, he enrolls in the Radford Royal Academy of Magic, where he’s about to find out he has more influence on his new world than he ever could have imagined!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: The Berserker NPC Unknowingly Destroys the World
title.native: 狂戦士なモブ、無自覚に本編を破壊する
title.romaji: Kyousenshi na Mob, Mujikaku ni Honpen wo Hakai Suru

title.native: ミドルノートにさよなら

203045.description:
Yun Su-Hyeon, the ace of the vampire hunter team. Traumatized by a childhood accident, Su-Hyeon is not only an outsider within the team, but even his teammates shun him.

"There we go again, you know?"

Then one day, the man Su-Hyeon, who insists on never sleeping with someone you've slept with twice, joins Alpha Team as his successor. And what's more, they have to live under the same roof?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: ラスカートラップ〜ためらうな、先手を打て〜

203046.description:
A chronicle of exchanges between a bumbling god and a troubled high school girl. A certain dreamlike event depicted with delicate brushstrokes...

(Source: The Hana to Yume, machine translated)

203047.description:
A bumbling tengu handler and a free-spirited child crow tengu on a youkai-exorcising adventure. The time is the Taishou era… In Kurashiki, a town where youkai and humans dwell, the ragtag duo's great youkai hunt begins…!

(Source: Hana to Yume, machine translated)

203049.description:
"There's no mistaking it. You're suffering from a case of L.O.V.E.!"

The man I fell in love with is some weirdo who has no idea what love is -- Sachi is in love with love. She is determined to meet her soulmate -- after all, her own mother and father married for love and always seemed so happy. Sachi falls for someone new every day in the hopes that she'll find Mr. Right. She gets her heart broken over and over again -- but she doesn't let herself feel that pain, instead she just races to her next crush! After falling for countless different men, Sachi meets Jogasaki. According to Jogasaki, love is an illness. He's a total weirdo who has been trying to find the drug to cure "L.O.V.E.". Sachi and Jogasaki, neither of whom know anything about real love, set out to develop this miracle drug together. But will the two of them be able to face up to their own feelings?!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: There's No Cure for the L.O.V.E. Bug!

203050.description:
I ran into Natsume again at our junior high class reunion and, long story short, a group of us have been going out for drinks together lately. My friend claims Natsume is into me (Wow!), but if that's true then he doesn't show it. If anything, he's always giving me attitude...! (Grr...) How does he really feel about me? I need to know, so I can decide on my next move...! In this romantic comedy of self-sabotage, will Hanako keep digging herself into a deeper hole, or will she finally be upfront about her own feelings?

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: There's Not One Thing I Like About Natsume
title.native: ナツメくんなんか好きじゃない

203051.description:
What do you do when nothing's going right in your life?

Minori (29), who has been struggling from day to day, has become pessimistic about life as a whole. This year has been especially dreadful. Work has become a hellish experience because of her new boss. Her childhood friend and longtime crush, Asai, just told her he only sees her as a friend. When all seems hopeless, Minori is suddenly visited by a "Toshiotoko", a fairy whose job is to bring luck and happiness to their charge. With his gentle and encouraging support, she slowly learns to take control of her life by the reins. What will Minori discover as she continues her search for what happiness really means to her?

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: When Life Let Me Down, Luck Picked Me Right Back Up
title.native: 好きな男にフラれた夜、甘い男に拾われた。
title.romaji: Suki na Otoko ni Furareta Yoru, Amai Otoko ni Hirowareta.

203052.description:
How reliable would you say your memory is? As humans, our minds can omit memories. Memories can become idealized. Sometimes, they can even be entirely fabricated. There are various ways by which one's recollection of past events can become distorted. One could even say that it is a type of mental defense mechanism meant to protect us. But what if you had the chance to see your memories in their original state, unblemished and untouched...? Would you take it?

Meet Hakucho, the hippocampus and their assistant, Rohen, two mysterious individuals that live and work at an old-fashioned cafe that's more than meets the eye. Their shop comes to those plagued by their past, offering a chance to see the truth behind their memories. When restoring a client's memories, Hakucho summons a mystical creature from their ancient pipe. The creature enters the client's mind, scouring its depths to reveal that which has become obscured. However... sometimes, the truth is perhaps best left forgotten.

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: Welcome. Would You Like to Have Your Memories Restored?

203053.description:
High school senior Ao Kuroda is a completely normal girl, neither glitzy nor plain. Nothing beats peace and quiet, that's her motto. In spite of looking forward to a no-nonsense and calm final year of high school, Ao bumps shoulders with Sakuya Ozaki -- a freshman infamous for getting into a fight soon after the first day of high school and sending the other student to the hospital!! Ozaki tells her off -- "That freakin' hurt, watch where you're going, why don't you?!"-- and Ao is so terrified that she cries. She wants nothing to do with Ozaki! So why the heck did he have to get into a fight with someone right outside of her favorite record store?!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

203054.description:
It was the final summer of college - the final summer before becoming a working member of society...Miharu is a senior in college whose dream is to be a high school teacher. She's overjoyed when she receives her results from her certification exam. Amidst her excitement though, her friend and fellow aspiring teacher Yuichi, confesses to her! Unfortunately, Miharu is conflicted. Despite having the same feelings for Yuichi, she finds herself unable to say 'Yes'. It all goes back to 2 years ago, when her close high school friend and crush, Hinata suddenly passed away.Even in a world without Hinata, Miharu can't seem to let go of him. On her annual visit to his grave and the beach where they used to spend their school days together, she continues to contemplate. trying to sort out her feelings. But right when she decides to head home, she has a shocking encounter!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: One More Last Summer With You
title.native: 君と最後の夏をもう一度
title.romaji: Kimi to Saigo no Natsu wo Mou Ichido

203055.description:
Set on becoming a clothing designer, she got herself a job at a leading apparel company - only to end up assigned to the reception desk. Yet Mio Adachi didn't give up there. She spent her days practicing design, on top of performing her receptionist duties, in hopes of one day moving to a department where she could actually work in fashion design. That fateful day comes, though with an unfortunate twist, when a higher-up in the design department sees a sketch by handsome top-class designer Miyabi Shito and mistakenly thinks it's one of Mio's...! Caught between the pull of her lifelong dream and the weight of starting it off with a lie, what path will Mio take next...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: A Designer Who Tells a Sweet Lie

title.english: DESIGNER: Our World of Pretty Lies
title.native: デザイナーは甘い嘘をつく
title.romaji: Designer wa Amai Uso wo Tsuku

203056.description:
What would you do if the perfect marriage candidate came along and said he wanted to be a "househusband"?

Having been focused on her career until now, Michika has finally begun looking for a marriage partner at the age of 35 when she meets Sho Unomori, a department manager at a major company who is kind, thoughtful, handsome, and one year older than her. "There's got to be something!" Michika throws question and after question at him, seemingly unable to find anything that even remotely resembles a flaw in this perfect man. That is... apart from the confession that he reservedly shares at the end of their date of his dream to be a househusband. Shocked, Michika thinks to herself, "Absolutely not," and kicks all hope aside. But as she spends more time with Unomori, she starts to want to get to know him better...?!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: Unomori Says He Wants to Be a Househusband
title.native: 鵜森さんは専業主夫になりたいらしい

203057.description:
He travels through a world he created with his fluffy companion.

Togo, who was reincarnated as a god for some reason, decides to create his own world, which is a god's duty. He also summons the fluffy dog ​​Miru as his companion. Wanting to check out the world he created, Togo descends into that world with Miru. After spending some time there, he unexpectedly finds himself in a situation where his divine realm is taken over by an evil god and he is unable to return! In the mortal world where divine powers cannot be used, Togo and Miru journey through this world in order to somehow return to his divine realm.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 神に転生した少年がもふもふと異世界を旅します
title.romaji: Kami ni Tensei Shita Shounen ga Mofumofu to Isekai wo Tabi Shimasu

203058.description:
Lauren spends a passionate night with a man she just met. She hasn't been in the mood for romance since she divorced her abusive husband, so why now? A few hours before, Lauren was preparing for her publishing company's party. There, she met the gorgeous and kind publishing agent Michael Timberlane. She tried to keep their interaction business-oriented but failed terribly and fell into his arms. Lauren cannot forget the lingering sensation of their hot night, but she finds out the next day that Michael approached her to get revenge...

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Honou no Kiss wo Mou Ichido

203059.description:
When Elle was fourteen, her father remarried, and along with a stepmother she gained an older stepbrother, Apollo. She had always kept her love for him secret, but twelve years later everything changed. Apollo started buying up bits and pieces of her father's company until he had taken it all. What motivated him to do it? Wanting to hear him out, Elle goes to meet Apollo, but the meeting quickly turns into a quarrel, anger sparks passion and the two of them go to bed together! That one moment is all she's ever wanted, but this is not how she imagined it!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 愛なきアポロと小さな命

203060.description:
In order to uncover the truth behind the death of her uncle, Lady Georgiana dresses up as a boy and heads to London. While chasing after one of the suspects, Viscount Fincham, she finds him being assaulted by strangers. In that moment, without thinking, Georgiana steps in to his rescue. The viscount, captivated by the beautiful eyes of the young boy who came to his rescue, soon realizes that Georgiana is actually a young woman from a commoner family. Unable to contain his curiosity, he gives her a proposition. "Would you work by my side as my personal aid?"

(Source: Renta!)

203062.description:
Hioki, an ordinary high school student, is feeling down after being placed in a new class without any of his friends. Just as he fears facing the upcoming school trip alone, he finds himself grouped with the super cool and popular Watarai. Though initially intimidated, Hioki's nervousness fades as Watarai constantly stays by his side, always looking out for him. As the two slowly grow closer and open up, Watarai's deep obsession begins to show...

(Source: Starts Publishing, translated)
203062.hashtag: #修学旅行で仲良くないグループに入りました
synonyms: School Trip: Joined a Group I'm Not Close to

title.native: 修学旅行で仲良くないグループに入りました
title.romaji: Shuugakuryokou de Nakayokunai Group ni Hairimashita

title.native: フミヤ先輩と、好きバレ済みの僕。
title.romaji: Fumiya-senpai to, Suki Bare Zumi no Boku.

203064.description:
"It's adorable how you keep whimpering."

She's the perfect office worker in the eyes of others, but to you, she's the queen bitch who nags you every day. One day, Si-U walks in on his boss masturbating in the bathroom.

"You crazy bitch. You were nothing but a slut after all."

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)
synonyms: 発情女上司のしつけかた

203066.description: A guild master, once ranked number one, wakes up 500 years in the future after winning a major siege. The guild is gone, the world feels strange, and everything has fallen apart. Determined to rebuild the guild and adapt to this unfamiliar time, they embark on a journey to restore their legacy and conquer the challenges of the new era.
synonyms: ここってゲームの世界じゃないんですか？

203067.description:
Lililucia, the daughter of a marquis, scarred her younger sister's face when she was a child. Feeling guilty, she continued to listen to her sister's whims, and as a result, she was molded into the kingdom's most evil woman. When her younger sister got married, Lililucia decided to stop listening to her sister's whims, but her younger sister, suspecting an affair between the princess and her husband, cursed her to turn into a cat and framed her for attempting to poison the princess. However, Lililucia, who has taken on the form of a cat, is picked up by Crown Prince Gerald, who has an excessive love for cats, and he dotes on her. If she turns back into a human, she will be falsely accused and executed, but if she remains a cat, she will die from being doted on...!? A fluffy romantic comedy fantasy about a villainous woman who has turned into a cat and a crown prince who dotes on cats.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 呪いで猫にされた悪女、王太子に拾われる。
title.romaji: Noroi de Neko ni Sareta Akujo, Outaishi ni Hirowareru.

203068.description:
I, The Founder Of The Shi Dao Sect, Fought Against The Heavenly Dao With All My Might, Only To Die In The End And Be Reborn A Second Time As A Mere Cannon-fodder Playboy. Watching Those Girls, Who Are Destined To Ends Up With Protagonist… My Heart Ached… Huh? They Said They Like Me?!… Fine! Then Let’s Joyfully Cultivate Together ~ And Defeat Those Protagonists… What? You Said? Wait, They Were The Real Protagonists From The Start?

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: It Turns Out That They Are the Protagonists
It Turns Out, They Were the True Protagonists From The Start
So, They Were the Protagonists All Along

203069.description:
The Third Time’s The Charm!

Princess That never received an actual name and suffered many years of abuse. Each time she meets her untimely end, she’s sent back into the past, and during her third loop, she restarts as a three-year-old girl. What’s more, the imperial family’s guardian deity—the Golden Dragon—takes notice of her this time. Even the legendary, ultra fluffy Flame Tiger latches onto her! Despite being That’s older brother, the crown prince never showed any interest in her, yet in this loop, he dubs her an angel. Will her father—the infamously cold-blooded emperor—shower her with affection as well?! The nameless princess will fight with all her strength to survive and earn a name of her own!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)
synonyms: Third Loop: The Nameless Princess and the Cruel Emperor

title.native: ‎ななしの皇女と冷酷皇帝 ～虐げられた幼女、今世では龍ともふもふに溺愛されています～
title.romaji: Nanashi no Oujo to Reikoku Koutei: Shiitagerareta Youjo, Konse de wa Ryuu to Mofumofu ni Dekiai Sareteimasu

203070.description:
What kind of trash system is this?! If I destroy my own sect, I become invincible—but if I try to strengthen it, the system wipes me out!
And right at this moment, the Sect Master insists I take on a disciple?
Hmph… Fine, I’ll accept a disciple—but who says I have to *teach* them properly? If my disciple ends up wrecking the sect for me, that still counts!
Solving inequalities has never been this fast! Beautiful female disciples, come to me at once!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Invincible Master: My Disciples Are Super Gods
When My Disciples Are Superb and I Lie Flat, When My Sect Is Destroyed and I Am Invincible
When My Sect Is Destroyed and I Am Invincible

title.native: 弟子超神我躺平，宗门毁灭我无敌
title.romaji: Dizi Chao Shen Wo Tangping, Zong Men Huimie Wo Wudi

203071.description:
He returned from the depths of hell. Using this nine feet long sword, he splits mountains, ocean dividing, flies to the heavens, and rules the word! He was poisoned, losing all his power, he was accused of high treason. Can he take back what's rightfully his?

(Source: WebComics)

203072.description:
Shen Wei Lan died for deeply loving Fu Su Mian in her last life. Now she born again and swore that she would stay far away from him! But why?! She racks her brains to stay far away from him, but he who hates her in the last life becomes strongly possessive! He claims arbitrarily, "You are mine forever! You have no where to go!"

(Source: WebComics)

203073.description:
Picture this... A farmer in the countryside with a height of around 5'9". Most guys who hear this are already running for the hills. Not to mention, having no love experience at 28... Still, I don't regret the choices I've made since there's nothing more important to me than this tangerine orchard my grandpa left me... Is what I thought until I met Sakuma who protects me, stands up for me, holds me when I'm down, and actually treats me like a girl. I'm not used to being treated like this, so I don't know how I should react, but his endless kindness is so sweet that I'm beginning to...

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.native: ワケありですが、甘さは極上です。
title.romaji: Wakeari desu ga, Amasa wa Gokujou desu.

203074.description:
Shuu is a girl going to university who's very popular with other girls due to her boyish manners and slender, handsome appearance. One day, she helps a beautiful looking man who got caught up in a fight... and then out of nowhere is told "You're the most beautiful woman I've ever seen." Suddenly he kisses her! While she would normally hate this, the kiss feels too good. She can't resist. Would you believe, this man is a mythical being that seduces humans and feeds on their life-force, their vim. He's a Succulent! His name is Shitou, and after being saved by Shuu he can't help but keep chasing after her. At first, Shuu sees Shitou as an annoyance, but slowly begins to accept the woozy hot kisses from the first man to treat her like a woman. The start of a love story that begins with a handsome, boyish college girl and a mesmerising demon!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: The Succulent's Kiss is Too Sweet to Resist
title.native: 吸蜜鬼のキスが甘すぎて困ってます！
title.romaji: Kyuumitsu Oni no Kiss ga Amasugite Komattemasu!

203076.description:
"Stop talking and sit down. Then, I'll teach you how to have them falling head over heels for you."

Dumped after turning thirty and left on read by the guy she met at a mixer, Miho has fallen into despair as she struggles with her love life. One day she stops by a bar and meets a mysterious woman named Beniko who is surrounded by handsome men, even though she doesn't have what society would normally consider "good" looks. From that day forth, Beniko takes the clumsy in love Miho under her wing, and begins teaching her "how to be a loved woman."

Every chapter includes a "Make Your Love Come True Q&A" by popular relationship columnist, and author of this manga, Yusuke Asada. Check them out for tips & tricks on how to gain confidence in yourself & improve your love life!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.native: わたしは愛される実験をはじめた。
title.romaji: Watashi wa Aisareru Jikken wo Hajimeta.

203077.description:
Jin Kurosaki is a high school boy who spends his days in irritation and apathy. That is, until he falls down a flight of stairs one day to save a pregnant lady named Mai and...ends up swapping bodies with her?! Suddenly becoming a pregnant lady is a lot to take in, but Mai's cheeriness and positivity help him face the situation. As feelings he's never felt before begin to sprout, he also starts to learn more about Mai and the secret she holds.

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: Belly Swap: From High School Boy to Mom-To-Be
title.native: DK妊婦・黒崎くんの出産

203078.description:
"I got myself fired in the fall of my 33rd year."

Six years into marriage, Mai Murata is now raising two young children while both she and her husband work full-time. Her colleagues often say she's "living the dream," but in reality she's struggling to handle work on top of doing all the childcare on her own, and it feels like she's constantly apologizing: to her boss, to the daycare center, and on and on. Amidst all this, she happens to try out a virtual flea market app and finds an amazing deal that makes her day... and leaves her chasing that same high again and again until it's all she can think about.

Addiction can happen to anyone, even you. This tale explores one person's struggle to escape that insatiable, unstoppable need and find genuine fulfillment.

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.native: 満タサレズ、止メラレズ

203079.description:
"Please, marry me." My coworker, the person I hate the most in this whole world, suddenly confesses his love to me, but doesn't realize that I'm Haruno Tsumugi...!

Tsumugi, who is the lowest performer in sales at her company, is constantly stressed out by her good-looking, top-performing coworker, Atsushi Honke, who is equally aggravated by her inability to do her job. Why is someone as hard-working as me at the bottom, while a game-obsessed slacker like him gets it all...?! One day, she's lending a hand at her dad's drag bar, wearing her usual disguise, and serving customers, when he happens to come in for a drink! Thus begins this love story of misunderstanding born of lies and revenge!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: Proposal From My Little White Lie
title.native: 嘘つきは求愛のはじまり

203080.description:
I have been in love with my sister's fiance for 7 years. I live a lie. That has never changed and never will. Or so I thought... Until I met Eichi. The day Eichi found out about my lie, that I was okay with my sister being with her husband, he told me that he wanted my sister for himself. We decided to work together to make our fantasy a reality. But, the way Eichi was coming on to me made me question if it was really my sister he was after. To grow accustomed to a man's touch, he hugged me... and even k-kissed me?! What in the world is going on?

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.native: 嘘つきな私たちの恋は

203081.description:
After dying in a terrible accident, I find myself reborn in a love sim as the villainess, Sariel! If everything goes the way it's supposed to, Sariel is doomed to die at the hands of the other characters seeking vengeance... just thinking about this has brought me to see terrible dreams of my various potential fates. I've been keeping to myself, studying martial arts, swordsmanship, archery, and all other things to help defend myself from any possible dangers... but it seems one of the love interests is already drawn to me?!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: The Dreams of a Villainess Named Sariel
title.native: 悪役令嬢サリエルの夢

synonyms: Be My Pain, Stay In Me

title.native: いたいのいたいのここにいて
title.romaji: Itai no Itai no Koko ni Ite

203084.description:
Ema has been dating her childhood friend, Aoi, for 8 years. They have been living together for four years, and Ema hoped to get married one day... However, Aoi has been neglecting the housework recently, and even treats her birthdays as an after-thought. Ema's desire to be with Aoi as a lover sometimes feels one-sided. Just as Ema starts to worry if they can even get married at this point, she runs into her high school crush, and he's just as kind as he was back then...

(Source: Manga Plaza)

203085.description:
"Lady Amalthea, will you marry me?"

Amalthea receives an unfathomable proposal from the cold prince who hates women! However, their marriage is only a contractual one. Even so, with how kindly the prince is treating her, Amalthea feels she might get the wrong idea...

Amalthea has exceptional skill when it comes to territory management. Her talents brought about expectations in the kingdom, and she has been asked to wed the future count, Thomas. However, Thomas takes Amalthea's proposals, leaving her name out of them and claiming them as his own. Not only that, but Thomas also has a lover. When Amalthea points this out, he causes a scene and calls off the engagement. Just when Amalthea had enough and was ready to leave, Prince Kirfas, who happened to witness everything, suddenly proposes to Amalthea?!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: The Consultant Amalthea and Her Marriage
title.native: コンサルタント嬢、アマルティアの婚姻

203088.description:
"I'll change your future!"

A chance to turn your life around, a guaranteed service promised by a voice phishing scam! Kang Juhyuk, a once beloved national actor who has fallen from grace and into poverty, lives in a dark, single-room apartment in misery. One day, an unidentified smartphone is sent to Juhyuk, leading to a series of events that will completely change his life.

"The voice phishing calls I'm getting... are they selling the future?"

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: It’s Voice Phishing, But It’s a Life Reversal

203089.description:
“Ah, so it’s you. The one that’s taken my place.”

Still keeping their true identities secret, Soo-Ha and Heli return to school as an official couple when suddenly a mysterious girl with Soo-Ha's face named Selen appears. Soo-Ha, with whom they have made countless memories together in the current, and Selen, with whom they share deep and fond memories from the past. As two people who never should have met collide, a dangerous and heartrending romance begins once more.

(Source: WEBTOON)

203090.description:
Alexant, a reincarnated person who awakened to his memories from his previous life at the age of seven, enrolls in the prestigious Akasha House School at the age of 13, where he discovers alchemy while demonstrating his many talents. A chaotic and laid-back atelier life begins with various companions from Akasha House, including a little witch, a loli elf, and a tanned, energetic girl!!!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 俺だけ超天才錬金術師 ゆる～いアトリエ生活始めました
title.romaji: Ore Dake Chou Tensai Renkinjutsushi: Yurui Atelier Seikatsu Hajimemashita

203092.description:
Notes:
- Originally published in Jump GIGA Winter 2025 issue.
- Semifinalist for the 2024 Story Pro award.

203093.description:
His father had suddenly disappeared, leaving the Ye family in ruins. His engagement got called off, leaving him humiliated, then enters a beautiful and arrogant daughter from a rich family, alongside a mysterious and beautiful assassin... Looks like there's a huge secret behind the seemingly ordinary high school that he attends, but what is it?

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: A Desperate and Evil Young Man

title.native: 昭和アホ草紙 あかぬけ一番！

203095.description:
There is a Wushu Record of Fame which records all the celebrities. Heroes that specialize one perticular weapon can enter this Record. Gao Jianli, a young man who just finished one's apprenticeship and wants to beat Qin Huangliang to be the No. 1 Swordsman, comes to Qin's house. Then, he finds that Huangliang is—a nut. This is a daily comedy that depicts how Jianli keeps challenging Huangliang...

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Being the World's Second Best Is Alright
World's Second Best Ain't So Bad

title.romaji: Tian Xia Di Er Jiu Ting Hao

203096.description:
Killed and reborn into her past, Tianxin Fok realized her stepmother was evil! In the face of her evil stepmother and stepsister who caused her mother and brother's death, Tianxin Fok resolved to learn to fight back and never again be that weak girl at the mercy of others! She was determined to kill all her enemies! "Do your worst! Defeat will be your only outcome!"

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: The Rebirth of the First Daughter
The Reborn First Lady Is Not Pure

203097.description: A heartwarming collection of short stories, bringing together the "tear-jerker sci-fi manga" from the genius Neko Organ.

203098.description:
Su Xiaomeng was pushed from a high-rise by her vicious stepsister and killed. When she woke up, she found herself reborn on the very night of the murder. To change her fate, she chose to marry the comatose tycoon in her stepsister's place. The world expected her life to be a joke, doomed to guard a living corpse forever. But on their wedding night, her devastatingly handsome husband opened his eyes.

(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: The Unlikely Union with A Comatose Billionaire
My Husband's Doting Love Just Won't Stop Despite Our Supposed Substitute Marriage
The Substitute Bride and the Overly Affectionate Husband
身代わり婚のはずが、旦那様の溺愛が止まりません

203099.description:
After her mother passed, Lucia was left with a family who had barely a care in the world for her. Her only value to her father and stepmother was that the second prince had chosen to marry her. But all it took for her to lose him too was a little temptation from her younger sister Nina. Not only has Nina been revealed to be with child, but the prince now wishes to wed her instead! When Lucia is about to lose all hope, she meets the kingdom's rumored archduke...

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: Forsaken Marquis's Daughter Is Loved to Pieces
title.native: 捨てられた侯爵令嬢は魂まで溺愛される
title.romaji: Suterareta Koushaku Reijou wa Tamashii made Dekiai Sareru

203101.description: Manga adaption of the novel Lady Chatterley's Lover by D. H. Lawrence

title.native: チャタレイ夫人の恋人

203103.description:
One week after the brutal murder of prefectural assemblyman Rihito Manaka in his own home. High school student Rio Manaka, the victim's daughter, said that her father deserved to be killed. All of a sudden, those who were trying find the murderer amongst "those who had been wronged" by Rihito — became fans of Rio Manaka instead, due to her outlandish statement.

Rio Manaka, a beautiful girl deemed "strange" and "abnormal" by her own mother and those around her, supports the death of a loved one. What is her true purpose? And why hasn't the murderer been apprehended, despite the presence of evidence and witnesses? A suspense novel that attempts to piece together the truth, seen from the perspectives of six people whose lives were affected by Rio Manaka.

(Source: MF Bunko J, translated)
synonyms: deserves to be killed, she said

title.native: 殺されて当然と少女は言った。
title.romaji: Korosarete Touzen to Shoujo wa Itta.

203104.description:
Jizo shrines, inari statues — things that are part of everyday life in Japan and hardly noticed by anyone. But Sophia, a student returning from overseas, is terrified of them, thanks to all the wrong ideas she picked up from Japanese horror movies and games!

A helpful boy ends up giving her a hand, and together they laugh, blush, and gradually learn more about Japanese folk traditions in this cute romantic comedy!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 三原ソフィアは怖ガール

203106.description: Released in Ribon Zoukan New year issue in 1973, re-released in Ribon Deluxe 1976 Summer issue.

203107.description: Released in Ribon 1974/10 issue, re-released in Ribon Deluxe Summer 1976.

203108.description: Released in Ribon 1975/6, re-released in Ribon Deluxe Summer 1976 issue.

title.native: ハッピーケーキの焼けるまに
title.romaji: Happy Cake no Yakeru ma ni

title.native: ちょっぴり悲しいファンタジア
パンプキン パンプキン

203117.description:
As a hotel housekeeper, Sunny is used to guest drama. But nothing could've prepared her for the day a beautiful woman with a baby stroller pushes her way into the room Sunny is cleaning. The irate woman forces the child onto the man staying there, the charming billionaire Max Grayland, and storms out... It seems Max's father, who passed away recently, had coerced the woman into having his child. Max is out of options and tells Sunny he'll pay her to be the child's babysitter. Sunny can't refuse his reckless request, nor her wildly beating heart...

(Source: Renta!)

203118.description:
Rachel has managed to heal from the heartbreak she suffered two years ago. Then one day a new executive at her company arrives with a crying baby. It's Nick, the very man who dumped her! His younger brother and sister-in-law were killed three weeks ago in an accident, leaving his niece in his guardianship. Rachel wants to help the struggling Nick, but can she suppress her love for the man who dumped her?

(Source: Renta!)

203119.description:
Nate stole Tess's heart the first time she saw him in a tux, which is how she ended up spending a night of passion with him. Six weeks later, she tells him that their wonderful night together has blessed her with a little life, but he refuses to believe the child is his. Tess is hurt after he rejects her and begins to regret the night they spent together. However, Nate later shows up at her place, having decided to pursue her. Tess briefly considers giving in to his advances, but she can't just let him have his way this time. So instead she overcomes the pain in her own heart and lies, telling him the pregnancy test was incorrect...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 億万長者の隠された天使

203120.description:
“Please let me see him!” When Cesar Montero is taken to the hospital after a car crash, Sorcha, his personal secretary, isn’t allowed to see him on the grounds that she is not a relative. Sorcha has long had feelings for Cesar, but right after they spent the night together, they were met with misfortune. On top of that, Cesar’s fiancée shows up and tries to pay her off, an apology to his “one last fling.” Sorcha despairs that their night of passion was just that, a fling that meant nothing to Cesar… She vows to start over, far away, never to see him again!

(Source: Barnes & Noble)

203121.description:
An unknown virus broke out in a city of ten million. Dr. Wendy Hao volunteered to fight against it. Will she be able to treat her patients and win this battle?

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)

203122.description:
"I should never have looked at my girlfriend's phone that day."

From a friend, I hear a strange rumor about my girlfriend, Olivia.

"They said Olivia walked out of a motel. And... she wasn't alone. She was with another guy."

I tell myself it must have been a mistake and try to brush it off, but the doubt takes root in the back of my mind. For the first time, and the last, I check my girlfriend's phone.

"What are you doing? Take it off. Everything. Your bra and panties too."

(Source: TOPTOON)
synonyms: My Girlfriend Was Already Fully Trained
俺は知らない彼女の顔

203123.description:
Cheon Taesan, the Scholar Specialist in Reforming Scoundrels. He gains renown by rehabilitating the most notorious ruffians in the Martial Arts World (Murim). Born with the Heavenly Martial Body, he faces a cruel fate where he must acquire the Seven Stars Primordial Qi just to extend his lifespan. As he interacts with the mysterious Ice Star Body, he draws closer to the hidden truths of the Martial Arts World.

(Source: Naver, translated)

203124.description:
Jewelry designer Tamara once again finds herself face-to-face with the Earl of Melton at a party. He's the CEO of a hugely successful company, with a strong build and masculine features, not to mention her father's choice to be her husband! With the confidence of a conquering hero, once again he asks for her hand in marriage. Although she refuses him right away, in order to save the business she has worked so hard to start, eventually she agrees. They hatch a plan to become husband and wife for half a year, each pursuing their own business goals-him, a successful merger with her father's company, her, a steady list of clientele-but can Tamara resist his passionate act?

(Source: Renta!)

203125.description:
When Rafael unexpectedly proposed, Cora couldn't believe what she was hearing. Rafael had brought her to Spain to work for him, but she never expected he'd want her as his wife. But all Rafael really wants is to fulfill the required conditions in order to buy land. The moment she finds out he's only using her, Cora is devastated. Of course a gorgeous man wouldn't love such a plain woman like her. But then why did he choose her to propose to?

(Source: Renta!)

203126.description:
A series of seemingly disconnected acts revolving around dreary situations, thematically connected. Tsukusun's first manga.

Organized in 3 acts:
第一章「死ぬ少女」 - First Act: "Dead Girl"
第二章「未来は素晴しい」- Second Act: "The Future is Great"
第三章「笑顔が一番」- Third Act: "A Smile is The Best"

203128.description: A story about a female knight captured by barbarians
synonyms: The Female Knight and the Barbarians
くっころ女騎士の漫画

203130.description:
I was reincarnated as the Princess of a small, insignificant country only referred to as the Struntz Kindom.

I, Brünhilde Rosenmüler Stuckenschmidt (yes I am aware my name is quite the mouthful), am the future Queen of my country. My Nation is surrounded by four other countries.

Even though it's a small country, it's quite okay. All of those foolish surrounding nations have the tendency to banish their people who happen to have extraordinary talents with abilities so amazing that they are almost cheat-level skills.

Thus begins the story of a reincarnated princess who aims to gather all of those banished "villainesses" and other villainous ladies into her Kingdom so that her small nation becomes the most powerfull and prosperous one of all!
synonyms: We’ll Take the Unwanted Villainesses, and We'll Take Them Back to Our Own Country.
Our Country Takes in Unwanted Villainesses. Banishing All These Excellent Noble Girls Is an Act of Foolishness That Will Ruin Their Countries, You Know?

title.native: 要らない悪役令嬢、我が国で引き取りますわ～優秀なご令嬢方を追放だなんて愚かな真似、国を滅ぼしましてよ？～
title.romaji: Iranai Akuyaku Reijou, Wa ga Kuni de Hikitorimasu wa: Yuushuu na Goreijougata wo Tsuihou da Nante Oroka na Mane, Kuni wo Horoboshimashite yo?

203131.description:
Elena planned to remain single, but she always wanted a child. That's why she accepted when her friend Sam offered to father a child with her. Nothing happened after a few weeks, so she assumed she hadn't conceived and thought nothing more of it. A whirlwind romance with Sam's brother, Jed, followed and the two were soon married! Elena was finally happier than she ever thought possible, but then she began feeling nauseous and realized she was six weeks' pregnant!

(Source: Renta!)

203132.description:
When nineteen-year-old Nicola's father passed away, she married his business partner, Brett. She'd always had feelings for him, so when they married, she was over the moon. But her happiness didn't last. It seems that Nicola's father arranged the marriage before his death because he was worried that men would come after her for her money. The whole wedding was arranged just to protect her. As time passes, she knows that it's futile to wish for a true, passionate marriage with Brett, and with her twenty-first birthday approaching, she'll soon be able to give him back his ring and break things off...

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Kokoro no Kagi wa Dare no Mono?

203133.description:
Natalie, marry me. Being proposed to by Pierce, son of the most distinguished family in town, should have been a dream come true for Natalie. She's been deeply in love with him since she was a teenager. She had given up on him before because she's the daughter of a servant, but her feelings only intensified as she got older. One month before his proposal, Pierce came to her house after breaking off his engagement with the daughter of a wealthy family, and they slept together. She intended it to happen only once, just to comfort him. But she finds herself pregnant, and now the man she loves most has come to her with a proposal born out of obligation. Is this the end of her dream?

(Source: Renta!)

203134.description:
Andi lost both her father and her fiance in the same car accident, and now she's been saddled with all the debt her father left behind. The only solution is to sell her family's mansion. In the depths of despair, she meets Linus, an up-and-coming real-estate tycoon who's interested in purchasing the property. He's a calculating man and makes her an offer of his own-she can stay and live in the mansion with her mother...if she'll be his secretary. Andi feels anxious whenever she's around him, but with no other options, she decides to accept his offer so that she can stay in her home with her mother. But what if Linus's real goal isn't just the mansion, but Andi herself?

(Source: Renta!)

203135.description:
"Just for tonight, forget about the future. Be with me..." Those are the words Angel, a very wealthy mogul from New York, whispered to Belle, the far-less-wealthy waitress. She has trouble believing the hot, arrogant prince wants her. It can't be...But with the way his gleaming eyes are looking at her, his attraction can't be denied. Belle decides that, for once, she won't be the good girl! It was just supposed to be a night to remember. Belle didn't expect it to become something she might regret for the rest of her life...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 摩天楼のスペイン公爵
男の娘JKギャルは実はお兄ちゃんがだ～い好き
title.romaji: Otoko no Ko JK Gal wa Jitsu wa Onii-chan ga Daaisuki

title.native: 友達をオナホにしてたらふたなり教師にちんぽで叱られました
title.romaji: Tomodachi wo Onaho ni Shitetara Futanari Kyoushi ni Chinpo de Shikararemashita

title.native: 淫乱少年総集編〜おじさんとビッチなショタ達の全て〜
title.romaji: Inran Shounen Soushuuhen: Ojisan to Bitch na Shota-tachi no Subete

203140.description:
Paddington Hospital is a popular children's hospital housed in a former castle. Victoria, a paramedic, is always butting heads with haughty Dominic, a doctor there. Just today they had an argument over how to admit a patient. He always has to have the last word! One day, after discovering that the man she's dating only got close to her to create a relationship with her father, Victoria goes somewhere she can cry alone. But then Dominic finds her and gently comforts her... She ends up wrapped in his warmth all night!

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Tou no Ue no Hi Koi

203142.description:
Last Christmas, Olivia found herself slipping away from the company party with jet-setting lawyer and committed bachelor Lucas. Consumed by overwhelming passion, Olivia broke her promise to save herself for marriage...An unexpected pregnancy leads to Lucas proposing marriage for the baby's sake, but Olivia is reluctant to accept a loveless marriage, especially one that impedes her dream of becoming a lawyer. To find out whether they can make things work, they decide to live together. Is it really impossible for a woman to have it all?

(Source: Renta!)

203143.description:
"With an assassin like Noah here, rumors may be spread that are unfavorable to the party."

Noah is suddenly expelled from the hero's party. Having grown up in a lonely and difficult environment of daily training, Noah thought that his fellow heroes were finally friends he could trust...

Just as Noah is at a loss, his childhood friend, Princess Rubia, appears before him. "Would you like to be my bodyguard?" Rubia recommends Noah as her bodyguard, but the king presents her with one condition: that he must defeat Tony Brown, one of the twelve knights said to be the strongest in the world, in a mock battle.

Will Noah really be able to become Rubia's bodyguard?

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 追放されたので、暗殺一家直伝の影魔法で王女の護衛はじめました！～でも、暗殺者なのに人は殺したくありません～
title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta node, Ansatsu Ikka Jikiden no Kage Mahou de Oujo no Goei Hajimemashita! Demo Ansatsusha nanoni Hito wa Koroshitaku Arimasen

203144.description:
Weza, a duke's daughter who can predict the weather 100% accurately, serves her country as the royal weather forecaster, protecting the people from many disasters. However, when her stepsister develops the same skill, she is quickly stripped of her fiancé and her position as forecaster, and is even sentenced to exile. Weza is left homeless in a remote area, but is picked up by a taciturn, handsome man from the agricultural guild, and begins a relaxing, comfortable life as a weather forecaster...!? Her life is happier after her exile, a Cinderella story of a weather forecaster!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 追放された公爵令嬢は、天気予報をしながら辺境の地でのんびり暮らす　～天気予報スキルを活かした追放生活の楽しみ方～
title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Koushaku Reijou wa, Tenkyohou wo Shinagara Henkyou no Chi de Nonbiri Kurasu: Tenkyohou Skill wo Ikashita Tsuihou Seikatsu no Tanoshimi-kata

203145.description:
Mayanna, the daughter of a marquis, comes from a family renowned for magic, but is a failure who can only use outdated rune magic. What's more, she is overworked by her older sister, a talented magician, and even has her fiance taken away from her, making her a pitiful victim. Then, one day, Prince Alectos, a great genius in magic, comes to visit Mayanna... "Mayanna Pheles... I've come to scout you." Will outdated rune magic save the country?! The reversal of Mayanna's life, once scorned as her older sister's waste, begins now!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: ルーン魔術だけが取り柄の不憫令嬢、天才王子に溺愛される ～婚約者、仕事、成果もすべて姉に横取りされた地味な妹ですが、ある日突然立場が逆転しちゃいました～
title.romaji: Rune Majutsu Dake ga Torie no Fubin Reijou, Tensai Ouji ni Dekiai Sareru: Konyakusha, Shigoto, Seika mo Subete Ane ni Yokidori Sareta Jimi na Imouto Desu ga, Aru Hi Totsuzen Tachiba ga Gyakuten Shichimashita

203147.description:
Svein Schmidt is a five-year-old boy obsessed with alchemy. During the "Seance Ritual" where he is bestowed with a "profession," he is given the unfortunate, lowest-level job of "Novice," with no particular field of expertise. However, in reality, "Novice" is a special "profession" that holds a little bit of every talent and opens up all possibilities, depending on effort! Svein ends up living with Aria, a girl who was banished from her noble family for being given a low-level job. One day, they rescue some legendary sacred beasts, and the two experience a major turning point in their lives!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 聖獣とともに歩む隠者～錬金術から始める生産者ライフ～
title.romaji: Seijuu to Tomoni Ayumu Inja: Renkinjutsushi kara Hajimeru Seisansha Life

203149.description: Confess your sins, degenerates! Honesty is the best policy, after all…

203150.description:
Yui Itomura is in love with her teacher, Seiichirou Hattori, who already has a girlfriend... until she finds out that his having a girlfriend has been a lie, at which point she decides to confess her feelings to him.
He initially rejects her on the basis that he finds romantic endeavors troublesome, but things escalate when Yui seduces him, awakening his instincts as a man. After having sex together for the first time, he begins to desire her more and more. Their relationship is secret and purely physical at first, but their hearts are slowly closing the gap.
However, a certain incident leads Yui to ghost her teacher. By the time he finds her again, he's already consumed by obsession. He forcibly takes her to his house where he repeatedly violates her with pleasure while whispering words of love. It's his way of ensuring she belongs to him...

(Source: DLsite)

title.native: カノジョは要らない服部先生！ ～恋は面倒なんて言ってホントは愛が重すぎる～
title.romaji: Kanojo wa Iranai Hattori-sensei!: Koi wa Menou nante Itte Honto wa Ai ga Omosugiru

203151.description:
What would pandas say if they knew how to talk? Will penguins adore polar bears because the North Pole is warmer? When baby tadpoles are on the way looking for their mother, they accidentally find a giraffe, and a hedgehog falls in love with a chestnut… Everyday life is full of happiness with many cute animals that you could never stop once you read!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Quickly Put the Animal Inside the Fridge

title.english: Put a Zoo in the Fridge

title.native: 花より団子なわけでもない
title.romaji: Hana yori Dango na wake demo nai

203154.description:
After half a year on the run, the vampire Eugene was ultimately killed, offered up as a sacrifice to boost a holy knight's fame. Just as his life ended in bitter regret, a chance to return came to him.

“I will never die like that again. If I’ve truly returned to the past, then I'll never regret anything a second time... no matter what it may take."

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: How to Live as a Vampire Lord

title.native: あの日、小川洋子先生の作品を読んで
title.romaji: Ano Hi, Ogawa Youko Sensei no Sakuhin wo Yonde

203157.description:
Wang Zheng, the veteran of the Special Forces is hire by the noble family, the Shangguan family, to protect its heiress Shangguan Shishi. The arrogant and willful lady is indeed a headache. While he is busy with kidnaps and murders, Wang Zheng has to teach this lady some lessons...
Anyway, who dares to piss me off must pay for what he has done!

(Source: MangaToon)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title.native: 彼氏の弟に懐かれたい
ハピネスTVショッピング

203160.description:
After Selina Tucker, the daughter of a rich man, is kidnapped, Harvey Lowe gains the trust of his father, William Tucker, by rescuing Selina. To find a way to heal his master, Harvey set off to the city where he works as Selina's bodyguard by chance and embarks on a legendary journey full of excitement…

(Source: WebComics)

203161.description:
In the world, cultivators practice on their soul. A young man named Ye Xinghe, a prodigy with an inborn talent, awakens a ninth-grade Soul: the Dragon Pattern Purple Gold Cauldron, becoming the youngest alchemist ever. However, he is envied by his brother, who steals his Soul, turning him into a cripple! Unexpectedly, he awakens the ninth divine-grade Soul! From then on, he rises and becomes a supreme master of both alchemy and martial arts!

(Source: MangaToon)

203162.description:
Diane Tao caught her bestie and her fiancé having sex accidentally in her own room. Feeling pathetic about herself, Diane immediately married a "surgeon" who came to her home to check up on her father in a fit of rage. She thought she would live an ordinary life for the rest of her life, but one day after the marriage, she found various secrets of her doctor husband...

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Flash Marriage Difficult to Leave, Will Spoil You

203163.description:
After an encounter with a blue-haired boy, Shi Lei was given a mysterious black card and became their puppet. After that, he began to start his days by spending money! “Kill me if I don't spend all of the money?”“I've only heard that growing stronger might make people bald, I don't know that being rich will also…”“Close friends are allowed to help me spend money?”“Brilliant! My childhood sweethearts, gorgeous beauties and wacky lolitas, let me be your personal ATM! Yeah!”

(Source: Webnovel)

203164.description:
In the urban suspense series of stories, behind a series of thrilling incidents, justice and evil are being watched, how does the punisher under the mask start to act?

(Source: INKR)

203165.description:
In the urban suspense series of stories, behind a series of thrilling incidents, justice and evil are being watched, how does the punisher under the mask start to act?

(Source: INKR)

203166.description: Manga adaptation of the "Otoko wa Tsurai yo" film series by Youji Yamada.

203167.description:
Onihime Orochi by Kichou Kagemori—the sole pseudonym of Marina Shirakawa—featured in the 1970s Hibari Kaiki Manga series! A masterpiece bridging modern and period drama, its brilliantly intertwined themes of tragic romance and serpentine horror shine through. Particularly overwhelming is the dynamic energy of Onihime, showcased across double-page spreads and entire pages.

(Source: Mandarake, translated)

203168.description:
When she was 17, the boyish Chiaki met her underclassman Koharu. The two girls started sleeping together and Koharu soon possessed Chiaki's heart. But after they graduate, Koharu shares that she slept with a man over summer break.

Note: Contains the full color one-shot Mousou Fuufu (妄想夫婦)

203169.description:
Sitting on the school yard, gazing at the sky, outside the window during class, waiting for a friend at the bus stop—love came unexpectedly. A sweet love story of two boys who are having a fling.

1. Jin-Woo and Young-Won: Jin-Woo, a good cook, a conceited, affectionate prisoner, and tactless, has grown listless in his dull daily life. Then, he falls in love at first sight with Young-Won, a senior he meets on school yard. However, Young-Won, everyone's idol, is already famous for his sharp rejection of confessions. It's only natural that if he, a stranger, confesses, he'll be 100% rejected! Jin-Woo decides to use his specialty, cooking, to tame Young-Won's stomach. Jin-Woo's "From Everyone's Senior to My Young-Won Project" ends in a mess.

2. Tae-Heon and Ah-Seong: A conscious, introverted, tactless, and a gold digger. Tae-Heon's childhood friend Ah-Seong has a penchant for falling in love easily, regardless of gender. Falling in love faster than anyone else, feeling heartbroken faster than anyone else. Tae-Heon, who knew every detail of Ah-Seong's love life, suddenly had a question.

"Hey, but why do you fall for everyone but not me?"

Tae-Heon confidently offered to make Ah-Seong fall for him, despite Ah-Seong's disapproval. Ah-Seong couldn't understand why he was acting like that...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

203170.description:
Chef Shanchuan Lin has always admired top model Haiming Sen from afar — a bright, confident star completely out of his league. But after a sudden accident costs Shanchuan his job and leaves him drowning in debt, his world collapses overnight. That’s when Haiming steps in, offering a lifeline...and a sickeningly sweet “special part-time job” only Shanchuan can do...

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

title.native: 母子情事 〜大好きな母さんと今夜交わる〜
title.romaji: Boshi Jouji: Daisuki na Kaa-san to Konya Majiwaru

203172.description:
In the hidden slums of Hong Kong, two rival powers dominate the underworld: The Grove Syndicate and The Lotus Syndicate. Their relentless territorial clashes plunge the city into chaos.

Song Ran, the underboss of The Grove Syndicate, is captured by members of The Lotus Syndicate but escapes, only to collapse in front of a modest flower shop. There he encounters Ja Woon-Young, the shop’s refined and gentle-looking owner whose presence feels strikingly out of place amid the shadows of the slums.

What begins as a chance encounter soon grows into a dangerous entanglement. As the war between The Grove Syndicate and The Lotus Syndicate escalates beyond control, Song Ran becomes haunted by vivid, feverish dreams of fierce intimacy with Woonyoung. Drawn to him yet disturbed by the menace behind his beauty, he finds himself unable to resist.

Beneath Woon-Young’s graceful smile lies a chilling gaze that conceals his true nature. Caught between desire and suspicion, Song Ran must uncover the secret of the mysterious florist before it consumes him entirely.

(Source: Lezhin US)

203173.description:
Kwon Ji-Hyeok, a good-for-nothing who’s lived his whole life relying solely on the handsome face he inherited from his parents, finds himself kicked out of his girlfriend’s house with nowhere else to go. While wandering in search of his next place to freeload, he stumbles upon a mansion with its door left open and decides to sneak in. But inside, he’s greeted by the horrifying sight of a dismembered corpse. Sensing imminent doom, he tries to escape, only for the missing homeowner to appear right then and there. One look is all it takes for Ji-Hyeok to realize it: this guy definitely has the face of a serial killer.

For someone who’s always coasted through life on his looks, this is the biggest crisis he’s ever faced. To survive, Ji-Hyeok might have to pull his most desperate move yet, using his charm to seduce this psychopathic killer. Because if he fails, it won’t just be his pride that gets pierced.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.
synonyms: อย่าทิ้งขยะอย่างผมเลยนะครับ

203174.description:
After suffering frightening spiritual symptoms, Park Sin-Wu undergoes a shamanic ritual and meets Bi-Yeon, the spirit he’s destined to serve. Bi-Yeon is beautiful, demanding, oddly affectionate… and insists that their “union” is the only way to protect Sin-Wu. But as Bi-Yeon grows clingier and Sin-Wu’s doubts deepen, he can’t tell if this god is his guardian or something far more dangerous.

(Source: Lezhin US)

203175.description:
The original creator of the series tells the stories of the everyday moments at Cafe LycoReco, never before seen in the anime! The third installment of this spin-off series weaves tales of the people who hang out at LycoReco, including Chisato and Takina!

(Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)

title.native: リコリス・リコイル Gluttony days

203176.description:
Once a spoiled beauty, she became fat and ugly after a serious illness!? Dumped by her boyfriend and friendless, she spent her days disheveled and unkempt, branded as the “good-for-nothing girl.” The heavenly princess has fallen into hell. Just as she resigned herself to drift through life all alone, a mysterious full-length mirror suddenly appeared in her room. The girl regained her beauty, and to her astonishment, she found herself transported back in time to when she was 17?

(Source: Baidu, translated)

title.native: 废柴小姐的恋爱生存游戏
title.romaji: Feichai Xiaojie De Lianai Shengcun Youxi

203178.description:
A quiet rural village. Alec, a handsome transfer student from the city, spots So-Ho, shunned by everyone for "shooing away even forest monsters." Alec, who was trying to unravel his own hidden, twisted complexes toward So-Ho, is overcome by an inexplicable emotion the moment he meets So-Ho's eyes behind his glasses. The forest he and So-Ho went to escape his father becomes their private nest.

"You will become my monster."

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

203179.description:
“Can I kiss you?”

The words slipped out before Ga-Young could stop them. Her straight-laced boss, Jae-Hyun, froze.

“Are you talking to me?”

“Do you hate the idea?” she whispered, leaning in to seduce him. After a soft, brief kiss, she giggled, “So soft. I didn't know you were such a gentle man, Team Leader.”But before she could pull away, his large hand gripped the back of her head, forcing her to face him. His eyes were no longer gentle.

“Now that you’ve done this, we’re dating. You’re my woman now.”

(Source: Manta)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunjeong Danpyeonseon (순정 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: When the Uptight Boss Goes into Heat

title.english: When Your Uptight Boss Gets Riled Up

203180.description: Note: Part of Metatoon's Gyeryak Danpyeonseon (계략 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Scheming Anthology] The Syrup in the Count's Tea Is a Sleeping Aid

203181.description:
Once upon a time, in a land far, far away, there was a small kingdom. However, a wicked witch suddenly appeared and the kingdom that was once beautiful grew ever poorer. After 300 years of living in terror of the witch, the king decided to capture the witch. This task was given to one peasant boy, Len...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: むかしむかしのわるい魔女

203182.description:
"Why don't you have a child with me, then?"

A woman who lost the husband she adored, and a man who lost the brother he revered, united in the depths of their grief.... The widowed Shion, age 35, spends her days trying to manage the small store she ran with the husband who died three years earlier. But from a sorrow that time doesn't seem to heal, she comes to think, "If only I'd had a child with him, a piece of him would still be here with me." When her college student brother-in-law Kosei learns of Shion's wish, he makes an unexpected proposition that shakes her to the core. Is he doing it out of respect for his older brother, or is it something else...? These two bereaved souls, aching for the same lost loved one, become transfixed by a forbidden notion....

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: あなたがここに、いないから

203183.description:
Will you listen? This is my rambling story... On a muddy Earth, humanity lives underground, hiding. One day, I visit the surface, and am captivated by a mysterious girl standing alone...

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

title.native: 婚約破棄された女侯爵は、救国の英雄に溺愛されました!?
title.romaji: Konyaku Hakisareta Onna Koushaku wa, Kyuukoku no Eiyuu ni Dekiaisaremashita!?

203185.description:
Nanase is paired with Tagawa as class representative. But during their first time working together, she realizes something... when she sees Tagawa's lips, she feels an incredibly strange sensation... As these feelings gradually grow, Nanase can no longer bear them! This collection contains 5 works filled with fetishism!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 君のくちびる 私の欲望
title.romaji: Kimi no Kuchibiru Watashi no Yokubou

203186.description:
"You mean marriage is the grave of life? If I'm not careful, I'll die alone, left out in the open!"

Nomura Natsuko continues to get involved with bad men and remains single. It wasn't until her 40th birthday that she discovered her boyfriend was married. "I'm tired of love, but being alone forever is lonely." While she was sulking alone at a bar, she happened upon the feared and harsh-spoken Director Yashiro. Moved by his sudden display of loneliness, despite his lack of romantic interest, Natsuko impulsively proposes a life partnership... but...? It seems like living together as adults without a romantic relationship might actually work out surprisingly well!?

(Source: Cmoa Comics, translated)

title.native: そこで死ねたら本望～結婚は人生の墓場!?～
title.romaji: Soko de Shinetara Honmou: Kekkon wa Jinsei no Hakaba!?

203187.description:
It's been ten years since the spiritual realm and our physical world became fully connected. Ghosts, monsters, phantoms, spirits — all manner of supernatural beings became humanity's neighbors. The human world has been completely transformed, as demons and monsters appeared everywhere and caused chaos. Naturally, crimes involving monsters became commonplace, and inevitably, there came people who made a living solving such cases.

They are "The Youkai Detectives."

One such man will once again go out into the night with his beautiful assistant, to tackle another case involving the supernatural.

The letter from the client read:
“I am a mermaid. If this continues, I will be eaten. Please save me.”

But when they arrived at the old mansion where the letter came from, it seemed the mermaid had been eaten over a year ago...
What truth will the Youkai Detective discover?

(Source: MF Bunko J, translated)

title.native: 魍魎探偵今宵も騙らず

203188.description:
After gaining a second chance at high school through time travel, Natsuki Haibara strives to live a vibrant school life with the help of his childhood friend, Miori. His next goal: to find a girlfriend. Natsuki invites his crush, Hikari, and together with Miori and Reita, they embark on a double date — enjoying the youthful experience he missed out in his past life! Just when it seemed his plan was going smoothly...

“…Um, listen. Would you like to go to the Tanabata Festival with me?”

Uta's earnest request sends Natsuki's heart racing, caught between his feelings for Shiori and the dynamics of his group of friends — love and friendship pulling fiercely at his heartstrings!

(Source: Firecross, translated)

title.native: 灰原くんの強くて青春ニューゲーム ～雨に打たれる君に傘を差そう～
title.romaji: Haibara-kun no Tsuyokute Seishun New Game: Ame ni Utareru Kimi ni Kasa wo Sasou

203189.description:
In the sweltering heat of summer, seven office workers lose their way during a company workshop. They stumble upon an old mountain lodge filled with mysterious, unidentified bottles of alcohol. As if bewitched, they drink one glass after another slowly letting their reason slipping away. The boss then discreetly offers us a proposal. The lodge suddenly fills with desire and secrets.

“Would you like to hear the story of my first experience?”

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

203190.description:
A song brings them together, but their youthful voices have fallen silent. From different worlds yet bound by the same loneliness, two teens searching for solace find themselves trapped in the grip of addiction. How will illegal drugs impact their lives?

(Source: Taiwan Comic City)

203191.description:
Arisa Kumagai, age 27. Works earnestly at her new job as an interior design salesperson. Lives in an apartment overflowing with self-improvement books. Meets unpleasant rumors from her coworkers and superiors with a smile. Arisa tries, and she tries, and she tries. But what comes after that…?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

203193.description:
Spin-off of Kugatsu-byou, centered around a new protagonist.

In addition to the main six chapters, includes the following extra short stories:
1. Honnou (本能); Self-published (2008-08)
2. Dear days; Comic Yell! Vol. 8 (2008-09)
3. Suimin Busoku (睡眠不足); Self-published (2008-08)
4. Koufukuron (幸福論); Bessatsu Puchi Yell! (2008-12)
5. Little Distance; Self-published (2008-08)
6. Mirai Yosouzu (未来予想図); Bessatsu Puchi Yell! (2008-12)
synonyms: Oboreru You ni Dekiteiru Perfect Edition

title.native: 溺れるようにできている。 完全版

203194.description:
After days of starvation, my vision blurred, and a shadow spoke to me.

That night, I made a pact with the shadow. By eating the sins of others, I gained a life where I would never have to starve again. Since gaining my powers, I've lost the ability to taste ordinary food, and I've accumulated a bit (a lot?) of a criminal record… But you know what? Sin tastes better.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

203196.description:
1. Shiro no Innocenti (白のイノセンティ)
2. Romancing N.Y. (ロマンシングＮ・Ｙ)
3. Yousei no Nemuru Ame no Mori (妖精の眠る雨の森)
4. Mitsu no Aji (蜜の味)
synonyms: Yousei no Nemuru Ame no Mori

203197.description:
Kim Seonu is perfectly content being an extra in the novel "Modern Mage." However, when the protagonist, Lee Seojun, dies unexpectedly, Seonu is sent back to his high school days with one goal: to keep his classmate safe. Armed with knowledge of the story’s future events, Seonu begins to alter the original plot. But the more he intervenes, the more he changes his own fate—until he’s no longer just an NPC, but the novel’s new protagonist. Now, every choice he makes could rewrite the entire story!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Regressed Extra Becomes a Genius

203198.description:
Broke and desperate, Marin talks her way into a job assisting Gerald von Vines, the blind and temperamental duke. Her plan is simple: earn enough to rebuild her life and return to normalcy with her mother. But a moment of kindness backfires, landing her an unexpected promotion to fiancée. Now she is stuck managing a stubborn man who rejects help yet finds his only peace by her side.
