As their arrangement turns personal, will Marin and the Duke discover that some things are better felt than seen?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Got Engaged To The Blind Duke

203199.description:
Unloved by her family and alone to her last breath, she reincarnates into a novel’s world as a girl raised in hardship. One day, the heir apparent of a count’s house appears, claims to be her father, and proposes a contract father daughter arrangement. Confused but desperate to escape, she accepts. She may be his real daughter, but their bond starts as a contract what future awaits this unusual

(Source: Piccoma, translated)
synonyms: The Count's Beloved Contract Young Lady
Beloved Contract Lady of the County

title.native: 伯爵家の愛され契約令嬢

203200.description:
Hina has just moved into her own place to start university, in a town that's livable but rather dull and boring. She figured, “Well, it's just for four years of college, so I'll just put up with it...” until one day when she meets Kage, a young man taking photos of seemingly ordinary spots around town. Intrigued by Kage's photos, Hina decides to join him on a stroll through the city! Suddenly, her impression of this boring town begins to shift...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

203201.description:
"Stop playing games and go outside and play!"

For those of us who find home more comfortable than outdoors, and games more enjoyable than sports, just being able to play games and access the internet is enough for us! Today, to protect our peaceful daily lives, a spectacular battle unfolds in the corner of our rooms!

(Source: Naver, translated)

203203.description:
Lee Heon-Seo (Female, 24), a college student who turned into a pigeon overnight. Unable to find a way to return to being human again, Heon-Seo stays at the house of her male friend Ban Hwi-Hyeol in the same neighborhood for the time being and continues her life as a pigeon...

"What do you think, Lee Heon-Seo? Is life as pigeon fun?"

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: ねぇご主人 今日の「ごほうび」まだぁ? ボクッ娘メスガキハーフサキュバス奴隷娘にごほうび生活
title.romaji: Nee Goshujin Kyou no "Gohoubi" madaa? Bokukko Mesugaki Half Succubus Dorei Musume ni Gohoubi Seikatsu

203206.description:
A collection of slightly strange stories set in the fictional town of Nishiogi.

It's ordinary, yet not ordinary. It seems to be somewhere, yet it's nowhere. But somehow it feels nostalgic.

A strange yet heartbreaking story of "us" that takes place in the fictional town of Nishiogi.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

203207.description: I'm crazy about the cutest boss in the world! My new boss is a quiet, cool, and top-tier employee. At first, I was scared, but then he stares at me, rubs up against me, and then suddenly pulls away... The more I get to know him, the more I get addicted to this "cat" boss. Will he be at my mercy again today?! A heart-fluttering office love comedy about an adorable boss and her subordinate!

title.native: ねこ上司といぬ部下くん

203208.description:
When unpopular college student Doba Sakurata orders a book on how to become popular online, what arrives is a beautiful girl!? A new kind of love story begins, scathingly addressing the questions of unpopular men!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 非モテの疑問に答える本
title.romaji: Himote no Gimon ni Kotaeru Hon

203209.description:
One day, Queen Ashley suddenly regains her memories of her past life. She recalls that the world she is currently living in is a romance novel she read in her previous life, in which Ashley was a "villain" who held her husband, King Ralph, in a hold of his weaknesses and did whatever she wanted. Knowing that she is heading straight for execution if she continues on this path, she confesses all the pain she has caused him and decides to divorce him in order to set him free. After leaving the castle, Ashley begins working at a clinic in town, making use of her abilities as a genius healer, but Ralph, who she thought she had broken up with, begins to approach her...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 前世の記憶を取り戻したので最愛の夫と離縁します～悪女と評判でしたが天才治癒師として開花したら、なぜか聖女が自爆しました～
title.romaji: Zense no Kioku wo Torimodoshita node Saiai no Otto to Rien Shimasu: Akujo to Hyouban Deshita ga Tensai Chiyushi to Shite Kaika Shitara, Nazeka Seijo ga Jibaku Shimashita

title.native: ゲット・バック・TVショウ

203211.description:
1. Oshiire Dragon (押し入れドラゴン)
2. Oshiire Majo Souko Iki (押し入れ魔女倉庫行き)
3. Oshiire no Wake Arishatachi (押し入れの訳アリ者たち)
4. Hoshi no Ko (星の子)
5. Umi e Iku (海へ行く)
6. Hinan Kankoku 61-nichi (避難勧告61日)
7. Yousei no Yakusoku (妖精の約束)

203212.description:
43-year-old housewife Kaori Odagawa has lost her sense of purpose in life, both at home and at work. One day, on her way home from work, she gets into a traffic accident and suddenly finds herself reincarnated in a Chinese-style alternate world!? At a loss, Kaori decides to show her gratitude to the elderly man who helped her, Hua Yuanhua, by serving him her homemade cooking!

As a housewife with 15 years of experience, Kaori is delighted to hear the words "delicious" she never heard in her previous life, as she prepares her usual dishes with care and dedication.

"Let's make lots of delicious side dishes!"

Reborn through the power of cooking! The Chinese reincarnation tale of cooking is now a comic!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 転生厨師の彩食記 異世界おそうざい食堂へようこそ！
title.romaji: Tensei Kuriyashi no Irodori Shokuki Isekai Osouzai Shokudou e Youkoso!

203213.description:
A count's daughter, Anastasia, was abused by her family and lost her life. When she opened her eyes, she somehow found herself transported back to the past!Hoping to finally seize happiness, she seeks freedom and is confronted by the mysterious merchant Kai and a group of closed-hearted young mercenaries. With memories of the future as her guide, she experiences kindness and bonds for the first time, while hoping for a love she has yet to experience.

The curtain rises on the young lady's dramatic turnaround!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 黒幕令嬢アナスタシアは、もうあきらめない 二度目の人生は自由を掴みます
title.romaji: Kuromaku Reijou Anastasia wa, Mou Akiramenai Futatabime no Jinsei wa Jiyuu wo Tsukamimasu

203214.description:
Andra Aveline and Dustin Ayrac were born sworn enemies just because their families are at odds. Andra has a passion for the pursuit of knowledge, while Dustin is the epitome of physical prowess. As they both try to complete their academy graduation assignments, they fall into a dungeon. There, in the darkness, an ancient spell that brings out their carnal urges takes hold of them. Now, they have to find a way to break this spell, but can they hold back their desires long enough to do that?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: พลบค่ำย่ำราตรี

203215.description:
A beautiful, fair-skinned young man living in a rural area turns out to be a vampire!? The vampire, who cannot drink blood, discovers beets, also known as the blood of the fields! He settles into the home of a young beet farmer, and while he tries to expand his business, his days pass by leisurely. A vampire-themed rural comedy about two men living together!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

203216.description:
Evelyn was forced to run an errand for cookies because her sister was trying to reconcile with her fiancé. But for some reason, the cookie, called a "love potion," ended up being eaten by her male friend, Kyle. Furthermore, the potion actually contained a libido-stimulating ingredient, and perhaps because of this, Kyle unleashed an unexpected, wild desire on Evelyn...?

"You wouldn't turn me into a beast and pretend not to notice, would you?"

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: The fourth story in Daewon's Neungyong Romance Danpyeon (능욕로맨스단편) Collection.
synonyms: [Neungyong Romance Danpyeon] Guljurin Neukdaeege Cookie-reul Juji Maseyo
Don’t Feed Cookies to a Starving Wolf

203217.description:
France, 1780. During the reign of King Louis XVI of the Bourbon dynasty, there was a princess who connected the people with the royal family. A young man was captivated by the princess, who vowed to remain single for life and continued to bestow mercy on the people with the "hand of God"...!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: エリザベート～神の手を持つ王女～
title.romaji: Elisabeth: Kami no Te wo Motsu Oujo

203218.description: Note: Published in COMIC Shigekiteki SQUIRT!! Vol. 66.

title.native: バ先パイセンと聖夜ボッチ

203219.description:
Following the death of her fiancé, the first princess, Lucia, returns to her home country. Upon her return, she finds herself subjected to daily harassment by her younger sisters, who are vying for the throne. However, with the support of Felix, the duke's son, her "royal qualities" begin to blossom...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 第一王女ルシアの帰還と華麗なる快進撃
title.romaji: Daiichi Oujo Lucia no Kikan to Kareinaru Kaishingeki

203220.description:
1. Boku no Oshigoto (ボクのお仕事)
2. Koi no Magic (恋のマジック)
3. Hayaku, Hayaku (はやく、はやく)
4. Naisho no Pool (内緒のプール)
5. Otoshimono Banzai (落とし物万歳)
6. Takuhai Santa (宅配サンタ)
7. Futarikiri Sokutei (ふたりきり測定)
8. Itsudemo Issho (いつでも一緒)
9. Senpai no Okage (先輩のお陰)
10. Hakucho to Chunibyo no Mizuumi (白鳥と中二病の湖)
11. Natsuyasumi! (夏休み！)
12. Dokidoki Bunkasai (どきどき文化祭)

203221.description:
After she gets caught up in a scandal and is exiled to a remote provincial hospital, all Hyo-Weon wants is to live a quiet life as a resident doctor. But her peace is soon shattered by Hae-Joo, a flirty patient notorious for seducing everyone in his path. Following a particularly stressful week, Hyo-Weon hooks up with Hae-Joo on the spur of the moment. As they continue their secret fling, the unlikely pair learn that they have more in common than they thought...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [OOTD Short Story Collection] Patient, This’ll Sting Just a Little

203222.description:
Ariane, a young girl born under the strong protection of the spirits, grew up with Lionel, the son of a duke who she had known since childhood. They vowed to marry each other and lived peaceful, happy lives together. But one day, her father, the count, forced her into an unwanted engagement with the second prince and confined her to their mansion. Believing she would be reunited with Lionel, Ariane endured her loneliness, but eventually she was deprived of the spirits' protection and was treated coldly by her family, pushing her to the brink both physically and mentally. Meanwhile, Lionel secretly began plotting to win back his beloved Ariane...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: あなたたちに捨てられた私は、ようやく幸せになれそうです
title.romaji: Anata-tachi ni Suterareta Watashi wa, Youyaku Shiawase ni Nare Sou desu

203223.description:
Luciel the Paladin is sent to eliminate a demon who has plunged an entire village into debauchery with their powers. At the village church, he reunites with Risia, a beautiful and kind nun who was his first love as a child. But when Risia sheds her habit to reveal a seductive truth, a mortified Luciel realizes that she knows all about his unholy desire for her...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [OOTD Short Story Collection] Holy Knight and Demon

203224.description:
Before going off to war, Penelope's father marries her off to a man named Ulric so she can legally inherit his assets in the event of his death. Frustrated with this decision, Penelope doesn't even look at her husband's face at the altar, nor when he leaves for the battlefield along with her father. When Ulric comes home years later, he turns out to be a kind and caring husband, but he seems different from how he portrayed himself in his letters. Is he really the same man Penelope married? If not, who on earth could he be...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note:
- Includes three extra chapters.
- Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [OOTD Short Story Collection] He Might Not Be My Husband

title.english: OOTD: He Might Not Be My Husband

203225.description:
Izumi, who is all alone in the world and can see supernatural phenomena, suddenly marries Haion, the last onmyoji protecting the imperial capital! Though unsociable during their married life, Haion recognizes Izumi's unique power of sight and is kind enough to stand by her. As a result, the distance between the two gradually closes...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 最後の陰陽師とその妻
title.romaji: Saigo to Onmyoji to Sono Tsuma

203226.description:
One day after school, Rin, a friendless high school girl who is constantly being harassed by spirits, bumps into Ruka, a handsome spirit with a nearly human presence. Normally, spirits disappear when they bump into Rin, but for some reason, Ruka doesn't disappear. The two find themselves chatting away, and upon realizing they have a strange common interest, Rin suggests to Ruka that they team up to provide advice to spirits...

A paranormal comedy featuring a non-communicative high school girl and a handsome ghost!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

203227.description:
When ordinary man Moo-Yeong awakens as an A-rank guide, he is shocked to find out he has been paired with his long-lost first love from high school: the elite S-rank esper Yoo-Hae. Although Yoo-Hae is delighted about their reunion, Moo-Yeong is determined to keep their relationship a professional one. And thus begins an endless amount of “work” as a guide. While it’s standard protocol for guides to heal through physical intimacy, Yoo-Hae’s demands are obsessively intense, pushing Moo-Yeong to his limits. Is this so-called business relationship going to work out?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: Excessive Work Is Good for Your Health

203228.description:
Jun-ho inherits his late Uncle Deok-chun's food truck. He travels the country, cooking to make the name "Go Deok-chun" known nationwide. Starting with Se-hee, the heir to a conglomerate, Jun-ho gets involved with women who each have their own stories in every region he visits! They all fall for him, but the one thing that truly captures Jun-ho's heart... is cooking! Follow the irresistible Jun-ho on his nationwide romantic food truck journey-business, let's begin!

(Source: Naver, translated)

203229.description:
Ordinary office worker Hae-Seo has remained a fanboy of a certain singer for a decade. During his overseas trip to attend a concert, he runs into Sae-Hyeon, a bodyguard, while preventing a malicious incident. Amidst the chaos, he leaves his prized fan merchandise with Sae-Hyeon. Hae-Seo is resigned to never seeing it again… only to have Sae-Hyeon show up at his hotel door. Hae-Seo is eager to have his merch returned to him, but there’s something familiar about this man. Will Sae-Hyeon not only bring back his beloved merch, but some nostalgic memories as well?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.

title.english: OOTD: Return to Me, That's Mine!

203231.description:
In a war-torn future, a machine called the E.T.A., or Emotion Transfer Apparatus, is developed to rid soldiers of guilt and PTSD. Once A-Jin gets his hands on an illegal version, he modifies it to amplify the user's pleasure with the dream of selling it to make a fortune. When the military gets wind of his plans and captures him as an adult, A-Jin unexpectedly reunites with his childhood friend, Hyeon, who is now a military officer. Believing A-Jin abandoned him when they were young, Hyeon is hellbent on getting revenge by using the augmented E.T.A. on A-Jin himself...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.

203232.description:
To Lord Vincent, his favorite servant, Adonis, has always appeared weak and fragile. This thought is further reinforced when Adonis becomes permanently injured in a horse-riding accident. In order to protect him, Vincent starts to keep his distance from Adonis, but that only triggers the servant to desire his master even more. Although the two of them can’t ride horses together anymore, with his whip in hand, Vincent might be willing to ride something else...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note:
- Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.
- Includes four extra chapters.
synonyms: [OOTD 단편선] 온 더 빗 (On the Bit)

203233.description:
Luce has had a huge crush on Kevin since their police school days, but hasn't had the chance to confess his feelings. Right when the two of them are about to wrap up an illegal aphrodisiac case, Luce accepts some donuts from a seemingly harmless admirer and gives them to a hungry Kevin. Unfortunately, these donuts are laced with the same aphrodisiac that's been plaguing the public! Poor Kevin has to climax ten times to get it all out of his system, and there's only one person around who can help him with the job...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.

title.native: こちら「運」命の恋ですか？
title.romaji: Kochira "Un" Mei no Koi desu ka?

203236.description:
Delinquent Tanaka is feared by all and nicknamed the Mad Dog. He fought every day, and rumors and whispers about him filled the school halls. That is, until a gloomy-looking, ordinary girl in glasses suddenly appeared. She didn't fear him, but rather, everything she did got on Tanaka's nerves.

"The way your face twists with emotion is very, very cute."

The unique air about her captures and traps Tanaka in her twisted cage.

(Source: K MANGA)

203237.description:
After the implementation of the female conscription system, newly commissioned Staff Sergeant Kim Hyunjoo is assigned as the only male instructor at a women-only recruit training corps due to a clerical mistake by the military personnel department. There, he comes face-to-face with two trainees: the school bully who tormented him during his student days, and his first love…

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

203238.description:
To take revenge on the husband who betrayed their nation, Adelaide returns from the brink of death. To get revenge on her husband, Adelaide decides to use her innocent brother-in-law, Cadis, and to let him go once her revenge is complete. After all, she was the poison he mistook for the Holy Grail.

“The only thing I’m afraid of… is being abandoned by you.”

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: The Poisoned Goblet: The Princess Filled With Poison

203239.description:
When Miranda, a nurse, is lured outside by a captivating sound, she finds an unfamiliar man playing the saxophone. Tempted by his sinfully soft voice, Miranda kisses him passionately. Then, suddenly, she's brought back to reality by the deep wounds in her heart and she flees. She decided long ago that she would never let herself be attracted to anyone again... Why did she let her guard down with him? Full of regret and bewilderment, she arrives at her new workplace and must confront a shocking situation. The man she kissed is her boss!

(Source: Renta!)

203240.description:
Sara is assistant to the Greek billionaire playboy Alekos. She also has secret feelings for him! Until now, she has lived by her mother's words: "Don't ever trust men." Her mother raised Sara by herself after Sara's father abandoned them, and through the years, those words have almost felt like a curse. Sara wants a change?she no longer wants to be just a boring secretary. So she takes a month off work and transforms into a entirely different Sara, one who completely shocks Alekos. At first he thinks she has a new lover, and yet he can't resist her. In fact, he decides to have her pretend to be his girlfriend, all the while saying that love is useless!

(Source: Renta!)

203241.description:
Are you living your own life?

Five years ago, Io Furuya came to Tokyo to change her life, which was comfortable but also empty. A friend introduced her to Nekome-sou, a boarding house. Nekome-sou is an old building, but it's attractive because of its low rent and the meals prepared by the two male landlords. Io decided to start a new life here, but she felt a little uneasy about the family-like closeness she felt with the unique residents and her new experiences. But then, a turning point came for Io...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 猫目荘のまかないごはん

203242.description:
Ellie never expected to meet Rio Benedetti again. They first met at her sister's wedding two years ago. Since then, Ellie's heart has belonged to Rio. They always had a mutual attraction and might have had an affair if Ellie hadn't thought that Rio was just playing with her. Pure-hearted Ellie, who is still hurt by the incident, visits Italy to meet the man who might be her father. Little does she know Rio is close to the man, and he does not want her anywhere near him because he thinks Ellie is a callous gold digger!

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 三姉妹はシンデレラ Ⅱ 億万長者と疑惑の愛

title.romaji: Oku Man Choja to Giwaku No Ai

203243.description:
Chloe agreed to a marriage of convenience with a young businessman named Ariston in order to save her father's company five years ago. But it wasn't long before she'd fallen completely in love with him. She was supposed to get pregnant within three years of their marriage, but when that didn't happen, they got divorced. With her family business once again in trouble, she pays her ex-husband a visit, hoping he can save it. Ariston is as charming as she remembers. Then he gives her a surprising proposition after hearing her plea. "I need you to have my baby."

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Kekkon to Iu na No Keiyaku

title.native: あみちゃんとゆうちゃん
かわいくなってきれいになって

203247.description:
To secure an alliance between the northern kingdom of Leracal and the southern realm of Arnata, the countries’ royal families agree to a political marriage. Tei, known across the frozen battlefields as the most fearsome warrior and monster hunter, volunteers himself as the kingdom’s hostage, trading his life as a warrior for that of a bride. In Arnata, Tei finds not the hostility he anticipated but the calm, steady gaze of Shuraka, the young crown prince destined to become both his spouse and future Padisha of the empire. For Shuraka to claim the throne, however, he must survive an uprising that threatens the kingdom - once that forces him to draw the blood of his own brothers. Moved by the courage and gentle integrity of his betrothed, Tei pledges to protect him at any cost…and in the quiet hours of a white night, two hearts caught between loyalty and longing begin to bloom.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: บุปผาใต้คืนตะวันฉาย

203248.description:
Alisa Benin has loved stories since her days at the Academy, so when she finds herself magically transported into the entries of her new diary, she gives the prince a story to soothe his tears. In these entries, Emperor Louis Ferdinando II is but a child, looking for friends. But in the present, Louis is perplexed by Alisa. Just who is this woman who has entered his dreams and, in doing so, altered his past? As Alisa comes to his aid, Louis will have to decide: Is this fairy friend or foe?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: アリーサと魔法の日記

203249.description:
Areum Ham can’t believe that one night of drinking to forget meant forgetting everything. But when Bumyeong Baek, soccer star and childhood friend, demands to know what they did the night before, one thing slowly becomes clear: neither of them remembers if things ended with a kiss. But just when she thinks things are complicated enough, he has another demand lined up for her.

Since when was he interested in more? Does she feel the same way, or has this tiger set his sights on the wrong prey?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: เสือร้ายข้างบ้าน
隣に住むは私のケダモノ
El tigre que vive al lado

title.native: うさぎさん美術館へ行こう

203253.description:
Duchess Ines, married to the Duke of Edward, a man more affectionate than anyone else. However, Ines harbors a secret she cannot tell. It is that she is more aroused by men who would humiliate her than by affectionate men. When her butler Leon learns this secret, he begins to abuse Ines to his heart's content while the Duke sleeps...

(Source: Naver Series, translated)
synonyms: The Duchess at the Butler’s Mercy

203255.description:
An unpopular man meets a cute young mermaid who comes onto land through a manhole.

Tired of life in the sea, she says she wants to fall in love with a human so she can gain legs that will allow her to walk freely on land.

Seduced by the mermaid's adorable smile, the man confesses, "I want to fall in love with you."

A rollercoaster horror story that begins with a sudden romance with a mermaid.

(Source: Number Nine, translated)
synonyms: At the Cost of a Mermaid’s Legs

title.native: 人魚の足とひきかえに
title.romaji: Ningyo no Ashi to Hikikae ni

203256.description:
Kang Min-Seok, the youngest kitchen staff member at the restaurant Black Hundred, is unexpectedly asked out on a date by designer Yun Ji-Ho at a broadcasting station where he's working as a food styling assistant. Min-Seok, entranced by Ji-Ho, who resembles his favorite, shares a meal with him and is drawn into Ji-Ho's strange power, ending up spending the night with him at a hotel. Ji-Ho, confused, demands, "Give me back the energy you stole." Min-Seok, who hurriedly flees, is suddenly attacked by Hee-Gong, the owner of the restaurant and his close friend of 10 years. Min-Seok learns that these monsters are approximately 1,000-year-old demons who need the energy he carries in their stomach to ascend to heaven and become dragons... ?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

203258.description:
Hyun-Oh, formerly an idol trainee. Although he never achieved his dream, he's already been an idol's road manager for a year. But this youngest, Kang-Woo, has been staring at Hyun-Oh suspiciously! Unwilling to notice, Hyun-Oh tries his best to ignore it... But then, Kang-Woo, the youngest, receives a drama offer and asks Hyun-Oh to practice a kiss scene with him, a shocking request?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: The first story in Mago Creative's Idol Danpyeonseon (아이돌 단편선) Collection.

203259.description:
Naturally, crimes are becoming more sophisticated, and so are detectives. Set in Tokyo in the near future, this is a hyper-detective story starring Ando Shachinosuke, a private detective with a penchant for the past.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 숨어 보는 BL 특강 : 블랜디드 러닝(BL)의 장점과 단점 ~히키코모리라도 XX는 하고 싶어!~
title.romaji: Sumeo Boneun BL Teukgang: Blended Learning (BL)-ui Jangjeomgwa Danjeom - Hikikomori-ra Do XX-neun Hago Sipeo!

203261.description:
"The Do clan will be short-lived for generations, and the descendants of the Imoogi who became dragons will become human and no longer be able to ascend to heaven."

Hae-Kwon, a descendant of the Imoogi who incompletely ascended to heaven, was originally a spirit but became human due to an ancestor's mistake. To lift a curse imposed by heaven, Hae-Kwon must find the "Yongrin" (dragon rin) possessed by the Do clan. Despite sacrificing countless years for the Do clan, Hae-Kwon finds it difficult to access. So, Hae-Kwon's family sends him to the Do clan to serve Chanui, plotting to exploit their friendship with him to seize the "Yongrin." However, Hae-Kwon, who has harbored a crush on Chanui ever since meeting him, hesitates to use him. To make matters worse, Chanui secretly leaves to study abroad. Then, just as he had left without a word, one day, Hae-Kwon suddenly reappears before him. Upon reuniting with Chanui, Hae-Kwon feels a strange heat rise within him...!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

203262.description:
"Did you feel bad about not having a handy ornament?"

Dam-I, who was castrated at a young age due to poverty and entered the palace to work as an apprentice eunuch. One day, the new crown prince, Mok-Yeong, the new Crown Prince whose mother was a lowborn courtesan, entered the palace to replace the Crown Prince who had died young from a chronic illness. After their unexpected first encounter, Mok-Yeong uses Dam-I as he pleases despite his pleas to be sent away from the palace—yet refuses to let him go for the sake of political intrigue. As the Crown Prince's royal bedchamber ceremony approaches, Mok-Yeong, unwilling to produce an illegitimate child, secretly brings Dam-I in as his practice partner...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

203263.description:
Ko is a graduate student with a secret... He just can't handle the heat of another person's touch. No matter how much he cares about them, his body rejects them... But, there is one person who can touch him: his step-brother Yu, who lives with him. Yu can touch him in ways his friends never can. Somehow, Ko doesn't feel uncomfortable when it's Yu putting his arm around his shoulder, patting him on the head, hugging him......or helping him out with his "needs." He knows most step-brothers don't "help" each other like this, but he still lets Yu do it. One night, though, Yu crosses a new line in their relationship...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 僕のかわいい鬼が笑えば
title.romaji: Boku no Kawaii Oni ga Waraeba

203265.description:
Why even try to win the emperor’s heart if you’re just one of 48 concubines? That’s the mindset of Elais, who spends all her days in the imperial palace shut inside her room playing a VR game. In fact, she’s never met the emperor before, nor does she ever plan to. And she has even less reason to focus on him when she encounters a cute newbie in the game. If she can’t have herself a real-life boyfriend, might as well have a virtual one, right? But wait, why does this newbie have the same name as the emperor...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: Named Player Elais: The Emperor's Lady
title.native: 放置された側室ですが恋したいので離婚してください
title.romaji: Houchireta Sokushtsu desu ga Koishitai node Rikonshite Kudasai

203266.description:
Princess Euphemia, boasting the most magical powers, talent, and beauty in her country, is known as the evil princess due to her arrogant attitude. One day, she's betrayed and nearly killed by her fiancé and sister. She barely escapes with her life, but...the next thing she knows, she's been transported to a distant land and transformed into a little girl! Then, she's picked up and protected by Albert, the emperor of another country rumored to be the "cold-blooded emperor"...

(Source: Jitsugyou no Nihonsha, translated)

title.native: 裏切られた悪徳王女、幼女になって冷血皇帝に拾われる
title.romaji: Uragirareta Akutoku Oujo, Youjo ni Natte Reiketsu Koutei ni Hirowareru

203267.description:
The gourmet king's favorite dish was meat dumplings, but the skin always broke before he could even put it in his mouth, spilling out the delicious juices inside. So he issued a decree: "Whoever can make meat dumplings with a skin that doesn't break will receive 100 pounds of gold." The chefs of the royal court are thrilled, but...?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.romaji: Hoi-san no Fushigi ni Oishii Paozu no Omise

title.native: 裏切られた悪徳王女、幼女になって冷血皇帝に拾われる
title.romaji: Uragirareta Akutoku Oujo, Youjo ni Natte Reiketsu Koutei ni Hirowareru

203269.description:
Emilia remembers her past life as the great saint Emilia, who was overworked by her country and met a brutal end. Desiring to live in peace this life, she resolves to hide her holy powers, but... She's had enough of the evil country! The hectic, heart-pounding slow life of an unaware genius!

(Source: Jitsugyou no Nihonsha, translated)

title.native: 転生聖女は引きこもりスローライフを目指したい！
title.romaji: Tensei Seijo wa Hikikomori Slow Life wo Mezashitai!

203270.description:
Rena, the daughter of a count, remembers her memories from her past life as an aspiring confectioner and realizes that she has been reincarnated as the villainous young lady in the world of an otome game she was obsessed with in her previous life. Her engagement is broken off, and she is abandoned by her family and becomes a commoner, but she opens the sweets shop of her past life's dream on the outskirts of the royal capital, and a second life full of hope begins.

Then, on the first day of opening, a handsome silver-haired young man enters the deserted shop, and an encounter with him changes Rena's life dramatically...

(Source: Jitsugyou no Nihonsha, translated)

title.english: The Sweet Villainess Who Lost Everything and Found a Sweet-Tooth Prince
title.native: 菓子な悪役令嬢は没落後に甘党の王子に絡まれるようになりました
title.romaji: Okashi na Akuyaku Reijou wa Botsurakugo ni Amatou no Ouji ni Karamareru you ni Narimashita

203272.description: Immediately after the ending of the previous work, where each found happiness, a third woman, Marie who looks exactly like the deceased Hisako Tojo suddenly approaches the Tojo family. With her appearance, their relationship shifts slightly. Of course, the discrepancy was due to Marie's plan to enter the Tojo family ...

title.native: 女神たちの二重奏─第Ⅱ楽章─
title.romaji: Megami-tachi no Nijuusou: Dai Ⅱ Gakushou

203273.description:
Ogata Katsumi possesses exceptional psychic powers. Awakened to these powers from a young age, he has solved numerous invisible cases by communicating with unpurified spirits, vengeful spirits, and even gods. While answering spiritual enquiries sent to him by his mother, Ogata Reiko, who is also a psychic, he also serves as a school counselor, lending a helping hand to those in the darkness lurking both inside and outside the school he visits.

A fully-fledged heroic horror story that depicts the terror and emotion of the supernatural!!

(Source: Jitsugyou no Nihonsha, translated)

title.native: 霊能者緒方克巳 SC編

203274.description:
Clarissa, the daughter of the Marquis of Merriam, is told by her fiancé Ryan that she is ugly and should hide her face with bangs. She is scorned in high society and referred to as the "Cinderella." Clarissa feels she has no place in the Marquis household where her stepmother lives, and she lacks self-confidence. But one day, while attending a party with Ryan, she meets a young man. A few days later, for some reason, she is summoned to the royal castle by the first prince, Lucas...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 婚約者に嫌われているようなので離れてみたら、なぜか抗議されました
title.romaji: Konyakusha ni Kirawareteiru You na node Hanaretemitara, Nazeka Kougi Saremashita

203277.description:
Humans and Gods Living Together!

Kinna Nishiharu is a horror writer who, for some reason, has earned a reputation for her work, despite her fearlessness. Feeling stuck in her work, Kina has a fresh start, she moves into a house left vacant after her grandmother passes away, only to be struck by a series of unexplainable phenomena. In fact, the house is a pathway for ghosts and monsters!

The mysterious and heartwarming daily life of a mischievous god and a horror writer who can see things she doesn't want to see begins!

title.native: 消えたくない神様と日日暮らし

203279.description:
This is the story of a half-human, half-mermaid girl.

(Source: Pixiv, translated)

title.native: ゆるくSMやってみる？　 -先輩と後輩の場合-
title.romaji: Yuruku SM Yatte Miru?: Senpai to Kouhai no Baai

203282.description:
A fake marriage could be her Cinderella story…

Alice works as a secretary to the CEO of a major company in New York, but with a seriously ill mother to care for, she can’t even afford to go out for lunch with her coworkers. Realizing her situation, the CEO, Thanos, makes a devilish proposal: a marriage of convenience in exchange for a massive payout. Thanos, a known playboy always surrounded by glamorous women, says he needs to make his personal life look respectable for work reasons. A fake marriage, but a Cinderella story anyone would envy… There is no way Alice can turn it down…

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 赤薔薇は富豪に手折られ
title.romaji: Aka Bara wa Fugou ni Taorare

203284.description:
Isabella lost her parents and raised her younger brother, but it wasn’t easy—she went bankrupt taking care of the two of them and wound up destitute. She was running out of options when Jeremy, a handsome millionaire, reached out to her. He offered to support Isabella financially if she would become his mistress. In desperation, and despite the cold look on his face, Isabella accepted his terms... But when the time comes, will she be able to hold up her end of the deal?

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: 地上の星 21 世紀探偵事務所
title.romaji: Chijou no Hoshi 21 Seiki Tantei Jimusho

203287.description:
Tsugumi is a high school girl who has a complex about her plain appearance and finds it troublesome to be a woman. One day, she suddenly finds that her body can transform into handsome men and beautiful women...!? A sexy, panic-filled romantic comedy!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: イノセント・ブラッド

203289.description:
Set in the vibrant Edo of the Bunka and Bunsei eras, what is the otherworldly (non-human) incident that the popular female impersonator Kagawa Rannosuke encounters? A mysterious detective story.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

203290.description:
Physiotherapist Stephanie has a new job, which turns out to be a request from a millionaire to help his younger brother, who is unable to walk. She never could have guessed that the millionaire is one of her favorite actors—he’s Jordan Simpson! After an accident on the job, he shut himself away behind his dark eyes and in his mansion. Stephanie fights her attraction to him—those thoughts are unprofessional and she must hide them. But that task suddenly becomes a lot harder once Jordan steals a kiss from her!

(Source: Harlequin, translated)

title.english: Jordan St Claire: Dark And Dangerous

203291.description:
The misanthropic scientist Hakase somehow survived the world's destruction with her dependable AI partner, Kumanomi. They are searching for a “treasure” left by her grandfather in a digital sea of data. A lonely yet gentle journey of fleeting encounters.

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

203292.description:
The undefeatable general of the Ye army died tragically of a vicious treachery on the battlefield. Though she was given a second life, she unexpectedly relived as a eunuch, whose life was threatened by a disabled prince on site! Who can tell me why this prince can't help but wish to hug and kiss me all the time? Destiny bound the despised servant and the slighted prince. Together, they shall rewrite their fate.

(Source: WebComics)

203293.description:
There are things that were never meant for humans to know.

In the Year of the Lion, on the twentieth day of the eighth month.
The notorious villainess, Adia Drowers, was publicly executed.
That is the start of the mystery.

As Adia walks onto the gallows for her beheading, she accidentally steps on the foot of Yuniht, the young apprentice executioner.

“Please forgive me. It was unintentional.”

Hearing the apology, Yuniht senses something different about Adia, compared to the usual criminals. Then, in the final moment before the axe fell, she whispers, “A single silver holy flower.”

Deeply unsettled by the final words of this notorious villainess, who was accused to have committed every conceivable atrocity, Yuniht wonders if he should investigate further. But by chance, he learns that someone—without revealing their identity—has already commissioned him to look into her past. Using his unique ability—the power to share the strongest memory of anyone he converses with—Yunicht goes to meet with the people who had been deeply connected to Adia in life, gathering their testimonies.

Eventually, he arrived at a terrifying truth that he wishes he would never have known—.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

203294.description:
Amachi is a pharmaceutical rep who has been working in Germany for two years. Before returning to Japan, he visits a Christmas market to create some memories. There, he sees a handsome man holding a large stuffed toy. As he is Amachi's type, Amachi talks to him and they agree to meet the next day. They go on a date and the guy, Okumura, hits on Amachi directly. They spend a few days together as temporary lovers. But Amachi has a strange feeling. It seems that he already knows him. When Amachi finds out that Okumura is a neurosurgeon, their relationship begins to go awry...

(Source: Takeshobo)

Notes:
- Originally serialized under the title "Sekirara na Hodo Yamashiku (赤裸々なほどやましく)".
- Includes two extra chapters.

title.english: Enveloped by the Fever of Guilt
title.native: やましさの熱に抱かれて

203295.description:
An ordinary girl transmigrates to a fairy-tale-like world filled with children. She becomes the only “grown-up” among the “little people” at a hotel. They are asked to help overcome the crisis at the hotel. But the problem is, the kids here are neither innocent nor happy. Instead, they are full of hostility towards her for some reason.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

203297.description:
After the fall of the Kingdom of Solaris to the Demon King Zermes, a princess and her queen mother are captured and branded with a cursed Pleasure Mark. To protect her daughter, the queen embraces corruption, while the princess loses her last hope. And day by day, both are broken down and forced to submit to the Demon King's pleasure.

(Source: TOPTOON)
synonyms: 淫楽王女ー絶対服従を誓います

203298.description: Lu Miao, a time traveler, is tasked with rescuing a pitiful and unloved villain from a book. She transmigrates to the villain's childhood, only to discover that the young villain is a well-behaved, sensible, and affectionate little devil. However, to outsiders, he appears to be a ruthless and insane tyrant.
synonyms: Bǎ Fǎnpài Yǎng Wāile Zěnme Bàn
What Should I Do if I Raise the Villain Crooked?

203299.description:
Tengoku Yoi, a perfect beauty who excels in both academics and sports, heads to the classroom in anticipation of the start of a brilliant high school life. However, during self-introductions, it's not her cuteness that causes a stir in the room... but the intimidating boy, Onizuka, who declares, "I'm going to be the heroine of this school!"

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title.native: かわいいなんて死んでも言わない！

203301.description:
Takeyama Kurofuto is a new teacher who has come to fill a vacant position at the private Obukure Academy Junior High School. Soon after arriving at the school, which is rumored to be haunted by demons, he is nearly mugged (or extorted) by some nasty students, but a mysterious demon (?) appears to save him...!?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

203303.description:
Somer, the bright young daughter of an oil tycoon, sets off for the Bailiwick of Jersey to see her fiance after a year apart...only to learn he's cheating on her with another woman! Stricken with grief, the heartbroken young woman finds herself drawn to Chase Lorimer, an attractive photographer and experienced lover. On a whim, she steals away to a quiet cove with him...but it leads to a pain she'll never forget. Five years later, a mysterious letter addressed to Somer arrives at the office...from Chase Lorimer. He asks Somer to marry him and says if she refuses, he'll leak compromising photos of her to the press! All Somer can do is wish this nightmare would end as the memories of that horrible day come flooding back...

(Source: Manga Plaza)

203304.description:
With her father in poor health and his company on the verge of bankruptcy, Dione has only one option left-visit multimillionaire Theo Tsardikos to ask for help. But Dione did not anticipate the deal this dangerously charming hotel tycoon would try to strike-he will help her if she agrees to marry him...right now. Dione is stunned, but does she have any other choice? With her father on the brink of a heart attack and his company about to go under, will she hand herself over to Tsardikos?

(Source: Manga Plaza)

203305.description:
Rin, a pure and beautiful girl who devotes herself to kendo, and Kai, a boy with a golden light. The encounter between the two awakens Rin's inner power, which also changes the fate of people. This is an unorthodox coming-of-age story that depicts the troubles that arise from the birth of "people with special abilities."

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

203306.description:
Introducing the genius qigong master Susugi Kagemura! A mysterious incident unfolds surrounding this man, who uses his magnificent techniques to even bring the dead back to life! What will become of him...?!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

203307.description:
Abe Tokiharu, whose ancestor was the great onmyoji Abe no Seimei, is a half-baked onmyoji. He is often compared to his cousin Yasuchika, who is highly trusted at court and nicknamed "Sashikamiko," and is the target of gossip every day. However, with the appearance of Seimei, Tokiharu awakens to his hidden powers, and this is a Heian period horror picture scroll tale that depicts his growth.

(Source: Gakken Plus, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

203308.description:
After years of illness and suffering, Carolyn's mother is going to be remarried...and her husband is secretly having a gorgeous mansion built for her as a present! He asks Carolyn to make sure the interior design goes off without a hitch before the honeymoon is over, but when she hears the name of the architect in charge of the project, her breath catches. It's Bahn Slater, a well-known architect...and the man who broke her mother's heart ten years ago! He was to blame for Carolyn's mother's nervous breakdown in the first place. Carolyn can't let her mother see him, no matter what. There's just one problem... As soon as she lays eyes on Bahn, Carolyn finds herself falling for him!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

203309.description:
The moment their passionate souls come into contact, something happens! Mika's encounter with Hiwatari Satoshi, a detective with a traumatic past, changes her destiny! What will happen to Mika...?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

203310.description:
Beatrice Laplace, a gifted young lady who successfully rebuilt her territory while still in her teens, was falsely accused and scorned as a “nouveau riche daughter,” leading to her engagement being broken off. On top of that, she was burdened with a massive compensation debt and forced into an engagement with the infamous “Pig Duke,” Alphonse Orleau.

However, Alphonse turned out to be nothing like the rumors—he was a true gentleman who even entrusted Beatrice with the reforms of his territory…!?

A success-and-love story of two solitary souls rising from the remote frontier!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.
synonyms: 成金令嬢の幸せな結婚 〜金の亡者と罵られた令嬢は父親に売られて辺境の豚侯爵と幸せになる
The Branded Heiress Sold to the Frontier Pig Duke Finds a Happy Marriage

title.native: 成金令嬢の幸せな結婚 〜金の亡者と罵られた令嬢は父親に売られて辺境の豚侯爵と幸せになる
title.romaji: Narikin Reijou no Shiawase na Kekkon: Kin no Mouja to Nonoshirareta Reijou wa Chichi Oya ni Urarete Henkyou no Buta Koushaku to Shiawase ni Naru

203311.description:
One night at 1 AM, Mana goes to a convenience store and encounters something so terrifying that it makes her miss her boring everyday life. What could have happened...?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

203312.description:
Sarah, who works as a building cleaner, is approached by Ben Gardiner, CEO of a large company on the top floor. He takes her out to dinner at a three-star restaurant to get the opinion of an "ordinary" woman for his product. For the a normal girl like Sarah, it is a dream come true. Ben then asks Sarah to accompany him on a further week-long visit to Milan to give him advice, saying that her opinion will be helpful. Sarah is alone with the famous playboy... And she has her own reasons...

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: Whisked Away by Her Millionaire Boss

title.native: 第126代目 歴代最弱の神託者～楔の誓女～
title.romaji: Dai 126-Daime - Rekidai Saijaku no Shintakusha: Kusabi no Chikai Onna

title.native: 七年越しのプロポーズ
町中華、準備中に人妻は
title.romaji: Machi Chuuka, Junbi-chuu ni Hitozuma wa

203316.description:
After her fiance's betrayal, Hannah goes on an impulsive trip to a Greek resort island, where she meets the most gorgeous man that she has ever seen. Leonidas is a mysterious man with beautiful yet sorrowful eyes that Hannah cannot help but feel allured by... The two share a passionate night together, but Leonadis leaves the next morning with a note telling Hannah to forget anything happened, which is also the moment she realizes that she spent the night with Leonadis Stathakis, one of the most successful billionaires in the world! As heart broken as she is, Hannah tries to move on from her one-night lover, except for one problem... She's pregnant! She tells the baby daddy the news, but Leonadis is devastated to know he made the biggest betrayal to his late wife and son... he tries to atone for it by proposing to Hannah, but promises there will never be love in their marriage...

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.native: 花嫁は金の鳥籠に囚われ
title.romaji: Hanayome wa Kin no Torikago ni Toraware

title.native: 内木小森のひきこもごも生活

203318.description: A collection of bizarre and supernatural ero guro stories.

title.native: マイハートハードピンチ
ガラス工房の錬金術師
ガラス工房の錬金術師

203323.description:
The greatest martial artist on the continent and the supreme Martial Emperor who unified the martial world—Suhyeok. He had achieved everything, yet a lingering emptiness in his heart remained unfulfilled by his yearning for family... In the end, he crossed dimensions using the power of sorcery, but what lay before his eyes was...

"I was in a coma for five years in a hospital!? And what's with this system window floating in front of me!? Black Sage, you big-mouthed bastard! You said you'd send me back to my world! Why the hell is everything so messed up!?"

During the five years he lay unconscious, his family had been struggling to pay his hospital bills... "For my family's sake, I need to make money—fast and a lot of it." The strongest Martial God of the Hwan Continent, Suhyeok! Now Awakened, he begins his journey to level up.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Martial God Who Levels Up
The God of War Is Leveling Up
レベルアップする武神様

203324.description:
What will become of this unwanted reunion?

She never thought she’d ever meet the man who broke her heart eleven years ago again… After Dan broke up with her and her father abandoned her, Molly left her hometown and raised her daughter alone in Seattle. But when she receives news of her father’s death and her mother’s injury, she returns home. When she visits her mother in the hospital, she’s shocked to find out that Dan is her mother’s doctor! Can Molly hide the truth about her daughter from him?

(Source: Harlequin)

title.native: ドクターと秘密のレディ

203325.description:
Baek Hwi-Soo has an embarrassing bedroom secret that has earned him the nickname “Cream Can.” But his uncontrollably big load of vitality is just what the starved incubus, Prince Amon, needs to come out of his century-long hibernation. Motivated by a reward of curing his cancer-stricken cat, Pancake, Hwi-Soo comes to the demon world to offer up all the cream from his can to fill the prince’s sweet tooth!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

203326.description:
A fantastic duo of a political master and a complete novice! I’m Gu Yeongjin, a six-term congressman — the pinnacle of South Korea’s political world, the nation’s hope! One fateful day in 2008, betrayed by my closest aides, I faced a special investigation and chose to end my own life. When I opened my eyes… it was Seoul, 10 years in the past?! Now a ghost, no one can see me or hear my voice. No one... except one person, Cha Jaerim, a 25-year-old Level 9 civil servant. No connections, no money, stuck in miserable circumstances... But look at that ambition, that fire in his eyes... I like it! Fine. I’ll make him my partner.

“You need to go into politics.”

And I’ll get my revenge. A political genius ghost, Gu Yeongjin, teams up with a clueless rookie, Cha Jaerim, for the ultimate combo in

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

203327.description:
Chan-Woo's neighbors are all nervous when a scary wolf named Eun-Jae moves into their villa. Being a friendly big dog, Chan-Woo tries to be a good neighbor to the cold and gruff wolf, even giving him cream puffs from his favorite bakery. But when Eun-Jae goes into heat for the first time, Chan-Woo's about to get stuffed with a different kind of cream for trying too hard to help...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: Hot-to-Go Bakery: How to Tame a Wolf

203328.description:
A billionaire and the daughter of a housekeeper. How could our worlds be any more different?

Eric was born into a rich family, and Sofia, the daughter of their housekeeper, loved him dearly. However, they haven't seen each other in fifteen years, ever since he was sent away to boarding school. Then Sofia unexpectedly appears for an interview at his real estate empire. Sofia is filled with beloved memories of the times they shared together. But will Eric, her first kiss, ever see her as more than a childhood friend?

(Source: Harlequin, translated)

203329.description:
In a ruined world where the dead rise as monsters, Johan survives in the outskirts by baking bread and bartering at the local village. One day, he’s chased by undead monsters back to his home, and he unleashes a blazing fire upon them… only to find two scorchingly hot men alive and well. Calion and Alexis, returned to their human selves, spend their time testing Johan’s limits on curing the undead… and the limits of what he can take into his delicious buns.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

203330.description:
Alice is a forensics investigator working a crime scene when she has an unpleasant run-in with a cowboy named Harley. After crashing into one another outside the hardware store they have a huge quarrel. In a fit of rage, Alice lays this snappy zinger on him: “I wouldn’t buy you from the groom shop even if you were in the bargain bin!” But the next day, her impression of him takes a complete 180. He saves her from a gang of hoodlums, and wins her love with his courage and kindness. So Alice follows her heart...and asks him to marry her!

(Source: Harlequin, translated)

203331.description:
In the near future, severe environmental pollution has led to the extinction of numerous livestock species, plunging humanity into a food crisis. Humanity's only salvation lies in the mutants created by pollution and genetic modification. Some humans began producing milk like livestock, prompting the government to establish a system called the ‘Human Dairy Farm’...

“But... why did I end up like this?”

Eui-Je, who reported the school's obnoxious popular guy, Cassie, as a human cow, somehow finds himself entering that very ranch.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

203332.description:
Lee Hyo-Min, the very embodiment of debauchery, relying solely on his looks to secretly throw parties while his wife is away. One morning, suffering from a hangover as usual, he encounters his new son, Choi Hyuk, for the first time in ages. Just as he marveled at how quickly his child had grown, with this unfamiliar build and expression, Hyo-Min felt strange after drinking the water Hyuk offered him. Only then did Hyo-Min notice the unnatural glint in his son's eyes...

“I bought this because you drink this stuff often.”

“It's only natural for a father to love his son.”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

203333.description:
He’ll give her the money she needs, so long as she pretends to be his lover.

When Virginia asks her boss to lend her money to pay for her father’s debt, she expects him to decline immediately. After all, handsome Marcos Allende is a notoriously heartless business owner. But the gorgeous tycoon easily agrees…and with a shocking condition. She must be his pretend lover! The pair head to Mexico on a business trip, where Virginia must battle her feelings for Marcos while he uses her to make his real lover jealous…

(Source: Harlequin)

203334.description:
Leaf thought he knew what temptation was, but it wasn’t until he saw Camellia for the first time that he understood what it really meant. The entire gang agrees that the young man is a rare beauty—the difference is that they can recognize him for the forbidden fruit he is. Yet, in spite of their warnings to stay clear of their boss’s so-called wife, he finds that he’s no saint. Will an affair with Camellia be his salvation, or will he find that his pleasure came at much too high a cost?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

203335.description: A girl-meets-girl story about an idol and an otaku high school girl who switch bodies.

203336.description:
Victoria was handpicked to be an assistant by the crown prince of the desert kingdom of El Deharia. So then why would the Imperial Guard suddenly break into her room and drag her away wearing nothing but a negligee? Her good-for-nothing father has been in trouble for gambling before, but to think he would have tried to cheat at cards against Prince Kateb... The prince's personality is as fierce as his scarred face. He earned the scars amid a failed kidnapping, during which they say he killed a man. Rejecting palace life, he has been known to disappear to a desert village for months at a time. Victoria despises her father, but can't abandon the promise she made to her dying mother. She pleads with the prince to set him free, and the prince agreed...on one condition. She would become his lover, and join his desert harem!

(Source: Harlequin)

title.english: The Sheik and the Bought Bride
title.native: シークに買われた花嫁

My Heart Hard Pinch: After That

203339.description:
Miao Hanyu is an otaku girl addicted to novels, who is hooked on Hu Haotian, the hero of a fiction, and was eventually dumped by her boyfriend. Her friends said it was because of her craze about this fictional character that her boyfriend broke up with her. When the drunk Miao Hanyu was on her way home, discarding a cell accessory, a boy who looked like Hu Haotian appeared and brought her to the world in the novel.

(Source: WebComics)

synonyms: My Sexual Life With My Boyish Big Sister! Whose hole feels better?

203344.description:
Sexless marriages, domestic violence, child abandonment, gender discrimination... The world is filled with injustice for women. The only thing that can save them from such a world is adultery.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

203345.description:
Komada Tsukasa, a geeky nerd, and Endo Hayato, a good-looking athlete, have been childhood friends. Now in high school, they've become completely estranged, but one day, Tsukasa contacts Hayato on a favor and discovers he's in a surprising place - "Could this really be time travel?" His childhood friend's smartphone, which was sent to a different place in time and space, is still alive and able to communicate. When he receives images and videos, it seems Japan... or rather, could this scenery be "here" from the Sengoku period?! A Sengoku trip graffiti that connects across time!!

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title.native: 電波のとどく時空にいます
title.romaji: Denpa no Todoku Jikuu ni Imasu

title.native: 本当にあった？AVみたいな話
title.romaji: Hontou ni Atta? AV Mitai na Hanashi

203347.description:
Hae-Gyeong, a rabbit shifter, has spent years pining for the golden boy of the neighborhood, Jae-Hyeon. Everyone loves Jae-Hyeon, but Hae-Gyeong wants to be the only one. One impulsive, drunken night, the lines between them blur when Jae-Hyeon crosses the ultimate boundary, leaving Hae-Gyeong more deeply in love than ever. However, the morning after brings a cold reality: Jae-Hyeon is drawing lines again. Now, Hae-gGeong must see if he can finally break through Jae-Hyun’s walls, or if his true love will remain forever out of reach.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.romaji: Dakara Boku wa Uso wo Tsuku

203350.description:
Jin-Seop, a gloomy guy working as an intern at a large corporation. His only hobby is stalking his team's assistant manager, Tae-Young, who seems perfect in every way. One day, while collecting Tae-Young's traces and feeding his delusions, Jin-Seop witnesses Tae-Young engaging in physical lobbying with higher-ups for a promotion. Feeling betrayed by the hidden side of Tae-Young, whom he thought was his own angel, Jin-Seop devises a plan to blackmail Tae-Young and turn him into his dog...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: キック・ザ・バケット：Kick The Bucket

203351.description: Note: Published in COMIC HOTMiLK Koime Vol. 55.

title.native: いたずらされたいアナル妻

203353.description:
Jae-I, who seemed more alpha than anyone else, manifested as an omega. His desire-filled eyes, longing to possess his own omega, fixated on his friend Ian. Having stayed by his side through college, Jae-I one day discovers Ian, who manifested as an omega late in life, being branded by an unwanted partner... From their school days to adulthood and cohabitation, is their meeting—where they become each other's soulmates—atonement, pity, or love?

The story of two male Omegas who can dream happy dreams only when they are together.

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

203354.description: Note: Published in COMIC HOTMiLK Koime Vol. 47.

title.native: すっぽん吸精妻ナツミ

203355.description:
Two years ago, Lee Gyudam abruptly ended his relationship with Shin Myeongjin right before enlisting in the military. When destiny finally brings them face-to-face on their college campus, Myeongjin is eager to reconnect, only to be utterly devastated. Due to a bizarre spiritual affliction, Gyudam is haunted by ghosts and literally cannot recognize his former lover's face.

Reeling from the trauma that his beloved hyung has completely forgotten him, a distracted Myeongjin wanders into traffic and gets hit by a car. Now trapped in a state of out-of-body astral projection, his spirit appears directly before Gyudam, who can see the dead. Refusing to let his tragedy go to waste, Myeongjin desperately clings to his ex, wailing, "How can I pass on to the afterlife without even getting to stick it inside me, hyung?!"

(Source: Lezhin US)

203356.description: Note: Published in COMIC HOTMiLK Koime Vol. 47.

title.native: 人妻の取り扱いにはご注意を
title.romaji: Hitozuma no Toriatsukai ni wa Gochuui wo

203357.description:
“Marry me!”

As children, Pija-Hyun and Do-Woon promised to marry each other. But after hearing from his mother that two men couldn't marry, Pija-Hyun resolved to let go of his feelings for Do-Woon. Years later, while pursuing ordinary relationships, Pija-Hyun kept getting dumped by his girlfriends for strange reasons. He eventually discovered that all his failed romances were due to Do-Woon's sabotage...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

203358.description: Note: Published in COMIC HOTMiLK Koime Vol. 37, 39, 47.

title.native: 義家族は巨根だらけでした
title.romaji: Yoshi Kazoku wa Kyokon Darake deshita

203360.description:
Yoo-Seong loves Skinship, but he can't allow it with his childhood friend. Han-Su has a crush on Yoo-Seong. Will the two be able to cross the line?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title.native: 湯悦秘蕩〜20年目の家族計画〜

203362.description: Note: Published in COMIC HOTMiLK Koime Vol. 55.

203363.description:
A high school student with no hope for the future, Fuyumuro Tanka, travels back in time to Ashikaga Academy, the largest educational institution for "gunbai-shi" (fanners) during the Sengoku period! Control the battlefield with your wits and aim for domination of the world with a single move. A tale of strategic battles where divine calculations and devilish strategies spark off!

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

203364.description:
For some reason, Sae, a serious and ordinary office worker, is being aggressively approached by Touma, a popular young, handsome boxer. Sae is actually happy, but she has a problem that prevents her from responding to his feelings... In fact, Sae is frigid, and has never been able to feel good during sex! When she tells Touma about this, he declares, "I'll make you feel good for sure!" Perhaps with this man...? A love story of healing between an office worker with frigidity and a younger, doggy-like boxer!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 今夜も君にノックアウト ～年下ボクサーに溺愛されてます～
title.romaji: Konya mo Kimi ni Knockout: Toshishita Boxer ni Dekiai Saretemasu

203365.description: The contents of this book consist of colored illustrations, terms, detailed character profiles, popularity polls, special interviews, information on techniques, concept art and information on several characters developments, a Q&A, and 7 new and uncompiled manga chapters

203366.description:
I hate my sister. My perfect sister. I hate my parents. For giving birth to the worthless me. But most of all, I hate myself. Why do I have to live like this?

Tsuki, the older twin, lives in the gloomy shadow of her brilliant sister Haru. Tsuki was hexed with a terrible curse: "Whenever someone touches her, she is overwhelmed with horrific visions." Because of this, with any touch, Tsuki screamed out and thrashed in fear. Only Tsuki could see the hallucinations, so no one understood. Every day was a painful trial. Until Haru got into a serious accident. It should have been a tragedy, but for Tsuki, it was a ray of hope.

"Maybe now I can become like Haru?"

A suspenseful story about changing your life to fight against a terrible fate!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: 同じ顔で私は嘘をつく
title.romaji: Onaji Kao de Watashi wa Uso wo Tsuku

203369.description:
Yuko is a full-time housewife living with her husband. In her stressful days, her only purpose in life is to support her favorite idol, Hoshino-kun. ...But then... one day, news breaks that Hoshino-kun has died from acute stimulant drug poisoning. In despair, Yuko chases after an afterimage of Hoshino-kun and ends up in an accident. When she wakes up, she finds herself in a new world where Hoshino-kun was a child actor...!? A time-traveling love story that begins with the death of her favorite idol!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

やり直し辺境伯夫人の幸福な誤算
