SS×XL〜社長のペットじゃありません！〜

203374.description:
Shim Tae-Woo, who became the lover of a chaebol playboy thanks to his pretty looks and submissive personality, is suddenly kidnapped by someone at a hotel and sent to a butcher shop called "Jangsaeng Livestock". The shop's owner, Gu Ja-Heon, takes in Tae-Woo, caught up in the conspiracy. Tae-Woo accepts this situation and gradually comes to rely on Ja-Heon.

He has no idea whatsoever what purpose his abduction serves.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

203375.description: Ai, a woman in her twenties, has been dumped by her boyfriend because he "doesn't see her as a woman. In an attempt to cheer herself up, she is preparing to enjoy her hobby of "pubbing alone at home". Then she hears a loud noise at her front door. When she looks around fearfully, she finds a man lying on the floor...! This strange encounter brings her closer to an older man who lives in the same apartment complex, who is obviously popular and speaks with a Kansai accent. What will happen to their romantic relationship in the neighborhood?

title.native: おいしい香りは君から

203377.description:
“Those kids aren’t yours.”

Bomi secretly raised Dogyeol’s twins after their toxic arrangement ended. When he returns she lies that they belong to another man. Dogyeol only smirks and holds up their old contract.

“Doesn’t matter. Our contract isn’t over.”

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: Because I Loved You So Much
For Loving You, and Loving You So Deeply

203378.description:
45-year-old mother of twin sons Jeong Suk-Hui X 25-year-old heavy-smoking lesbian queen Min Se-Ra.

Crazy lesbian Min Se-Ra who enjoys promiscuous sex. Drunk Se-Ra spots 45-year-old auntie Jeong Suk-Hui living in the same apartment complex. Jeong Suk-Hui becomes Min Se-Ra's perfect prey...

"Wait for me, my heart!"

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

203379.description:
Eden and Sung-Hyun, sex partners and killers. Unlike Sung-Hyun, who insists only on a plain, emotionless relationship, Eden seems to want something more than just partners...

Can they find a solution in this one-sided relationship?

"Our chemistry is great, isn't it? How about we start dating properly now?"

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

203381.description: Murasaki Yamada's debut one-shot, published in the May 1969 issue of COM.

203382.description:
"I want to listen to my idol's request!"

26-year-old Kasumi works at a convenience store on campus. She has a sexy figure and is rumored to be experienced, but in fact she has no experience. Now that she's a university student, Iwakura-kun, a former child actor who she has been supporting for nine years, appears in front of her!? He has made an unbelievable request of Kasumi to help him prepare for his role...!? An exciting love comedy about increasing your experience with your idol begins!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 推しと、オトナの練習はじめます
title.romaji: Oshi to Otona no Renshuu Hajimemasu

203383.description:
Osaka-born Koume has admired standard-speaking boys since she was a child, and dreamed of a love story in which a standard-speaking boyfriend confesses his love to her in standard Japanese. Realizing that she will never meet the ideal boy in her hometown, Koume finally decides to move to Tokyo upon graduating from high school!

This is a love comedy about the out-of-control adventures of the honest and reckless Koume in Tokyo.

(Source: Cmoa Comics, translated)

203384.description:
Azusa, a university student currently job hunting, is shy and withdrawn, which makes it difficult for her to speak well during interviews, making her job hunt difficult. Today was her interview with her favorite company, but on the way she saw someone who looked unwell and had to help them, causing the interview to end up past the scheduled time. Just as she was about to leave with her shoulders slumped, someone suddenly grabbed her hand, and when she turned around...there was the handsome man she had helped earlier! To her surprise, the handsome man turned out to be the president of the company where Azusa was going to have her interview!?

(Source: Cmoa Comics, translated)

title.native: お義姉ちゃんはオトシごろ

203386.description:
Shiho, who works at a housekeeping service company, is earnest but clumsy, and receives poor reviews from customers. But her new place of employment is... the home of popular idol actor Natsu!? Shiho, unfamiliar with celebrities, doesn't pay it much attention and is determined to do her job well. However, Natsu, who is intrigued by the way Shiho treats him normally, begins to toy with her with his natural looks and sweet, devilish style!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: オフレコメイド〜年下小悪魔アイドルの家政婦はじめました〜
title.romaji: Off the Record Maid: Toshishita Shouakuma Idol no Kaseifu Hajimemashita

203387.description:
At a class reunion, Hisaki, a corporate slave office worker, reunites with her high school best friend Mizuki, who has transformed into a super handsome manicurist. Just as she is genuinely happy to see him again after such a long time, he tells her, "I came to see you." Hisaki is refreshed after getting a massage from her former best friend.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 安良城くんにほぐされてます

203388.description:
Born and raised in a rural town by a family of hitman, Tamamano Chiharu has spent the two years since graduating high school living a quiet, modest life as naturally a hitman herself. No dreams, no boyfriend, and still living with parents; her days are mostly “work” and spending time in the local shopping mall. But her peaceful countryside routine is suddenly shattered when her mother announces, “I’ve found a new man,” and orders Chiharu to move to Tokyo. Thrown from her calm, comfortable rural life into the overwhelming big city, Chiharu must face unfamiliar challenges at every turn. Will she be able to survive the hitman trade in Tokyo and secure the “sparkling city life” she’s been promised?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)
synonyms: A Hitman Girl’s Struggling New Life in Tokyo

title.native: お娘と五十風 - 晴天の巻
title.romaji: Omusume to Gojuu Kaze: Seiten no Maki
Watashi wa Kimi no Kami da yo

203392.description:
45-year-old hairdresser Hanamori Hikaru lives with her recently adopted cat, Mochi. Hikaru hasn't had a romantic relationship in a while, but one day, she meets a man.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

203393.description:
"Five million yen in one night?!"

When Kyoko finds out that her straitlaced best friend Miyu has fallen for a host, she storms the host club alongside her to snap Miyu out of it. With the help of Ryosuke, a nobody host who barely registers, she's going to tear the mask right off these guys, or so she swore... Instead comes sweet, dizzying pleasure and swirling jealousy, and the beginning of hell. A rollercoaster romance based on a true story!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

title.english: I Gave a Host 15 Million Yen. Was I a Fool?
title.native: ホストに1500万貢いだ私ってバカですか？
title.romaji: Hosuto ni 1500-man Mitsuida Watashi tte Baka desu ka?

203394.description:
Kirara is a first-year high school student. One day, after eating a strange crystal, horns start growing on her head! It seems she's been possessed by a dragon...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 親愛なるドラゴンちゃん

203396.description:
Lala is a popular influencer searching for her very own prince charming. She accepts everyone who comes along and dates them, but they never last more than two weeks, and after her 32nd heartbreak, she finally hits rock bottom. She begs her apartment neighbor and only friend, Wataru, for help, but he abandons her. Panicked, Lala decides to join a certain club after receiving a direct message on social media, but...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: まんまるポタジェ～あたらしいシーズン～

203398.description:
Kang Jae-Hui is constantly haunted by the mistakes of his past, mistakes he can neither forget nor abandon. One day, while living a monotonous life as if punishing himself, he is assigned to produce a corporate newsletter project. He is tasked with interviewing Cha Hak-Yun, a reporter for the NSB News Department's Social Affairs Bureau and one of the most talked-about figures of the moment. On the day of the hard-won interview, a series of unpredictable incidents unfolded, from being late to a sudden motorcycle collision. Despite his initially cold and businesslike demeanor, Cha Hak-Yun carefully looked after him, helping him get through the interview safely. But his gratitude was short-lived; he found himself flustered by his persistent follow-up contact...

“I'm not doing it. Dating.”

“Who's going to eat you? Why are you so scared? I'm just saying, let's date a little.”

What should have been a fleeting coincidence had somehow transformed into an inexplicable destiny.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

203399.description:
Gun-Yul, who prides himself on being strong and manly, has been having a hell of a time lately thanks to a subway groper he keeps running into. A groper targeting someone as manly as him?! His disgust lasts only a moment, as he's startled by his own desire for this stranger to touch his secret places even more. But wait a minute—this groper looks familiar...

Isn't that Hye-Yeon, the goddess of our department?!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

203401.description:
From childhood, Heinrich was raised by his father, the emperor, as nothing more than an instrument of the imperial household, subjected to abuse. Such treatment caused Heinrich to become obsessed with Theo, who had shown him even the slightest bit of attention. As an adult, Heinrich succeeded in seizing the emperor's power and commanded Theo to submit beneath his feet...

“I am delighted that Theo is now in my grasp.”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

203402.description:
Seo-Rim is in the process of divorcing her trashy husband. On the day everything, including assets, is neatly settled, her ex-husband suddenly grabs her and begs for a fresh start. As he forcefully pushes her, insisting his affair was just a fling, Tae-Yun—the office idol and her coworker—appears, blocking them and protecting Seo-Rim. X-time goes, BenX comes? Could the young, healthy, and handsome Tae-Yun truly become Seo-Rim's new love?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: 課長、離婚してください

203403.description:
Torn between love and loyalty, May is haunted by betrayal and guilt. On a wedding night that was never meant to be hers, she resolves to flee from the heartache. But Shin So-Gyung, her secret lover and the newlywed groom in a strategic marriage, finds her. Together, they share a night that could be their last.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: ５月の花嫁〜身分を超えた一途な恋〜
ค่ำคืนแรกของรักทรยศ

203405.description:
Lieutenant General Euclid Von Wisteria is a well-known beastman cold and calculated man nick-named the "Bespectacled Ice Lord." Those who are beastmen are known to be devoted to their mates for the rest of their lives. At the same time, Musca has been living in the castle as a servant to the nobility for some time and has been looking for a peaceful life as a normal woman. However, during the festivities ensuing at the end of a long war, Musca has definitely had too much to drink... and finds herself in bed next to the Bespectacled Ice Lord himself!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 獣人たちの溺愛すぎる日常

203406.description: Ayase Ito, who transferred from the city to a local printing company, meets Inukai, a craftsman with a seemingly scary personality. Her heart pounds when she sees him working so enthusiastically! But he doesn't seem interested in romance. She wants to get closer to him, but they can't, and then suddenly, an adult relationship begins. Huh? Am I being misunderstood somehow? All I want is for Inukai to love me!! That's all! What is the love life of an adult girl who wants to feel her heart flutter and be doted on?!

title.native: 犬飼さんに愛されたい

203407.description:
Shiori, 25 years old. Her boyfriend of five years dumped her, saying, "I have no intention of getting married." She was distracted and made a simple mistake at work, which led to her being scolded by her boss. Day after day, things were going wrong, and she had no energy to cook dinner, nor did she feel like buying ready-made meals to eat at home. She happened to be passing by an izakaya, and decided to pop in. The customers were all friendly, and the young manager said he would cook and serve whatever she wanted that day. It was an unexpected treat. But that wasn't the only treat...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

203408.description:
Akio Ikuta is an office lady working at a real estate company. She's been dating her boyfriend for six years and they know exactly when to orgasm during sex. However, it seems he's not ready to give her a spare key just yet. Meanwhile, Akio is fully prepared for a sales presentation for a new apartment building that the company is looking to sell, but she ends up losing to her junior colleague, Hayato Kirishima, a rich kid who got the job through connections and is always late. To top it off, she ends up teaming up with him to support him! A hot love story with a younger, playful guy!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

203409.description:
Shail is a princess with a sincere heart that cares for her country, Jupiter, and the strength to control lightning enough to defeat monsters. For the sake of the alliance, she is to marry Prince Tsina of the neighboring country, Marduk, as a political matter. When Tsina and Shail are engaged, she shakes his hand with a shock of electricity, saying, "I don't want this." However, in reality, he is a cursed prince who was raised in an oppressive environment and unable to use magic well.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: スパダリ花嫁のプリンスメーカー　～虐げられた呪われ王子に触れるのは私だけ…よしよしして育てたら一途に溺愛されました～
title.romaji: Supadari Hanayome no Prince Maker: Shiitagerareta Noroware Ouji ni Fureru no wa Watashi dake… Yoshi Yoshi Shite Sodatetara Ichizu ni Dekiai Saremashita

synonyms: Histories of Drifting in Infinite Sea

203411.description:
"What a wonderful start to your cold-hearted life! This is fine!"

The third princess, Leticia, is to be married off to a neighboring country in a political marriage. In a letter from her fiancé, Alberto, she finds the cold words, "I have no intention of loving you." However, having been oppressed by the queen and her sisters in her own country, Leticia is used to being treated coldly. She was hoping (?) for a quiet life of cold-heartedness, but something seems a bit strange about her husband...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: An edited version of the work that appeared in "Konyaku Haki Saretarisa Renakattari desu ga, Fukou Reijou ni Narimashita.: Zamaashinakute mo Shiawase desu: Anthology Comic" Vol. 2 (婚約破棄されたりされなかったりですが、不幸令嬢になりました。～ざまぁしなくても幸せです～ アンソロジーコミック).

She was reborn into the world of her favorite otome game, but the reincarnated character was a mob character who met a tragic death at the beginning of the game! To avoid death, she decided to raise Reinaldo, the strongest assassin who would eventually lead her to ruin, into a loyal knight from a young age... But when Reinaldo grew up, he showered her with his affection --!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

A spin-off anthology from the wildly popular mountain manga series, which has sold over 2.5 million copies in total, is now available. This non-fiction documentary comic, a collaboration between an extreme challenger and a manga artist, focuses on food in harsh environments! Experience the adventure of pushing yourself to your limits, armed with food appropriate for the environment. Let's go to the extreme!

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

Small strange happenings in everyday life. Sometimes they are frightening, sometimes fantasy, sometimes science fiction-like...

Humans are the scariest thing about us, but they are also the most lovable. A collection of heartwarming short stories set in various eras and spaces.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

203416.description: The story follows a young exorcist who uses smartphone apps to do his job.

203417.description:
Airi and Yoshimi have been undergoing infertility treatment for five years since they got married. They have poured in over 8 million yen. But it didn't work. They lived in a rundown apartment with a rent of 30,000 yen, cutting back on everything and devoting everything to having a child, but they had reached their limit in pursuing their dream. "We did well. We kept telling ourselves that this was the hardest time. It was so hard." And so their long-cherished dream was shattered. When they stopped trying to conceive, which they had devoted most of their lives to, what awaited them every day? A new drama about a couple torn between despair and longing!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

As if fated by a cruel joke, Hee-Su is forced to co-star with Do-Hyun in a new reality show called, "Going To Bed With Your Hater." With the cameras rolling, Do-Hyun's aggressive advances feel all too real, and Hee-Su's pure hatred begins to melt into a dangerously sizzling passion. Can she resist the enemy she's accidentally falling in love with?

(Source: Tappytoon)

203425.description:
Arsinoe knows a few things about redos. Her first three lives all followed the same tragic script: born the scorned daughter of an enslaved queen, married to a crown prince as charming as he is cruel, and driven to death by the very man she trusted. But in her fourth, Arsinoe refuses to play the doomed princess. Determined to claim her own destiny, she forms an unexpected alliance with Walter Heibergh, the kingdom’s most formidable commander — one powerful enough to change fate itself.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Dawn That Twists Your Neck

203426.description:
An ordinary woman who once dreamed of the Martial World awakens as Dang Sohye, a lowly handmaiden serving the Sacheon Dang Clan, a house notorious for its poison techniques. She thinks she’s possessed a doomed extra, but this body is anything but ordinary. As the clan’s fearsome grand elder takes her in and a young swordsman from the Namgung clan notices her, she’s swept into a deadly power struggle. Can she master the Dang Clan’s techniques and survive the schemes closing in from within?

(Source: Tapas)

“Don't flaunt your money in Yeo-Su, don't boast about your connections in Suncheon, and don't show off your fists in Beolgyo.” There's an old saying like that...

Hyun Woo-Yong, an 18-year-old high schooler who brazenly flaunted his fists in Beolgyo. After serving two years at the Cham Bit Juvenile Correctional Facility, he returned to high school at age 21. He tried desperately to graduate like any ordinary student, but... But in this place where school violence runs rampant and injustice abounds, his patience reaches its limit and explodes.

The extraordinary past of ‘Shark’ Season 2's villain, Hyun Woo-Yong, is revealed.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Kou is a lively fifth-grade elementary school girl who tends to act before she thinks.

She's so energetic that during a fight with her classmate, Taira, she accidentally breaks the stone that seals the shrine's vengeful spirit...! The vengeful spirit has taken over Taira's body and escaped, so Kou, along with Sanbi, a messenger from the gods, teams up with historical figures like Murasaki Shikibu, Sakamoto Ryoma, and Himiko to stop the evil deeds of the vengeful spirit!!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

203435.description:
Despite the sound of skin tearing and bones breaking, Despite fresh wounds etched over unhealed scars, Seon-Woo, who had been focused solely on knocking out the thugs, Only lowered his fists once the warehouse fell silent. Hellish days he couldn't endure without fighting. As he buried his unresolved frustration and prepared to leave, someone grabbed Seon-Woo's departing foot.

“Hyung, can you take me with you?”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

203437.description:
Late at night in a secluded park, Ha Do-eon and Ahn Sae-Byeok move through an intimacy so natural it feels almost unreal. To anyone watching, they are the picture of a flawless couple: effortless, synchronized, complete. But their story didn’t begin there. Three years earlier, a chance encounter drew them together, setting the stage for a relationship that only seems perfect on the surface…

(Source: Lezhin US)

203438.description:
To the rest of the world, Ju Ha-Ram is the picture of innocence and grace, yet his nights tell a different story. From the vantage point of a stalker, Ha-Ram's modest reputation is a curated lie as he brings a revolving door of men back to his bed. Lost in a world of feverish fantasies, the observer has spent months imagining being the one selected for the night. The line between reality and obsession finally blurs when Ha-Ram makes his move, inviting his shadow into the very home he has been haunting for a year.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 果実～悪魔へ捧げる生贄～

203439.description:
Kang Min-Woo suffers amnesia after a car accident. Three men approach him... Each of them claims, "I'm your real boyfriend!" With three boyfriends in an instant, Min-Woo begins a physical dialogue to find the "real" one.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Oh no! I've lost my reason to live! Sawayama An is a high school girl who devotes herself to her idol... but then her idol suddenly goes on hiatus! Deep in despair, An slips off a bank into a river on her way to school! She wakes up to find herself surrounded by unfamiliar bushes. As she stumbles along, she's confronted by men holding guns, dressed like they're from a period drama! Is this the filming of a new drama?! The carefree An is rescued by a handsome young warrior on horseback...! Who is this guy?! I can totally support him! This overly optimistic high school girl finds her favorite idol in the Sengoku period!

203453.description:
Xiu Xian died and, upon waking up, found himself transmigrated into the body of a cowardly illegitimate son from a cultivation family. Without spiritual roots, he couldn’t cultivate, and the head of the family despised him. Almost anyone in the household could easily humiliate him. However, he acquired a “Female Disciples’ Leisure System.” As long as his female disciples cultivated various leisure skills like cooking, painting, blacksmithing, weaving, and construction, Xiu Xian would gain experience points. As the disciples improved their skills, they could even develop all sorts of incredible cultivation techniques—like eating food to restore health bars…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

203460.description:
It was pure coincidence. Nakajo Yumi was looking for a place to move to and came across this old apartment. But there she found someone she never expected: Nagao-senpai, the man she had always admired since high school! And the apartment she was shown to was right next door to his! Yumi, who had always been a shy junior, blurted out, "I want to live here!" without even looking inside. But Yumi, who thought, "I can't let a tiny person like me get in the way of my senior," became so shy she went off in the wrong direction...!? From a complicated, pure love that spirals out of control!? Will the love between the reunited neighbors really come to fruition?!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: 曇り空のピクニックで君とキスしたかった

203463.description:
Tomoki works as a real estate agent in a small provincial town. He finds meaning in his otherwise dull daily life finds by supporting Sui, a member of the popular boy group RAYZ! He was actually once high school classmates with Sui — his first love. But six months ago, the group suddenly disbanded, and Sui vanished without a trace. Where could he be? What could he be doing? Tomoki was wondering, when Sui himself shows up looking for a place to live!? A former idol mysteriously returns to his hometown, to find a devoted fan and former classmate who still holds feelings for him.

(Source: Overlap, translated)

title.native: スパークル・アンコール

203464.description:
He was originally a rich second generation of a local tyrant. Unfortunately, he was deprived of all the possessions and driven out of the family due to his father's disappearance, leaving him nothing but a small supermarket. However, it's this supermarket that connects another world and makes him a business tycoon in both worlds! Chew gum can be exchanged for celestial pills! Orders are coming nonstop! Perfume can be exchanged for the constitution-reinforcing liquid. Strengthen your body and defeat villains with just one punch! What? You want a Qilin beast from the Eastern Fairy World for riding? No problem, as long as you have enough money to pay. What? You want the iridescent clothes of the fairy? Sure, downpayment first and then I'll go talk to the fairy. As long as you have the money, I'll get you what you want. I'm the only supplier of the other worlds!

(Source: WebComics)

203465.description:
The devil’s soul comes into a pathetic young man’s body, making the young man have two souls in one body! With the devil’s soul, nobody is a match for him! With a man’s soul, he can’t defeat anyone… Let’s see how Li Yulan embarks on his journey of recasting heaven and earth step by step with the coexistence of two souls!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Don't Bother Me From Immortal Cultivation
Don't Disturb: This Is My Cultivation Time

203466.description:
Hong-Ryeol gets falsely accused and becomes a loner. One day, he gets to download a mysterious hypnosis app that lets him take revenge on the girls that looked down on him.

I'll fuck all of you who looked down on me."

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)

title.native: 死にたくない僕の中出しハーレム

203468.description:
After her boyfriend unilaterally dumped her, telling her to break up with him because he'd found a new lover, Rika was drinking away her sorrows at her favorite bar. As she continued to drink, she ended up inviting the handsome Kunieda, who happened to be sitting next to her, to spend the night with her, and made a mistake... The next morning, feeling a little awkward, she headed to work, thinking positively that she would only have to meet him at the bar again, only to find Kunieda there! And the president himself...?! Thinking back on last night's blunder and feeling in danger of being fired, Rika begged him, "I'll do anything, just don't tell anyone!" But what condition did Kunieda present to her?!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: スパダリ社長と偽装恋愛

203469.description:
After getting drunk at a company party, Fumi is given a ride home by her favorite senior, Shirota, on his back. He invites her back to his room... a fait accompli, huh?! Just as Fumi is daydreaming about something naughty, all she sees is a burning apartment building! What?! Why is my house on fire?! Having lost her place to live, Fumi manages to force her way into Shirota's apartment. However, the extremely strict Shirota not only makes a move on her, but tries to kick her out...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

203470.description:
The rumored series that "will make you fashionable just by reading it" has finally been made into a comic! Rio and Mio are twins who adore RONI. Rio dreams of becoming a model, while Mio dreams of becoming a designer. To make their dreams come true, Rio becomes a catalog model for RONI, and Mio begins studying design at RONI. Eventually, Rio is scouted by an entertainment agency, and the clothes Mio designs become actual products! Things don't always go as planned, but if the two work together...?!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

203471.description:
Born at the bottom of society, Jake survives by leading Sabertooth, a mercenary group loyal to him. Yet he is ultimately betrayed and killed by the nobles he served. But instead of death, he awakens to a new life with soft, frail hands and the title of the third son of House Valdek, the most powerful family in the empire, rivaling even the crown. Surrounded by wealth and splendor, Jake realizes he has been granted a second chance to fulfill his ambition. So he sets off, determined to rise as high as possible. Look out, world, here comes Lucian Valdek!

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: Reincarnated as the Archduke’s Third Son
轉生為大公家的三兒子
บุตรคนที่สามของแกรนด์ดยุก
Reencarné como el tercer hijo del gran duque

title.english: Reincarnated as the Grand Duke’s Third Son

203474.description:
Tora has taken over the perfume shop run by her late parents and lives with her beloved younger brother. While handing out scented smudges in front of the store, a shabbily dressed young man smells them and suddenly bursts into tears. Wondering what's going on, she asks him what he's saying, and it turns out he's been wandering around with amnesia. Believing that scent and memory are linked, Tora proposes that they work together to help revive his memories...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

203475.description:
A thrilling love story of living together! Yuusa, a high school girl who is devoted to supporting the popular young actor Shuri, ends up living with an acquaintance of her stepfather due to family circumstances. To her surprise, her idol shows up! Embarrassed and reluctant to reveal Shuri's true nature, Yuusa wants to avoid being found out as an otaku, but the airheaded Shuri unconsciously approaches her!?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

For over four years, Shayla has served as the personal maid to Judith, the troublesome youngest daughter of the prestigious Kalley Count Family. Her predictable routine is completely upended when the heir to the estate, the eldest young master Cedric, returns home. Taking charge of his sister's chaotic education, he approaches Shayla with a shocking and archaic proposal: to become Judith's "whipping maid," absorbing the physical punishments earned by the lady.

"The duration will be three months. For your services, you will receive an additional salary equal to your current maid's wages."

The offer of a double salary is too tempting to refuse; it means reaching her secretly guarded financial goal much faster. Greed overcomes her hesitation, and she accepts the contract. However, reality hits her brutally during their very first session when Cedric commands coldly: "Lean against the fireplace and bare your backside." Only then does Shayla realize her grave mistake. She hadn't accepted a lucrative job, she had walked straight into his carefully laid trap.

(Source: Lezhin US)

While she is confused and distressed, her husband is ecstatic. He sees it as the perfect chance to get revenge on her for what she did to him. But as he spends more and more time with his wife, his will for revenge is slowly eroded, revealing a deep sorrow that he's carried with him the entire time...

His strength comes solely from endlessly honing his swordsmanship and martial arts using the only spirit he can contract – a micro-spirit. In reality, he's always fighting desperately just to stay alive...!?

Amidst all this, he gets chosen as a member to explore the highly dangerous "Lunar Ruins"...!?

The Spirit Mage who everyone thinks is hiding his true power actually always fights with everything he's got. He's not refusing to summon his Contracted Spirits, he just doesn't have any!—this Spirit Mage is still too strong!?

A fantasy of misunderstood overpowered heroism, surpassing even the strongest through effort alone!

203599.description:
Conquer the Japanese Derby!
12 furlongs―a 2,400-meter journey that has created numerous histories in horse racing and captivated people. A man is reincarnated―as a racehorse from a small local farm. His name is Satan Marukko. A chestnut-colored Thoroughbred with a distinctive round white star on his forehead. After consecutive victories in local horse races, trainer Kozumi Nada convinces the owner, Nakagawa, to enter him in central horse racing. "Marukko is a horse who will win the Derby." Having accumulated prize money, Marukko secures a ticket to the Japanese Derby. Riding him is veteran jockey Tomonori Tatekawa, a rider who has won numerous Group 1 races, but who carries the jinx of never having won the Japanese Derby―. "And now, the Japanese Derby, enter the main racecourse." And so, the fanfare sounds, and the gate to determine the generation's top horse opens. Welcome to a world swirling with money, pride, honor, and determination.

This is a passionate horse racing story about a man who became a racehorse and the people who are fascinated by this seemingly absurd horse.

Yet as the two spend more time together, Raphael slowly warms to Julius, and their instincts pull them together in a way neither of them expected!

6. Mienai Kizuna (見えないキズナ) [Maki Sugawa]

title.native: お憑きあいしませんか

203639.description:
Marina Adelaide, the daughter of an earl, is living a NEET life after an unfounded scandal is spread about her. Then she suddenly receives the tragic news that the ship her parents were on has gone missing! Although she has a younger brother, he is young and sickly, and if things continue as they are, the Adelaide family will be taken over by the evil Marquis of Lanas. In order to protect her family, she becomes engaged to a stranger, a civil servant named List, but will she be able to stand up to the Marquis's conspiracy? The curtains are now open on a miraculous romance!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 伯爵家を守るためにとりあえず婚約しました　ニートの令嬢は醜聞をはらし意地悪な侯爵家に対抗するためいちかばちかの婚約を決断する
title.romaji: Hakushaku-ke wo Mamoru Tame ni Toriaezu Konyakushimashita Neet no Reijou wa Shuubun wo Harashi Ijiwaru na Koushaku-ke ni Taikou suru Tame Ichikabachika no Konyaku wo Ketsuden suru

203640.description:
Hidden within the brilliance of gemstones are mysterious stories you may not know about. Hinatako works at a jewelry specialty store in Ginza. Every day, customers come to the store bringing in gemstones with mysterious secrets. While working with appraiser Teruya to appraise the gems, the unknown stories of the gems are revealed...

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 宝石物語　ジェム ストーリーズ

203641.description:
"Who should I love, my boyfriend or my best friend's boyfriend?"

Mana, a third-year high school student, is dating her classmate and honor student, Eira. One day, her beautiful and rich friend, Aimi, comes to her for advice, saying that she is troubled by her boyfriend Ren's cheating habit. To teach Ren a lesson, she suggests that they exchange boyfriends for just one day... But what is the true nature of her best friend, Aimi, that emerges from exchanging boyfriends?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: お嬢様、本日のメニューです

203643.description:
China is an ordinary high school student who loves books. One day, the idol group Link shows up at China's school for the filming of a drama. By chance, China meets Kanata from Link on the rooftop. She is touched by Kanata's hard work, his unexpected laughter, and the kindness with which he treats Chinana like a girl, and becomes increasingly attracted to him... But the other members and staff of Link are not happy about the two of them getting closer...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Notes:
- Includes one extra chapter.
- Includes the one-shot "Hanamaru Renairon (ハナマル恋愛論)".

title.native: まんが家さんになれるまんが

203646.description:
1. Mayonaka Nouchakai (真夜中のお茶会)
2. 7-shoku Matchi no Shoujo (7色マッチの少女)
3. Yoru ga Kuruhi (夜がくる日)
4. Kyoumi: Hasami (挟身－ハサミ－)
5. Hime no Hitsugi (姫の棺)
6. Bijin no Yu (美人の湯)

title.native: 富美菊さんのお気に入り

203650.description:
High school sweethearts Akiharu and Teru were as happy as could be. However, those happy days did not last for very long. Teru, who was aiming to become a professional soccer player, had an unexpected accident one day… After losing out on his soccer career, Teru began to grow sullen and mean, almost like he'd become another person, and finally the damage spread to Akiharu, too… "I'm telling you to go sleep with another guy!" Following that order from his beloved boyfriend Teru, Akiharu smothered the pain in his heart and set out for a gay bar…

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Yoake wa Kimi no Te de

203652.description:
This manager's sexiness aura is off the charts…!

Takuma Fujikawa, a university student and model, receives an opportunity to release a photobook! Suddenly, in front of him appears a super charismatic man overflowing with mature sex appeal. This man is Chiaki Kuga, Takuma's new manager. After being told that success is pretty much guaranteed in Chiaki's hands, Takuma agrees to learn what an adult's sex appeal is from Chiaki. "Keep your eyes on me", Chiaki's words and actions leave Takuma defenseless…! "I can't believe my smooth-sailing life turned into one that yearns for another man after a few lessons…!"

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title.english: Infatuated Sex Management: Penetrated by a Wicked Schemer!?
title.native: 溺愛セックスマネジメント～腹黒男にハメられる!?
title.romaji: Dekiai Sex Management: Haraguro Otoko ni Hamerareru!?

203653.description:
One day, Hane, an office worker, pays a visit to a high-class gallery space. There, he meets Takakura, the gallery manager. The two of them hit it off immediately! With his angelic features, one would never expect that Hane is actually a fan of the artist Fujii, famed for his salacious artworks. Takakura finds himself drawn to Hane's indescribable charm, so much so that they meet every weekend for drinks. However, everything changes when it turns out that Hane actually has quite the extraordinary relationship with Fujii, that favored artist of his...!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: He's Mr. Takakura's Most Prized Piece
title.native: 高倉さんのお気に入り

203654.description:
Nyan Warrior Vesta has been fighting solo to save citizens from people bitten by bad dogs. Until an unexpected potential partner appears: the standoffish guy who sits beside her in class!?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

203655.description:
Having turned 30, Hiro and his former classmates return to their old middle school to dig up time capsules they had left behind. Hiro finds shocking words from his past self inside his box...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: If Your Dreams Didn't Come True, Die

203656.description:
Office worker Hiroto feels happy with his mundane daily life. One day, as he returns home, he is confronted by his university junior, popular young actor Hanazawa Yuu. During his university days, Hiroto gave up on acting, and Yuu begs him to "try acting again." Hiroto treats Yuu coldly, but as they spend time together, he begins to see the gap between his selfish and free-spirited side...?

(Source: Libre, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
203656.hashtag: #お前なんかにときめかない
synonyms: I'd Never Fall for Someone Like You

title.native: お前なんかにときめかない

203657.description:
Due to past trauma, Yanai is a high school boy who has difficulty expressing his emotions. One day, as he searches for ways to change himself, he finds out that his classmate Hasugaya's family runs a chiropractic clinic that relieves emotional stiffness. After begging Hasugaya, who is reluctant to bother, to give him a treatment, Yanai is able to cry for the first time in years, but... before his very eyes is Hasugaya's ecstatic expression!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Hasugaya-kun Likes to Make People Cry

title.native: 泣かせたがりの蓮ヶ谷くん

synonyms: This love is still inside me

title.romaji: Mada Boku no Naka ni Ite

203660.description:
Notes:
- Originally serialized in 4 issues of Ribon, it was re-published in full in Ribon Deluxe 1976 Autumn issue.
- Includes the one-shot "Horohoro Hana no Chiru Naka de".
synonyms: Horohoro Hana no Chiru Naka de

title.native: なっちゃんの初恋 太刀掛秀子傑作集 2
title.romaji: Nacchan no Hatsukoi - Tachikake Hideko Kessakushuu 2

203662.description: First published in Ribon 1975/01 issue, it was republished in Ribon Deluxe 1976 Autumn issue.

title.native: ミルキーウェイ 太刀掛秀子傑作集 3

203665.description:
The strongest dragon in the world? …Sigh, looks like it’s my turn to step in” — Just an ordinary case of a second-year middle school syndrome, joining the fray.

Imagine a story where the most powerful beings, who don’t want to stand out, wish for a peaceful life, or have reasons to conceal their true capabilities, secretly save people from significant threats by unleashing their hidden powers now and then.

For example, what if the protagonist of such a story actually had no real power at all?

In front of upper-class students who torment the weak, in the presence of a princess being chased by assassins, and facing the world’s strongest dragon attacking the academy…

What if, in such dire situations, a magic student who only pretends to be concealing his true abilities, who in reality possesses only C-rank strength, appears?

This is the story of a C-rank magic student, who indulges in the illusion of having hidden powers, acting as if he has more strength than he truly does.

title.native: 自分をSSS級だと思い込んでいるC級魔術学生
title.romaji: Jibun wo SSS-kyuu da to Omoi Kondeiru C-kyuu Majutsu Gakusei

203667.description:
If you make the wrong choice, you will die instantly! The worst Otome game ever with death is about to begin!

One day, the protagonist receives an email from her former best friend saying, “I finished developing the game we used to make together, and I’d like for you to play it.” However, the day after playing the game, she wakes up and finds herself as “Diana,” the villainess of the game! Moreover, she has entered the “extra mode,” in which Diana is the heroine! In this mode, her favorability with the male characters starts in the negatives, all of them seem to resent Diana.

Can Diana survive this game of death?

203670.description:
Renas, the "Mighty Hero," defeated the Demon Lord but was left on the verge of death due to a deadly poison. To save his life, he was placed into a frozen sleep for a century until a cure could be created. During that time, the one who waited faithfully for him was his wife and fellow party member, Fina the elf! Finally reunited, the couple set off on a honeymoon across a world where they are now hailed as "Legends"!

They hid their true identities to enjoy more time together uninterrupted, but trouble seems to break out wherever they go! Unable to ignore those in need, the former hero and his wife begin a journey to correct the world's wrongs while flirting nonstop!
synonyms: Starting an Eternal Journey with My Elf Wife: The Legendary Hero Travels the World He Saved 100 Years Ago with His Beloved Elf

title.native: エルフ妻と始める悠久の旅〜伝説の勇者、愛するエルフと共に100年前に救った世界を旅する〜
title.romaji: Elf Tsuma to Hajimeru Yuukyuu no Tabi: Densetsu no Yuusha, Aisuru Elf to Tomoni 100-nen Mae ni Sukutta Sekai wo Tabisuru

203671.description:
In 2019, as Japan transitioned from the Heisei era to Reiwa, a hidden chapter unfolded on Sarubotoke, a secluded island in the Seto Inland Sea. This island has long thrived as a secret haven for prostitution, overseen since the Showa era by the powerful Futatsuguri family.

Meanwhile, four strange individuals have emerged from the shadows of society, drawn to the island for mysterious reasons.

Embedded within both the island’s ruling family and these newcomers are sorcerers who practice an undetectable form of murder: the art of killing with curses.

As dark ambitions and human plots weave together on this island of vice, an even darker force broods beneath the surface—a sinister curse that has haunted Sarubotoke Island for nearly seven decades, a legacy of the island’s war-ridden past.

203672.description:
I might be his wife in name only, but I want to stay by the doctor's side.

She's engaged to the surgeon of everyone's dreams despite the fact that they never dated! Miori, a new nurse, attended her hospital's get-together and ended up falling into a contract engagement with Dr. Mayuzumi, a surgeon she secretly harbored a crush on. He admitted that he was going to end up being embroiled in the hospital's power struggle because he was single. Miori wanted to support him in his feelings for caring more about saving as many patients as he could over hospital politics, but she turned down his proposal. Even so, he took an indirect approach and ended up making their engagement a reality! They were supposed to be a temporary married couple, but between his thoughtfulness and their gradually growing closeness, Miori was bewildered but also couldn't stop her racing heart...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.native: 旦那様はエリート外科医～かりそめ夫婦なのに溺愛されてます～
title.romaji: Danna-sama wa Elite Gekai: Karisome Fuufu nanoni Dekiai Saretemasu

title.native: 絶界ディストラクション

203674.description:
Shi-chan grew up surrounded by her parents' love and the warm care of the neighbors around her. Her dining table is always full of wonderful meals— curry rice, scorched rice, monkfish hotpot, yakitori, and more. It all tastes even better when it's shared with family. Come enjoy this warm, comforting book at your own table.

(Source: emaqi)

title.native: しーちゃんのごちそう

203675.description:
Jake Reed, the right-hand man of the First Prince and the object of every woman's admiration, was fed up with the haughty daughters of the nobility. He was constantly targeted by the lustful young ladies, and it eventually escalated to the point where he was drugged with an aphrodisiac. Then, one day, a woman came to the Marquis Reed household.

"I can't take it anymore... I'm going to tell them straight away!"

Jake was furious, but the mysterious woman, Sarah, approached him with a smile.

"Husband, let's get a divorce!"

Jake was stunned, but gradually memories of the past began to return...

(Source: SORAJIMA, translated)
synonyms: You Promised to Divorce Me After 10 Years, Right Dear?

title.native: 旦那様、10年で離婚する約束でしたよね？
title.romaji: Danna-sama, 10-nen de Rikonsuru Yakusoku Deshita yo ne?

203676.description:
Boys' school x cross-dressing x school battle!

Sakamoto Haruchika is a first-year high school student who transfers to Masurao Academy, a school for training martial artists. He has a secret - he gets pleasure from using violence! Haruchika wants to live a peaceful life, but the hot-blooded students of Masurao Academy keep challenging him to the school's famous "duel" one after another!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

203677.description:
Chie was involved in a traffic accident, losing both her parents and suffering serious injuries herself. She was taken by Nobuyuki, the doctor at the hospital where she was treated for the accident, and they fell in love and married. They were meant to live happily together, raising their child, Ohto, but after giving birth, she was told she had only a short time left to live, and he asked for a divorce and forced her to give up custody. However, it was all a clever trap set up by Nobuyuki to have Chie act as a surrogate mother, and then get rid of her when she was no longer needed. Chie was saved at the last moment by the doctor, Toru, and faked her own death, escaping Nobuyuki's control. Three years later, with a new face and name, she infiltrates the Saigawa household under the guise of a housekeeper. Is it all to get her child back?

(Source: SORAJIMA, translated)

203678.description:
Cover illustration: Nao Maita

2. Satsujin Yuugi (殺人遊技) [Mako Fukunaga]
3. Imouto (妹) [Ryouko Mizoguchi]
4. Kesaranpasaran (ケセランパサラン) [Kirara Himekawa]
5. ×× Mura e Youkoso (××村へようこそ) [Isao Sakamoto]
6. Shi no One Click (死のワンクリック) [Mea Sakisaka]

203679.description:
Eunchae is a perfectly ordinary college girl who has a loving high school sweetheart as her boyfriend. But who would have known running into her boyfriend’s father would lead to this?

(Source: Lezhin US)

203680.description:
The protagonist is Ouji, a 44-year-old unmarried man who lives at his own pace. One day, Ouji barges into the apartment next door to try to stop a fight between the couple living next door, and meets Kiri, a woman his age who has also barged in... With the arrival of Aoi, a 32-year-old mentally unstable girl, Ouji's life reaches a turning point.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

203681.description:
Minami is a high school girl who hates rich people, but her dream is to become even richer than them. But Takahiro, whom Minami meets at her part-time job, is actually...!?

A collection of exquisite works.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

203683.description:
Takuro, a father whose hobby is collecting toys, is presented with divorce papers by his wife Keiko... In order to win back his beloved wife, he decides to become a video streamer, making use of his hobby... What will happen to the family of four...?

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

title.native: ガングライフ～オレとオモチャと家族と離婚～
title.romaji: Gang Life: Ore to Omocha to Kazoku to Rikon

203684.description:
Makiko is a former delinquent. She is so strong that she has never lost a fight. However, upon graduating from junior high school, she quit, saying she wanted a normal relationship. She dyes her hair black again and tries to become a cute girl, but she just can't find a boyfriend. Then, when she is being harassed by a man trying to pick her up, she falls in love at first sight with Hashimoto-kun...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: バイオレンスなパートナー

203685.description:
The protagonist, Yusuke Minami, is a kind-hearted office worker who "can't say no" when asked. He is always busy answering requests from colleagues and clients. But his joy is bento sake. When he eats his bento and drinks, he forgets everything and feels a sense of freedom in his whole body. And then, from time to time, he remembers a certain woman...

A delicious food story with a mysterious side.

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

203686.description:
1. Ghost Hunt☆Darling (ゴーストハント☆ダーリン) [Tomoko Nishimura]
2. Gakkou no Nana Fushigi★Tours (学校の七不思議★ツアーズ) [Michiru Aoi]
3. Noro Wakashi ko Yuurei Gakari (野呂井小ゆうれい係) [Junko Kagari]
4. Watari Rouka-chan (渡りろうかちゃん) [Pochi Kashiwa]
5. Anata wa Watashi (あなたは私) [Junko Nose]
6. Yami no Hohoemi (闇の微笑み) [Eri Kumaki]
7. Inui-san (イヌイさんッ！) [Chako Tsukisuzu]
8. Horror ga Kita (ホラーがキターー！！) [Minori Katou]

203687.description:
The unparalleled girl Liang Xi is the illegitimate daughter of an important official. The official takes Liang Xi back to the residence after the death of his wife. The elder daughter Yu Yan is jealous of Liang Xi's beauty and talents and orders her subordinates to sell Liang Xi to the brothel. But fortunately, she was rescued. Yu Yan is even more jealous of her and plots to get rid of Liang Xi. It is a gorgeous court story, in the Forbidden City filled with schemes and plots, love and miracles surge…

(Source: INKR)

203688.description: Note: Includes the one-shot "Otona Nikki (おとな日記)".

203689.description:
In order to find out her identity, the 19-year-old Yu Liang does her best to get into the GMS Company and works hard to become a temporary assistant to the mysterious character He Yan. She does not expect her boss to be not only sloppy but dangerous, and also someone she never wants to see again in her life.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

203690.description:
Flora traveled through spacetime with a heart attack into the Comic World. When she woke up, she found her icon, Edmund lying on top of her!! “Hey! Get out!”

(Source: WebComics)

203691.description:
A cute and heartwarming story about catboys, dogboys and a girl's daily struggles with her pets.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: You're So Noisy! Please Give Me a Peace of Mind

title.romaji: Bie Nao! Wo Xiang Jing Jing.....

203692.description:
This novel absolutely does not bully the protagonist—the system is just a tool!

After transmigrating into a xuanhuan world, Su Changge becomes the master of the future Female Emperor—right before her infamous descent into darkness. His once-abused little disciple suddenly notices something strange: her master has grown gentle, incredibly powerful, and increasingly soft-hearted beneath his stern words…

Su Changge: “You damn system—I refuse to be a despicable villain!”
System: “Born to be trash, destined to be the antagonist!”

Feng Wanqing: “I’ve fallen for my own master… What should I do? I’m going to have a sweet, earth-shattering romance with him—no matter what!”

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: Fantasy: My Disciple of the Empress Wants to Be Blackened
My Empress Apprentice Is Becoming Evil
My Empress Apprentice Wants to Turn Dark

title.native: 玄幻：我的女帝徒弟要黑化
title.romaji: Xuanhuan: Wo de Nüdi Tudi Yao Heihua

203693.description:
An ordinary girl suddenly receives an invitation to join the most popular band! While falling into dangerous traps and being hurt by conspiracies, she also meets a goup of beautiful music spirits, a race of mythical creatures! And one of them looks so charming and gorgeous~

(Source: Webnovel)

203694.description:
Ye Feng, a young man who lived in seclusion, was unexpectedly thrust into a strange world. A familiar and warm voice startled him up, but he was in the arms of a strange girl named QingWu. Thenceforth, he started a new chapter in his life by entering the world of "Ming"!

(Source: INKR)

203695.description:
Lei Ke is a noodle shop delivery boy, but when there's trouble, he helps the weak in secret. His deeds were exposed by a smart university student, so he agrees to help him fight against evil. With a group of people with martial arts prowess, Lei Ke takes down those with dark intentions!

(Source: INKR)

203696.description:
Yun Ge meets a boy in the desert, and they promised to reunite once she is in Chang'An. Years later, Yun Ge visits Chang'An, but the boy she met doesn't remember her or the promise. Though saddened that the boy doesn't remember her, she gets tangled in obstacles involving him.

(Source: INKR)

203697.description:
1. Tomodachi Miman (友達未満) [Yuki Morita]
2. Lovely Punch!! (ラブリーパンチ!!) [Michiru Aoi]
3. Obake tte Yobanai de! (おばけってよばないで!) [Pochi Kashiwa]
4. Tomodachi Keikenchi (ともだち経験値) [Eri Kumaki]
5. Pon Poko Pokapoka Friend (ぽんぽこぽかぽかフレンド) [Nanami Poppo]

203698.description:
When the author of a romantic fantasy novel wakes up in her own story, she's mortified to find out that she's just a side character who eventually gets killed off! Determined to escape the outcome she wrote herself into, she decides to adopt a new identity. Now, as Bella, she not only escapes becoming the emperor's concubine who's eventually executed, but she also becomes the nanny of her novel's final villain, Eren Winthrop. Can she set right the terrible ending she created in the first place?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Went Undercover as the Villain’s Nanny
The Nanny Contract of the Black-Hearted Villain

title.english: Going Undercover as the Villain's Nanny

203699.description:
Squirrel ChamCham shyly reveals his true profession: idol fan. Being an idol fan is his destiny and the driving force behind his life. He wants to be a fan 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. He says this is his life! ChamCham's xx-year-long fandom life, from holding a cheering stick during his first birthday to his favorite idols' pockets filled with their merchandise. He confesses everything.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

203702.description:
In 1940, amidst an era of chaos, a beautiful mansion named Yeongchunhwa was built on a remote island, constructed solely out of a man's deep love for his wife. Time passed, and the story of the couple tied to the mansion faded from memory. Yet one day, a mysterious ‘caretaker’ appeared, transforming it into a lodging establishment. He began inviting people to the mansion—those who must love, guided by the couple's spirits...!

“Welcome to Yeongchunhwa, the secret mansion that will bring you infinite imagination. Here, any form of love is possible. Love and indulge freely. As long as the mansion permits.”

A luxurious mansion and the people who visit it for various reasons. Erotic stories for women, crafted by various authors, unfold now.

Fifth Short Story The First Night After Divorce: Once a rising star, actress Oh So-Ra dreamed of a glamorous comeback to the entertainment world through her divorce ceremony! But days later, contrary to expectations, she faced a barrage of public criticism. Fleeing reporters, she sought a secluded place and headed to the Mansion Youngchunhwa. But what do you know? There she runs into her recently divorced ex-husband, Jung Hyun! The shock is short-lived. On their first night at the mansion, Jung Hyun's aggressive advances(?) lead to a fiery night together. The next morning, however, only So-Ra remembers the night. Still bewildered, before she could find answers, "Ru-Ri and “Tae-Oh” arrive at the Youngchunhwa Mansion one after another, sparking a subtle tension between the four.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Forsythia Mansion: First Night After the Divorce

203703.description:
Mikaru, a fashionable fifth-grader with excellent grades, views Rizumi, a girl in her class, as a rival. One day, Mikaru sees Rizumi dancing at a dance school and thinks she looks cool. Out of a sense of rivalry, she decides to attend the dance school herself.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

synonyms: When My Huge-Dicked Self Used a Dating App and Met a Super-Perverted Woman with Whom I Have the Best Compatibility

title.native: チ◯ポのでかい俺がマチアプで相性最高なドスケベ女と出会ったら
title.romaji: Chinpo no Dekai Ore ga MatchApp de Aishou Saikou na Dosukebe Onna to Deattara

203706.description:
Graduate the Academy by Luck is a trash VR game loved by no one—except for him. But that doesn’t mean he wanted to end up inside of it! After transmigrating into the body of a young female character named Oknodie, this protagonist will have to start from the bottom of a hierarchy based on luck. With only his wits and the help of a few new friends, will he be able to raise Oknodie up and win the game, or will he be trapped inside the body of a weakling character forever?!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: I Became the Villain's Daughter at the Academy
title.native: アカデミーの黒幕の娘になった
title.romaji: Academy no Kuromaku no Musume ni Natta

203708.description:
On his way home from work, Eita comes across a super villainess in a dumpster and decides to shelter her instead of turning her in. She’s unused to kindness, but it isn't long before Eita's sincerity melts her evildoing heart.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: Released at Comiket 106.

title.native: 女幹部を匿ったら同棲する事になった話
title.romaji: Onna Kanbu wo Kakumattara Dousei Suru Koto ni Natta Hanashi

203709.description:
Given a three-month death sentence, Ipoh Bell, a maid, impulsively proposes a one-night stand to the Marquis' master, Awin Asta, whom she has been secretly in love with. Though she claims she desires nothing more than one night, her feelings for Awin only grow. Meanwhile, the suspicious archmage Dalton approaches her...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: ムッキムキの黒人デカチンポで出張中の夫にできないアクメSEXしちゃった❤
title.romaji: Mukkimuki no Kokujin Deka Chinpo de Shucchouchuu no Otto ni Dekinai Acme SEX Shichatta ❤

203712.description:
Tsukasa Saeki, my former tutor, is always nagging and I can’t stand him. Today, I, Nanase Momoka, was determined to make him pay for it! My plan was: ‘I’ll let Saeki touch my chest on purpose, then use the secretly filmed sexual harassment video to get him expelled from school!’ Or so I thought…! Learn more about the bonds between the knights of the Order of Beast Hunters. Read about Ivano’s and Fermo’s passion for their work with stories about merchants and artisans. Indulge in the love affairs of Ordine’s nobility. Cozy up with stories about Dahlia’s closest friends, Lucia and Irma. Get a glimpse of the hidden world of Guido, Jonas, and the Scalfarotto family.
