2. Chuugakunen Hen (中学年編)
3. Kougakunen Hen (高学年編)

title.native: 年齢層別フェラチオレビュー

203778.description:
Suspended FBI agent River Winstead is offered reinstatement if she poses as the lover of Alessandro—her first love and the son of her worst enemy. But as the mission deepens, she’s helplessly drawn to him. Yet this feeling ought to be resentment. Never can it be called love.

(Source: Manta)

203779.description:
Bella, a poor, tormented maid bullied by her masters in the duke’s household, was pushed off the rooftop by a veiled figure. When she regains consciousness, she finds herself possessing the body of the duke’s mad daughter who had been sick for years. Bella decides to use this newly acquired identity to uncover her murderer and take revenge! But can she pull it off while avoiding an arranged marriage to the rumored monstrous count of the Stuel kingdom?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 주인으로 모시던 미치광이 귀족 영애의 몸에 빙의하다
An Abused Maid Takes Revenge by Switching Bodies With a Sickly Daughter

title.english: I Was Possessed by the Mad Lady's Body That I Serve!
title.native: 虐げられたメイドは病弱令嬢と入れ替わって復讐します
title.romaji: Shiitagerareta Maid wa Byoujaku Reijou to Irekawatte Fukushuushimasu

203780.description:
President Seo deeply cares for his people and his economy. Unfortunately, bureaucracy and red tape gum up every step he could possibly take to help. With his approval ratings plummeting, President Seo has no choice but to sit back and watch as his people turn him into the scapegoat for all their problems. That is, until he finds himself awaken one morning as Du Hyuk Ma, a notorious gang leader.

(Source: Tapas)

203781.description:
Being stranded on an island with the five hot male leads of an erotic novel? That sounds like many women's dream... Except, when you've reincarnated as the villainess that all said hotties hate with a burning passion, it's closer to a nightmare. And that's without even counting the monsters that roam the island! As a former scout instructor, Margaret can handle the wilderness, but she never learned how to deal with buff men with homicidal tendencies. Let's just hope she can take the heat!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I’m Stuck on a Remote Island With the Male Leads
Trapped on a Deserted Island with the Male Leads

title.english: Trapped on a Remote Island With the Male Leads

203782.description:
Lydia Evanzi’s first life ends in tragedy because of one reason: her awful taste in men! Vowing to stay single in this life, Lydia chooses the chaste path as a priestess, though it’s really just a front for her to get revenge on all those who once wronged her. But to help with that plan comes another man, Arsen Edith, who actually proves to be a far better partner than Lydia hopes for...!

(Tappytoon)
synonyms: The Regressed Villainess Takes a Vow of Chastity
The Villainess Who Returned in Time Vows to Stay Pure
The Regressed Villainess’s Vow of Chastity
回帰した悪女は純潔誓約します

title.english: The Returned Villainess Vows to Stay Single

203783.description:
The story is set in a high school "Idol Club." Mitsuki Tsunoda, an idol otaku high school boy, suddenly becomes a girl—but only physically. Soon after, his favorite former idol, who once disappeared from the spotlight, appears right before him! Aiming for the top with your favorite idol! A gender-bender school idol comedy begins!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: さよなら僕のアイドル

203784.description:
"I told you I would support you any way I can, right?♡"

Tamura Momo, a shoujo manga editor, has been running into a string of misfortunes, both at work and in her personal life. One day, she walks into a bar and is approached by Rio, a cute young man. She gets drunk and starts spilling out all her troubles to him. Rio was just going to take Momo home after she passes out, but then one word from Momo suddenly causes his attitude to totally change...!?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title.native: 小悪魔ワンコの甘やかし方

203785.description:
I've made up my mind. I'm going to quit being an idol. I'm serious this time. After all, if you're going to change jobs, it's better to do it quickly.

Haruka Minamiya is the youngest member of the four-man boy band KNIGHTS. While the other members strongly oppose his leaving the group, he meets a woman who claims to be able to see his aura!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)
synonyms: I Want to Quit Being an Idol.

title.native: オレはアイドルをやめたい

203786.description:
The hearts of the hero's party have grown weary. A world where humans and demons are at war. The heroes have been facing deadly battles while they're being hailed as valiant heroes by the townspeople. The Sage, Sofia, places her hope on Hoshino, a psychological counselor that transported from modern Japan, and believes that she can bring salvation to them. Her psychotherapy slowly but surely changes the hearts of the heroes, and soon it brings tremendous change to their world...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)
synonyms: The Counselor Through the Years and Stars

203787.description:
"Running reveals a person's life."

In his second year of junior high, Shun Uzuki clocked the nation's fastest time and was hailed as a prodigious runner. Expected to dominate the athletics world, he suddenly vanished from the spotlight. Now, upon entering high school, he returns to competition! Yet, his appearance bears no resemblance to his former self— a flashy, blond playboy, a far cry from an athlete...! The world around him is speechless, but what of his true ability—!?

A story of youth club activities aiming for national high school ekiden supremacy through setbacks and rebirth, and a strategy that rejects the "grit theory"!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

203788.description:
"Do friends in a group usually talk about each other behind their backs...?"

Kiyo, like any other socially adept high-school girl, spends every day having fun with her group of friends! But somehow, things don't feel quite right... Do friends in a group usually talk about each other behind their backs...? Maybe not, but if there's one thing that Kiyo knows, it's that she doesn't want to be on her own. And so, she simply goes with the flow, even as her high school life is hit by a storm!

(Source: Comikey)

203791.description:
A high school boy and his best friend-turned-zombie live out their lives in a world one year after the end of a zombie pandemic.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 肉まん泥棒ハオチーちゃん
つかさくんのくり～む煮

203795.description: Note: Originally a one-shot published in Shounen Hana to Yume No. 12. It was picked up for continuing serialization on 2025-12-06.

203797.description:
Si-Hong is a prodigy on track to make a splash in the world of engineering, until mysterious alien creatures named yomis, as adorable as they are bloodthirsty, invade Earth. Three years later, he’s confined to his apartment as the outside world goes to hell, surviving on weekly rations handed out by the government. One day, he is visited by a talking squirrel-like creature who asks him to help end the invasion by killing his mother—the leader of the yomis who is masterminding their takeover of Earth, disguised as the popular human K-pop star Hyo-i…

(Source: WEBTOON)

203798.description:
Shiro Atami, the star of the sales department that everyone admired, had been dealing with an unexplained issue affecting his health. On top of that, a conflict with a coworker left him with psychological damage. Shiro was saved from that dire situation by psychiatrist Akihito Masaki. After Akihito, a Dom Omega, read him in an instant, Shiro was slowly pulled under by a pleasure so intense it overwhelmed his mind…?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: Be a good boy, my dear dog
title.romaji: Be a good boy, my dear dog

203799.description:
Notes:
- All chapters were split into three parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases.
- Includes two extra chapters.

203800.description:
Yu Jitae is a Regressor wielding limitless power—and he still isn't strong enough to prevent the end of the world. Because four bored, young dragons once descended to Earth for fun, Yu has been caught in an endless cycle of failing to stop the apocalypse. But this time, in yet another timeline, Yu decides to try something different: maybe he can nurture the destruction out of these dragons as their guardian!

(Source: Tapas)

203801.description:
An Ying has recently been tormented by nightmares of being kidnapped, which feel too realistic. In order to feel more secure, An Ying chose to hire Cheng Lengyi as his bodyguard. However, during their time together, An Ying discovers that the person he personally chose to be his bodyguard is actually the one pushing him towards the abyss: Cheng Lengyi’s appearance was premeditated, and his seduction of An Ying was orchestrated by a backer behind the scenes…Who is holding such intense hatred towards him?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

203802.description:
Notes:
- All chapters were split into three parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.
- Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 僕はエッチができない!?
俺とお前のマウント戦争
title.romaji: Ore to Omae no Mount Sensou

title.native: 愛してなんて命令じゃ言えない

203806.description:
A story about two people with different personalities and backgrounds trying to close the gap between them.

Note: Released at J.GARDEN 55.

title.native: 君と仲よくなりたいな
上司の家に転がり込みまして。
今夜ベッドで待っていろ バリエーション
大草原の小さな四畳半

203810.description: After 14 years, a young woman returns to the place where she grew up in.

title.native: 劇画 藤原四代 奥州平泉の興亡
title.romaji: Gekiga Fujiwara Shidai: Oushuuhiraizumi no Koubou

203813.description:
Raya Famiira, princess of a small kingdom conquered by the Sultan. In reality, she is a modern doctoral candidate who was writing her thesis on Arabian Nights when she suddenly awakens inside the very tale she was studying. Being reborn as a princess should have been a stroke of luck. Instead, within three days of her possession, she is taken captive as a prisoner of war, thrust into the role of a doomed heroine fated for tragedy.

(Source: Lezhin US)

203814.description:
They might looks beastly, but inside they're all softies. Step inside this furry campus, and find out what these college animals are up to!

(Source: Toomics)

title.native: 眠れるアインシュタイン

203816.description: This chibi-style manga conveys the charm of the TV anime "Gnosia" in a relaxed and peaceful atmosphere, a little different from the serious tone of the main story. Enjoy the world of "Yurutto Gnosia" designed by Pom-sensei!

203817.description:
The unobtrusive VRMMO "Myrla".
Inside it has a mysterious death game.
Once he was the protagonist that failed to attack, the last one has been restored in a magical phenomenon, and you can recover the attack from scratch.
The Last One entered the second row while maintaining predecessor knowledge. Now you can select a production job just like the battle and run the streets of the abbreviated streets such as bug skills and cheat skills.
This popular "Become a Noveler" is finally a book with an overwhelming fun and mysterious VR game element.

title.native: Myrla[ミルラ] ～VRMMOでやりたいほうだい～
title.romaji: Myrla: VRMMO de Yaritai Hou Dai

203818.description: Luna, a saint, was executed by the people she had saved as a fake, ending her life. She was reincarnated 300 years later with immense power, and on her deathbed, she wished to live freely like a "villainous lady." She planned to live quietly and inconspicuously, fulfilling her wish to do so!
synonyms: The Condemned Saintess Goes on the Path of a Villainess!

title.native: 断罪された転生聖女は、悪役令嬢の道を行く！
title.romaji: Danzai Sareta Tensei Seijo wa, Akuyaku Reijou no Michi wo Iku!

title.native: キラボシくんはネコより輝きたい

203820.description:
The spinoff manga centers on the meals of the Namerikawa yakuza group led by Hidenobu Namerikawa, his sworn younger brothers Kajio and Tobita, and their apprentice Chūbō. What do they eat in their peaceful yakuza days, and what do they eat in tense situations?

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 闇金ウシジマくん外伝　滑皮組ヤクザメシ
title.romaji: Yamikin Ushijima-kun Gaiden: Namerikawa-gumi Yakuza Meshi

203821.description:
This side story volume brings you six exciting new shorts not seen in the main series! Stella tries an otome game, a drunk Shizuku tells Alice her hidden fears and worries, and Stella and Shizuku fight to see who’s truly worthy of Ikki’s love! We also learn some of Toutokubara Kanata’s secrets, see a bit of what Stella’s training with Saikyou Nene was like, and even witness the legendary moment that got Ikki accepted into Hagun Academy in the first place!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.native: 落第騎士の英雄譚 零

203822.description:
Late one evening, a large sum of money was transferred into her account.

“Any questions about the transfer? Talk to the bank directly! That's all I'm saying!”

There was no way he could just give it back. It wasn't that he wanted to pocket someone else's money—that's just how the world works these days. Did you think I'd fall for voice phishing? But the moment the shadowy group stormed into her home, Song-Yul realized something was terribly wrong. One man stood out distinctly from the rest. Model-like tall stature and striking features. Even his loosely worn suit seemed charming, such was the intensity of his presence. He delivered his demand to her in a cold voice.

“One hundred million.”
“Yes? Yes?”
“I'll give you 100 million won if you stay locked up like a corpse for a year.”

A year of confinement for 100 million won? It's far more dangerous than expected, and far sweeter.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

203824.description:
The manga centers on Atsushi Kojima, a bullied high school student, who became immersed in the world of martial arts, after he comes across the autobiography of Atsushi Tateshima, a real-life Japanese hero in the kickboxing world. Kojima shows his growth in the sports of kickboxing, guided by one charismatic man.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: ざまぁみろ！―不屈のキックボクサー・立嶋篤史に魅せられて―
title.romaji: Zamaamiro! - Fukutsu no Kickboxer Tateshima Atsushi ni Miseraete

203825.description:
A woman forever burdened by misfortune, In Greenwood. Disaster followed her like a shadow, and unhappiness gave her no moment to catch her breath. Each time, in those life-threatening moments, a benefactor appeared to save her. But before they could exchange even a single word of thanks, he would vanish like mist.

[Why not test whether meeting him was chance or fate?] Then one day, as a train fell from the sky and crushed her—A strange, uncanny man, seemingly not meant to exist in this world, appeared once more and saved her life.

“Would you at least tell me your name now?”

“Adrian. Call me whatever you like.”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: To My Immortal I Can’t Be Honest With

203827.description:
The Mainichi's popular serialization and Japan's cutest 4-panel comic. The lively and slightly sad daily lives of the Daimon family.

(Source: Mainichi Shinbun, translated)

203828.description:
Kang Sung-Tae, commissioned as a cadet officer, is unexpectedly transferred to a unit where his senior officer deserts. Because of this, his superiors begin to harass and suspect him from the very day he transfers. Stigmatized as a decommissioned officer, how will Second Lieutenant Kang Sung-Tae navigate this situation?

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Success Story Of The Omnipotent Soldier
เส้นทางนายทหารอัจฉริยะ

203829.description:
Welcome to the Cake Circus! The circus is leaving for another performance today. Donut wants to get on stage, but what if he messes up? Donut has a long way to go! Will he be able to finish the performance safely?

(Source: Naver, translated)

203830.description:
Don’t judge a book by its cover! Eugene is a powerful mage whose appearance can frighten anyone out of their wits, but all this kind-hearted soul wants to do is teach Ain, the daughter of his master, so she can become the next archmage. Can his curriculum help her navigate through the world of magic and become the second-greatest mage of all time?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: หลักสูตรมหาจอมเวท

203832.description:
"I didn't write it!"

Popular idol Jung Ha-Jin's school violence revelations explode. The world, with detailed information seemingly gleaned from her memories, points to victim Min-Ji as the "author." The mysterious author is stealing my memories and strangling the perpetrator. Is this the perfect revenge for me? Or is this another trap?

(Source: Naver, translated)

203833.description:
Back at school after a year. On her first day back, she thought it would be fun, but a miraculous turn of events landed her in the same class as her younger sibling. Then, a stranger caught her embarrassingly...! And why did that man have to be Seo Jin-Young?! Why am I getting involved with Jin-Young, whom I haven't spoken to all school year, now?

Da-Jung's school life is going haywire... Please, let her graduate safely!

(Source: Naver, translated)

203834.description:
Eun Dan-A, a girl raised on an island, loses the bucket list she'd been keeping in anticipation of her first day of school. It was a mysterious classmate named Cheon Se-Hwa who found the notebook. Dan-A develops feelings for Se-Hwa and approaches him, but Se-Hwa finds her burdensome. The more she spends time with him, the more her face flushes, her chest tightens, and she feels uncomfortable. But somehow, she doesn't hate it.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: I'm Only Shy in Front of You
I am Only Embarrassed in Front of You

203835.description:
Seo-Jin, who travels to a Southeast Asian island, falls in love at first sight with Ariel, an assistant instructor working at a diving hostel. However, suspicious incidents, rumors, and Ariel's mysterious past make him uneasy. His excitement gradually turns to fear, and his longing for her becomes distorted.

(Source: Naver, translated)

203837.description:
“Long time no see, Laila. My maid.”

Laila, the maid who was the daughter of a brothel. Leopold, the king's abandoned bastard son. Their childhood first love for each other was tender, yet simultaneously became an indelible wound for both. Years passed, and they met again under false identities. Love and hatred, obsession and contradiction—these conflicting emotions reignite like sparks. The first love they tried to erase but could never let go now threatens to consume them both...

The dangerous reunion of the noble princess and the war hero. What awaits them at the end? Mutual ruin or destiny?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

203838.description:
The reincarnation of the strongest beings from another world—an ordinary life is already out of the question.

The Heavenly Demon, on the verge of unifying the world. After a final battle with their sworn enemy, the Ice Witch, the two died together. They are reborn as ordinary twin siblings in the human world. But peace is fleeting. Now teenagers, reincarnated organizations are shaking the world. The world will never let the siblings live in peace while hiding their past powers. Former subordinates gather one by one. This time, the Ice Witch stands by their side not as an enemy, but as a partner.

Can the Heavenly Demon truly become the world's strongest once more?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

203839.description:
Woo Jung is figuring out what he wants to do with his life. He joins Twitter and becomes a fan of an account named “Universe.” Joo-In Yoo works as a designer by day, and by night, she uploads fanart under the username Universe. Despite never seeing each other, the two form a friendship and soon decide to meet. Fantasy and real-life clash as Woo realizes Joo-In’s artwork isn’t the only thing he finds attractive, and Joo-In is shocked when she realizes Woo is not a girl...but a very handsome guy.

(Source: Tapas)

203841.description:
Seo-Byeol, a girl from an island village, grew up alongside her childhood friend Min-Jae, who was born with innate talent for painting. Through him, she developed an interest and dream for art. Eventually, the two moved to the capital together and enrolled in an art high school. While preparing for art school entrance exams, Seo-Byeol feels inferior to Min-Jae, and the sibling-like bond between them begins to crack.

It's the summer of their senior year, when they should be focusing intensely. Seo-Byeol faces a crisis: her family's financial troubles force her to give up everything and return to the island...

“Come to my place, Oh Seo-Byeol.”

After much deliberation, Seo-Byeol accepts Min-Jae's offer, and their secret cohabitation begins!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

203842.description:
Bloody Mary, ghost building, wolf shadow, death soul, and the marriage crossing death and life... A steady stream of bizarre cases follow. Behind these absurd rumors, there often hides an incredible truth. In order to pursue the truth, our MC and his partners take risks to investigate and find out the roots hidden in their heart.

(Source: WebComics)

203843.description:
Wang Jiang is a regular teenager who loves playing PUBG, his cute little sister, and anime. He accidentally gets transported to ancient times and is saved by a strange old man named Gong Shang. Follow Wang Jiang as he is thrust in a dangerous world with a divine artifact to save the world!

(Source: INKR)

title.native: 真面目なんかじゃない！
守銭奴聖女は冷徹領主の偽りの婚約者になりました
title.romaji: Shusendo Seijo wa Reitetsu Ryoushu no Itsuwari no Konyakusha ni Narimashita

203847.description:
Mikoto, a third-year high school student, gets into an accident. When she wakes up, she finds herself transported to a parallel world reminiscent of the Edo period! After meeting Shogun Yoshitaka, Mikoto is welcomed into the inner palace. There, she finds four men waiting for her to soothe her "heat"...!? A Japanese-style fantasy x doting erotic reverse harem romance!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: 大奥で慰めて。～将軍と4人の夜伽華たち～
title.romaji: Oooku de Nagusamete.: Shougun to Yonin no Yotogi Hanatachi

203848.description:
At the age of 12, Serena Ashenheide attends the party to select the Crown Prince's fiancée. She recalls that she was once the fiancée of the Crown Prince, known as "the most evil woman of all time," and that she was framed for a crime she did not commit by the Crown Prince and his sister-in-law, and died in prison at the age of 18. "This is bad, I must avoid getting engaged to the Crown Prince at all costs!" she thought, quickly proposing to Glenn Bryant, a beast knight who happened to be there, and successfully avoided her engagement to the Crown Prince. However, Glenn, who initially dismissed her as a child's nonsense, suddenly decided to accept Serena's proposal...!? This is the start of a pure love comedy that begins with the lies of a villainous young lady and a beast knight!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 逆行悪役令嬢はただ今求婚中 近くに居た騎士に求婚しただけのはずが、溺愛ルートに入りました！？
title.romaji: Gyakkou Akuyaku Reijou wa Tadaima Kyuukon-chuu: Chikaku ni Ita Kishi ni Kyuukon Shita Dake no Hazu ga, Dekiai Route ni Hairimashita!?

title.native: 異世界で鍛冶神の力を得た俺、女神とスローライフはじめました。
title.romaji: Isekai de Kaji-shin no Chikara wo Eta Ore, Megami to Slow Life Hajimemashita

title.native: 竜神様に見初められまして～虐げられ令嬢の三食もふもふ溺愛付き生活～
title.romaji: Ryuujin-sama ni Misomeraremashite: Shiitegarare Reijou no Sanshoku Mofumofu Dekiai Tsuki Seikatsu

203851.description:
Kaya grows tired of holding her own feelings back, living life constantly accommodating others. One day, by chance, she becomes friends with her classmate, Ichikawa—a girl who is as straightforward with her feelings as it gets. Things get shaken up when she has Kaya tag along for a round of boxing...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

203853.description:
Izumo Hiyori, who lives in a poor village, is to marry Saku, the head of the Minazuki family, due to a village custom that states that "children with a birthmark representing the sun will marry into the Minazuki family." Although the relationship is semi-forced, Saku welcomes it. For Hiyori, who has yet to experience her first love, the gentle and kind Saku is a husband she can rely on. However, it seems he is not just kind...!?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

203854.description:
Leah is the guardian saint of her kingdom, and has been bullied by her older sister, Priscilla, for as long as she can remember. Despite the constant beratement, she has been using her powers to heal the townspeople, fight with monsters, and protect the kingdom. However, one day, Priscilla made her final move. She convinced the prince to call off the holy engagement, claiming that she herself is the true guardian saint, and forced Leah into exile. Having been sent to the forest of illusion to carry out her exile, it was no different than a death sentence. However, that changed in an instant as she comes across a young prince from the neighboring kingdom who is in serious need of healing!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Saint Exiled to a Forest Finds a Handsome Man With a Past: I'm Enjoying My New Life, so I Don't Want to Go Back Even if Asked!
title.native: 追放された聖女は、捨てられた森で訳アリ美青年を拾う～今の生活が楽しいので、迎えに来られても帰りたくありません！～
title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Seijo wa, Suterareta Mori de Wakeari Biseinen wo Hirou: Ima no Seikatsu ga Tanoshii node, Mukae ni Korarete mo Kaeritaku Arimasen!

synonyms: The Young Lady of Ice Is Sweetly Melted by the Demon Wolf Knight.

title.native: 氷の侯爵令嬢は、魔狼騎士に甘やかに溶かされる
title.romaji: Koori no Koushaku Reijou wa, Marou Kishi ni Amayaka ni Tokasareru

203858.description:
University student Mio can't let go of her lingering feelings for her ex-boyfriend, Atsushi. One day, it's not Atsushi who shows up at Mio's house... but his younger brother, Taishi, who looks exactly like Atsushi. Mio tries to see the resemblance of Atsushi in Taishi, and falls into self-loathing. Taishi kindly accepts her, and then confesses something... I want to take another step into love... A pure and heartbreaking love story between a complicated me and a straightforward you.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

synonyms: My First Love Hasn't Died Yet

title.native: 初恋はまだ死んでない

203861.description: Note: Chapter 6 was split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.
203861.hashtag: #なんか憑いてるオーカミくんっ

title.native: なんか憑いてるオーカミくんっ！

203862.hashtag: #悪役へび男は英雄狼に食べられる

title.native: 悪役へび男は英雄狼に食べられる
title.romaji: Akuyaku Hebi Otoko wa Eiyuu Ookami ni Taberareru

203864.description:
The richest heiress in the world, Touka of the Tsukizakura Conglomerate, dies in a freak accident… and wakes up in another world—Megalanica. Captured by a wicked king and forced into slavery, her fate seems sealed… until she activates her unique Authority: Gravebank, the Bank of the Underworld—with a jaw-dropping balance of ¥70,000,000,000,000,000. Armed with absurd wealth, Touka buys back her freedom—then sets out to free others like her. Now, with gold as her weapon and a growing party at her side, she begins her journey to buy the world itself—and bring down the demon kings who rule it.

(Source: Comisma, translated)

203865.description:
Mutsuki Mizuta has been secretly in love with his childhood friend, Junya Yayoi, for as long as he can remember. He knows his feelings won't be returned, and he'd convinced himself that being by Junya's side as his closest friend was enough, or so he thought.

"Hey, Mutsuki, I need some relationship advice..."

Will he swallow his tears and remain just a friend? Or will he...?

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ブルーハートドロップス

203867.description:
After a brutal battle, magical girl Ruby is torn into two separate bodies. Can Ruby reunite with herself before darkness wins?

(Source: Toomics)

203868.description:
Farrara, the daughter of a duke, has her engagement to the crown prince broken off, leaving her mentally ill and confined. One day, she dreams of her fiancé being taken away by a former friend as Choko, the daughter of a company president.

"Who is Choko?" "Has my engagement been broken off?"

Waking up from a nightmare, Farrara finds herself back at age 12, the day after she was engaged to the crown prince! She doesn't really understand, but she doesn't want to live a life that's the same as her dream. Reflecting on her arrogant past, she resolves to start over, aiming for a brighter, more enjoyable future. This is a happy fantasy about starting over, featuring the struggles of Farrara (from another world) and Choko (from the present).

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 悪夢から目覚めた傲慢令嬢はやり直しを模索中
title.romaji: Akumu kara Mezameta Gouman Reijou wa Yarinaoshi wo Mosaku-chuu

203869.description:
Shizuku is currently training to become a shrine maiden. On her 16th birthday, she breaks the seal, causing her spiritual powers to go out of control, making her body go into heat!? What's more, the condition for inheriting the shrine is to choose one of five potential fiancés and offer her virginity to him! Shizuku begins a naughty life together with the boys who are after her first time...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.

title.native: 発情ルームシェア ～旦那様たちと性欲レッスン～
title.romaji: Hatsujou Room Share: Danna-sama-tachi to Seiyoku Lesson

203870.description:
Taichi is a clumsy boy with psychic abilities. He is surrounded by many mysterious ghosts and monsters, including the playful ghost Grandma Komachi . Today, he is collecting their voiceless voices and delivering them to loved ones...? A heartwarming four-panel comic that will make you laugh, cry, and laugh some more!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

203873.description:
The beautiful (male) girl Shion and the handsome (female) boy Yukari are a couple! It's a romantic comedy about the daily life of this perfectly matched pair, full of unexpected contrasts!

(Source: Gangan Online, translated)

title.native: 女装男子と男装女子はお似合いカップル
title.romaji: Josou Danshi to Dansou Joshi wa Oniai Couple

203874.description:
Mizuhara Aoi, 29, has lived her life doing what's expected of her and causing as little trouble as possible for those around her. Before she knew it, people were calling her a career woman. With her slanted eyes and stern appearance, she thought it was impossible for a man to love her, but she had a boyfriend who was okay with that.

Yes, she "had" a boyfriend, too. "I've found someone I want to protect," he said, dumping me in the company's conference room. That night, not wanting to go home, I stopped off at a bar and was drinking when a handsome, playboy-ish man started clinging to me. As I was talking to him, I started thinking about my ex-boyfriend, so I opened a drink to escape, and the next thing I knew... I was in bed with this playboy, naked. What on earth was going on?! A secret, doting love story with a junior colleague!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title.native: 後輩君だけが知っている

203875.description:
Upon being admitted into a prestigious all-girl high school, Hailan meets Shuya, a fearless student who isn't afraid to challenge unreasonable authority. Contrasting personalities—one soft, the other strong—spark a same-sex romance which defies the norms of their conservative school. The first Girls' Love comic published in Taiwan.

Note: Includes five extra chapters which were drawn 24 years after the original release ended.

203876.description:
All kinds of love is forged in this town!?

Hanako, a divorced woman who runs the rice ball shop "Hanamusubi," is cheerful and caring. As she deepens her relationship with the shop's customers, Mamoru and his sister, Comet, who are much older than her, Mamoru becomes attracted to Hanako, and Comet also experiences her first love. This is a hilarious, human-interest four-panel comic set in "Hanamaru Town," where adult love, sibling love, and all kinds of love grow.

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

203877.description:
When a girl of certain heritage gets thrown into her destiny that involves a folktale that turns out to be true, what will she do?

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: The Tiger, The Sun and The Moon

203878.description:
Beloved SS-rank Esper Hyun-Seo and S-rank Guide Woo-Yun get off to a disastrous start when their first meeting ends in a fistfight. Forced into a pair match, they bicker through every mission—until buried scars and hidden truths surface, blurring the line between guiding and love.

(Source: Manta)

203879.description:
Lu Ye—once hailed across the realms as the Nine-Lives Celestial Venerable. Yet on the very day he ascended… the eight Empresses he had raised, protected, and trusted turned on him. Nine Heavens Sword Maiden: “Because of you, the world sneers at me as nothing but a Sword Slave!” Fairy Hong Ling: “If not for you, I would’ve become his divine companion long ago! You deserve to die!” Vermilion Bird Demon Empress: “You warned me they’d hurt me… but the only one who truly wounded me was you!” But fate rewinds, granting Lu Ye a second life. And this time, he refuses to walk the same doomed path. He won’t sacrifice everything for them again. Let the eight of them fend for themselves.

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)
synonyms: Reborn After the Eight Empresses Betrayed Me, Now I’ll Make Them Regret It

title.native: 八女帝全背叛，重生悔到肠断
title.romaji: Ba Nüdi Quan Beipan, Chongsheng Hui Dao Changduan

203881.description:
1. Motto Meshimase (もっと召しませ)
2. Karakai Ressun (からかいレッスン)
3. Sugao wo Misete (素顔を見せて)
4. Honki Asobi (ホンキアソビ)
5. Jimikano (ジミカノ)
6. Oshigoto Kankei (オシゴト関係)
7. Nikumare-guchi (にくまれぐち)
8. Anata no Hyoujou (あなたの表情)
9. Motto Meshimase Okawari (もっと召しませ おかわり)

203883.description:
Poisoned and tortured by her husband, then betrayed by her own family, Saphielle died realizing that no one had ever truly loved her. But death wasn't the end. Saphielle has now been taken back to the day everything started. This time, she won't be playing a fair game. While pretending to be the same naive girl, she will always be ten steps ahead. While exposing her backstabbing enemies and dodging her past husband Felix's lies, she discovers that the dangerous Grand Duke Leander might be her only salvation—and perhaps something more.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: Although She Is a Failed Princess, She Is Loved by the Grand Duke in This Life

title.native: ハズレ王女ですが、今世は大公殿下に愛されています
title.romaji: Hazura Oujo desu ga, Konse wa Taikou Denka ni Aisareteimasu

203884.description:
Shiloh the orphan thought she found happiness when she was adopted by Duke Defons, even if he only did it because she resembled his late daughter, Claire. But when Claire turns out to be alive and returns eight years later, the Defonses start treating Shiloh coldly and waste no time canceling her adoption. Even worse, they frame her for a murder that she didn't commit! Backed into a corner, the desperate Shiloh accepts the helping hand of her mysterious acquaintance, Caleb, whose intentions aren't entirely pure, either. Can Shiloh clear her name and get revenge on everyone who wronged her?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: The Reason the Abandoned Fake Princess Returned

title.native: 捨てられた偽り公女が帰ってきた理由
title.romaji: Suterareta Itsuwari Koujo ga Kaettkita Ryuu

203885.description:
Eligible bachelor CEO Tsukasa Donose has a business proposal for office worker Miyabi Sayama: he wants to skip the romance, jump straight to marriage, and move in together. There's only one condition: if she catches feelings, the deal is off. But Miyabi's in no danger of that... right?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: 商業婚姻─喜歡上了就離婚

title.english: Business Marriage - If You Fall in Love, We'll Get a Divorce
title.native: ビジネス婚―好きになったら離婚します―
title.romaji: Business Kon: Suki ni Nattara Rikonshimasu

203886.description:
Kutsuzawa Yasuo is a gloomy loner with zero friends. As he walks home alone like always, he has a chance encounter with the class’s top-tier beauty a popular gyaru admired by everyone! After helping her when she nearly falls and fixing her bicycle, he plans to quietly leave... but she looks at him with sparkling eyes instead.

A gloomy introvert and a cheerful extrovert who were never supposed to cross paths yet somehow, they begin to grow closer. Thus begins an awkward but heartwarming youthful romantic comedy between two opposites.
synonyms: When I Repaired a Gal's Bicycle, She Became Attached to Me

title.native: ギャルの自転車を直したら懐かれた
title.romaji: Gal no Jitensha wo Naoshitara Natsukareta

203887.description:
To pay off her parents' debts, Urara is a female college student working at a maid cafe for a high hourly wage. But there is one regular customer who always requests her every Wednesday, a handsome man in a kimono. The customer (her master) is usually quiet and awkward in conversation, but through a series of unexpected events, the two suddenly become close...!? A master who loves his favorite idol and a maid who is a little weak to pressure. This is a love comedy that will make you go "moe moe kyun" (cute, cute, heart-pounding) about these two!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 後宮灼姫伝～妹の身代わりをしていたら、いつの間にか皇帝や将軍に寵愛されています～
title.romaji: Koukyuden: Imouto no Migawari wo Shiteitara, Itsunomanika Koutei ya Shougun ni Chouai Sareteimasu

203889.description:
Extra or protagonist—you can only be one or the other in May Avril’s romance-fantasy world. May is the former, with no power or prestige of her own. But when a transmigrator steals her precious younger sister’s body, May is the only one who can see it. Armed with her wits and her special ability to see the titles of the Ro-Fan stories in her world, will May be able to rise above her meager “extra” status and change her sister’s fate?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Can See the Heroines’ Story Titles

title.english: I Can See the Title Though

203890.description:
Tatsuki is a high school student at rock bottom, whose only family member, his father, a police officer, has disappeared after being accused of corruption. Struggling to make ends meet and shunned by those around him, he gets caught up in a yakuza feud on his way home from work one day. He wakes up to find that he's been swapped with the boss's son, Genryu! And what's more, he's surrounded by dangerous people! Forced to live as the boss's son in an outlaw world, he soon finds himself embroiled in a yakuza family feud in this brutal, violent, action-packed mystery!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 横浜アウトサイダーズ

203892.description:
Feeling out of place in the countryside, high school dropout Nina Iseri moves to Tokyo. After a rough first day and getting locked out of her apartment, she meets her favorite guitarist, Momoka Kawaragi. The two put on a street performance together and decide to start a band with three other girls. While each girl faces her own struggles, their passion for music keeps their dreams alive.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
synonyms: ガールズバンドクライ　～Secret Live～

203893.description:
One day, the son of the bookshop owner, encounters a beautiful girl who carries the air of the city. Though he feels his heart flutter at this new breeze blowing through the island, her tastes are rather... unusual?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: そんなコト、描いていいんですか！？
title.romaji: Sonna Koto, Egaite Iin Desu ka !?

203894.description:
The Kingdom of Brize is a country where beastmen live. Lili, who lives a poor life with her younger brother, is a hybrid (double) born between a beastman and a different species. When the castle becomes short-staffed due to the prince's search for a mate, she is offered a high-paying job as a maid! However, when she meets Phil, the wolf prince, she is chosen by his pure-blood instincts to be the bride of the first prince, who says, "You are my beloved mate!"

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 愛が重めなオオカミ殿下は運命のつがいを軟禁中
title.romaji: Ai ga Omome na Ookami Denka wa Unmei no Tsugai wo Nankin-chuu

203895.description:
The work is a romantic comedy centred on Haruka Sato, an office worker dreaming of dramatic romance, and Takeshi Tatewaki, a science graduate student. On her first day at her new workplace, Haruka encounters Obito wearing an ‘outerwear like a kotatsu quilt’ and decides at first glance he's not her type. Further shocked by Takeshi's tactless words and actions, she blurts out, ‘You don't seem popular at all!’ ending their first meeting disastrously. The next day, when Haruka tries to apologise to Takeshi, she finds herself unexpectedly moved by his actions.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 運命の人、絶対に炬燵の布団みたいなアウター着てない
title.romaji: Unmei no Hito, Zettai ni Kotatsu no Futon Mitai na Outer Kitenai

203896.description:
Ashley thought she and her husband were in love, but he abused her and she died giving birth to a child. Before she could take revenge on him, she opened her eyes and found herself in a pre-marriage phase with him. She felt like she was going to live that hellish life again, so she looked for a replacement husband for her. Ashley went straight to visit Duke Esperad Camedici, who was rumored to have been afflicted by a curse after his fiancée died under mysterious circumstances.

"I'm Ashley, I would like to ask Your Grace to marry me."
"Does what you said mean that you wish to die now?"
"Do you think the misfortune that has befallen me is a joke?"

Ashley knows that he will become emperor, so she tries to win his heart. Moreover, she has finally replaced her husband, and yet he is still arguing with her. Will Ashley be able to take revenge across time and space and succeed in replacing her husband?

(Source: KakaoPage)

203897.description:
Seria was born as an ordinary serf, but her extraordinary beauty makes her an outcast in her village. Growing up without any friends, she meets a young guardian dragon, names him Sizrelia, and forms a deep bond with him. But because guardian dragons are symbols of the imperial family's legitimacy, the emperor must hide the fact that a mere serf can form a pact with a guardian dragon by making Seria an imperial princess! But even with Siz by her side, can she handle life as a fake princess?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Guardian Dragon and the Princess of Lies
มังกรผู้พิทักษ์กับองค์หญิงกำมะลอ

title.english: The Guardian Dragon and the Fake Princess

203898.description:
Karina Paeonia has just broken off an engagement for the fourth time—typical of a side character inside a reverse harem game. All her lovers have left her for Tatiana, the female lead. But when Karina is about to give up on romance, Tatiana's first love, Aster, shows interest in her. As furious Tatiana goes out of her way to get revenge, Karina learns that Tatiana might not be playing the game entirely fairly. Will Karina be able to hold on to Aster? Or will the female lead snatch him from her?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Stole the Heroine's First Love
ヒロインの初恋を奪いました
รักแรกของเธอฉันขอนะ

title.english: I Stole the Female Lead's First Love

title.native: さよなら僕のメイド様

203902.description:
In a bar of a small border town, a doctor is performing CPR on a patient in cardiac arrest when interrupted by a strange foreigner calling himself a Monster Doctor. Meanwhile, along the frontier, a peculiar disease is spreading unnoticed... In a world where humans and monsters have established a coexistence order, the fantastical medical tale of the Monster Doctor—who possesses knowledge of monster physiology begins.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

203903.description:
Who says furry roommates are therapeutic? My Yun Ting Community F4 will crack you up! Watch as the mischievous, hornless sheep-curly hair shows off his death-defying antics, the “aloof” snow leopard ends up as the comic relief, the “useless” office drone Gray Teacher goes mad and awakens, and the gentle White Doctor tries to work miracles! All this and more in this hilarious urban comic about shedding, wrecking homes, and saving the day!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

203905.description:
“City cats have homes but no freedom. Forest wolves have no homes but possess a freedom domestic cats lack.”

Molly, a Ragdoll cat living in the suburbs, yearned for freedom. After setting out on her journey, she made new animal friends...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

203907.description: In a future where eating isn't necessary anymore, a young woman discovers the taste of food for the 1st time...

title.romaji: Kimi to Hikari sasu Shokutaku de

title.native: ノースドレイク少年刑務所

203914.description:
A strange debt repayment began. Ku Tae-Gam, manager of the illegal loan company ‘Takatsu’. The only female employee, accountant Chae Hui-On. Change comes to them—supervisor and subordinate, nothing more, nothing less.

“My grandmother's hospital bills are three months overdue.”

“Look elsewhere. I can't lend you money even if you starve to death today.”

He refused outright, but Tae-Gam couldn't stop thinking about Hui-On's unexpectedly vulnerable side, something he'd never seen before. Then, he rescued Hui-On from danger and they ended up drinking together. While Tae-Gam slept drunk, he was kissed like a thief in the night.

“......You, damn it.”
“Why are you cursing? Was it that bad?”

Only much later did he realize that kiss was a ploy to learn the office safe's password, but Tae-Gam couldn't bring himself to abandon Hui-On, standing on the edge of a cliff.

“Write this down. Don't miss a single word.”

A wretchedly scribbled loan agreement on a scrap of napkin. Twenty thousand won a day. To be repaid in cash, no exceptions.

“I'll chase the bastard who borrowed my money to the ends of hell.”

Each exhausting day only ended after exchanging twenty thousand won. Days piled up where he couldn't tell if he was repaying debt or accumulating it. Those days gradually took root deep within their lives.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

203915.description: Note: Published in the special booklet "Kowai Ribon" included in the July 2025 issue of Ribon magazine.

203916.description:
World War III has ended, but Ji-Min’s troubles are only beginning. A superhuman bloomer, he’s enslaved in a scrapyard, where his life changes after he finds and repairs Aurora, a discarded battle bot. Post-war exploitation of the weak and clashing factions has given rise to the Second Lost Generation. Even if they escape, they’ll still have to grow up in the chaos. But can they outrun the Stalker Bot and the mercenaries hot on their trail?

(Source: WEBTOON)

203917.description:
A young man, struggling to support his ailing mother, continues to write unsold web novels. Then, one day, he enters a mysterious contract and finds himself transported to the world of his own creation, "The Legend of the Overlord." Not as the protagonist, but as a supporting character, Attila! In this harsh alternate world, Attila, alongside his father, Munjuk, the chieftain, overcomes his tribe's crises and distinguishes himself on numerous battlefields. Using the author's knowledge, Attila embarks on a journey to find clues to return to his home world. He leads a band of mercenaries he meets along the way, and they triumph in countless fierce battles. He ultimately faces off against the original protagonist, Charles, and his reputation soars. However, the aftermath of this encounter erodes the narrative of the novel. Will Attila ever return to his home world? And where will his epic tale end? A 100% satisfying alternate world battle fantasy depicting his growth with his companions and his struggle with destiny begins now!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: I Became the Berserker of the World I Created

title.native: 내가 만든 세계 속 광전사가 되었다
title.romaji: Naega Mandeun Segye Sok Gwangjeonsaga Doeeotda

title.native: 最強の皇帝に叛逆したら懲役666年をくらった俺、追放先の精霊界で真の最強となって舞い戻る
title.romaji: Saikyou no Koutei ni Hangyuku Shitara Choueki 666-nen wo Kuratta Ore, Tsuihousaki no Seireikai de Shin no Saikyou to Natte Maimodoru

203919.description:
"I want to see cuter and more messy Katsuragi."

I know it's going to be like this, but I'm dying to make you feel better...!

Mio quit his job and started working freelance as a storage advisor. One day, I happened to meet Shimizu, the former president I longed for...?!? He gently hugs Mio, who suddenly becomes hyperventilated, and calms him down. When Mio was told, "I need you," he decided to go to Shimizu's house as an organizing storage advisor, but it wasn't just about cleaning --!?

title.native: 憧れの野獣社長に溺愛されてます
title.romaji: Akogare no Yajuu Shachou ni Dekiai Saretemasu

203920.description:
Mocha is a male calico cat—an extremely rare combination said to bring good luck. Abandoned on the streets as a kitten, now he’s spoiled by his adoptive humans, who love his typical cat moods and mischief. Whether he’s walking on the book they’re trying to read, climbing the curtains, or just doing a biiig stretch, he’ll put a smile on your face just like he does for his family!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: Mocha the Cat and His Forever Family

203921.description:
In this cruel world, I was just trying to survive with my sisters. But the rich and powerful treated us like worthless ants. Upon my death, I awakened the power of Reincarnation. Now I'll be reborn into my enemy's family, let them spend their money to raise me, and then destroy them from the inside!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: After Reincarnation, My Enemy Made Me Invincible with Money
After Reincarnation, I Was Made Invincible by My Enemies

title.native: 投胎后我被仇人氪成无敌
title.romaji: Toutai Hou Wo Bei Chouren Ke Cheng Wudi

203922.description:
London, the city of magic. In this city shrouded by mist, Elliott and his assistant— "No, wait. Super cute assistant. It's important to Alicia-chan,“—and his super cute assistant Alicia, made a name for themselves as the only ”detective with a wizard's license" in the British Empire. Usually, wizards don't take on detective jobs. It's all to find his missing brother and restore Alicia's life as Angelica.

Three years ago, she was killed by Elliott's older brother. It was a magical murder that erased every trace of her existence from the world. To save her, Elliott broke a taboo, and then… lost his magic. In the blood-stained room, he swore.

“I'll give my soul to the devil if I have to, but I will bring her back.”

(Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)

title.native: トリック・オア・デリート
イタズラな指先で愛して
そろそろ結婚しませんか

203926.description:
Troubled by her parents pestering her about marriage, Izumi meets gentleman Mr. Mano, a cameraman, at the marriage interview she was pretty much forced to attend. Unused to the proximity of handsome men, she'd meant to turn the whole thing down right away, but she's forcefully offered a six month trial betrothal... Before she knew it, they'd already moved in together! Her parents won't pester her anymore... just as she thought she'd found some peaceful time to herself, she's being pushed down on the bed at night!?

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: Sugar Sweet Trial Betrothal -Devoting His All to Me-
title.native: 俺の全部を注いであげる…～旦那さん(仮)と溺甘お試し婚約!
title.romaji: Ore no Zenbu wo Sosoide Ageru: Danna-san (Kari) to Dekiama Otameshi Konyaku!

203929.description:
Kitagawa, an office worker, moves into an extremely cheap property in Tokyo. However, it turns out to be haunted and has a mysterious past! In order to help the ghost Omichi find peace, Kitagawa promises to uncover the truth behind her death and clear her name. However, the only clue he has is Omichi's memory of walking along the Tokaido road in the Edo period. In search of clues to help her find peace, Kitagawa, Omichi, and Yajima, a colleague who loves the Tokaido road, embark on a "Tokaido walking trip" filled with laughter and history!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

203930.description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2019 December issue.

203932.description: Note: Originally published in Icha-Love Shika Nai Yuri Anthology volume 1, but also featured in Comic Yuri-Hime 2019 November issue.

title.native: おきがえたいむ、おきがえchu！

203933.description:
Kengo, a humble chef from downtown, finds himself reincarnated as a "princess" in another world after a dispute with a customer. Stranded with his servant Auguste, he finds himself cooking under extreme circumstances with limited ingredients. In order to enjoy the tricky ingredients from another world and return to the real world, Kengo puts his pride as a chef on the line to create the ultimate "otherworldly limit gourmet"!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 転生王妃の晩餐会 ～アラフォー料理人、やっかい食材で世界を救う～
title.romaji: Tensei Ouhi no Banquet: Arafoo Ryourinin, Yakkai Shokuzai de Sekai wo Sukuu

203934.description:
The manager of an understaffed izakaya restaurant is troubled not by an unfilled shift schedule or young people who quit without permission, but by a talented part-time worker, Shinomiya-kun. This is because Shinomiya-kun keeps asking for the manager's beloved daughter, Saori's, contact information! But Shinomiya-kun's fierce love appeals gradually reach the manager...!? A battle begins between a man who absolutely wants to win her over and a man who absolutely does not want to be called "father-in-law"...!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 慎みなさい篠宮くん！ ～お義父さんとは呼ばせない～
title.romaji: Tsutsushiminasai Shinomiya-kun! Otou-san to wa Yobasenai

203935.description:
How cruel can humans become? Powerless girls exposed to the world's injustice and violence—ready to bare its fangs and attack if you take one wrong step. This digital-exclusive volume by Hazuki Igarashi vividly captures the terror and humiliation of having precious chastity trampled with utter ease.

(Source: ebookjapan, translated)

203936.description:
Jaden never expected to be caught up in the Olsen family's drama, but Philip, his old friend and secret crush, is terminally ill and wants to see his son, the boy Jaden once babysat, one last time. Jaden agrees to help, even though Harry refuses to face his father. Their reunion starts as a clash; Harry feels abandoned by Jaden all those years ago, but his feelings for him soon resurface. And Jaden begins questioning his own heart…

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

203937.description:
After making a major blunder as a police officer, Sasami is demoted to a police station on a remote island. There, he meets a senior police officer who, for some reason, has the appearance of a cat...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

203938.description:
Ga-Ram is a half-breed between a demon and a human, requiring periodic absorption of sexual desire to stay healthy. However, his constitution only allows him to absorb male sexual energy, which he finds utterly repulsive. After enduring it for so long that his health deteriorates, he gets scolded by her older brother. Terrified by his threat to hand him over to a perverted old man if he doesn't consume someone's sexual desire, Ga-Ram promises to try consuming the sexual desire of the classmate sitting next to him at the academy he'll soon attend. But wouldn't you know it, that classmate happens to be Jae-Chan, his childhood friend he's grown distant from...?

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

203940.description:
Cha Geon-Wu spent years nursing a hopeless crush on his classmate Lee Tae-Jun, ever since middle school, all the way into college. Tired of dragging around a first love that never went anywhere, he escaped into military service just to reset his heart. But the moment he’s back on campus, destiny laughs in his face, as a required course throws him right back into Tae-Jun’s orbit. Soon, one run-in turns into another, and somehow Geon-Wu ends up trapped in a new cycle he never saw coming. One where Tae-Jun isn’t just the crush he tried to forget…but the person he’s suddenly sharing a bed with.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: ハイスクール・ソルティ・ハート

203941.description:
After Seok-Hyun's death, Sung-Yun lives a shattered daily life, until Jae-Han, his college classmate, appears before him. Jae-Han, who had secretly loved Sung-Yun during their university days, persistently sticks to Sung-Yun, determined to restore him to his former self. Sung-Yun, unable to discern Jae-Han's intentions, feels uncomfortable. Yet, as Sung-Yun struggles to move on from Seok-Hyun, he gradually begins to accept Jae-Han...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

title.native: 無自覚少女は確かめたい
ボクだけに淫乱な彼女がとまらない
title.romaji: Boku dake ni Inran na Kanojo ga Tomaranai

203944.description:
Forced to live as the perfect Alpha, Alex pushed away the only person who ever truly comforted him. Nine years later, he reunites with Nathan through an assigned case. But when the side effects of Alex's suppressants spiral out of control, the fragile distance between them begins to unravel.

(Source: Manta)

203945.description:
Vince (28) is a universally acknowledged talented artist, yet he is never satisfied with his own work. Obsessed with painting the ‘perfect’ picture to fill that void, Vince one day meets an enigmatic man named Michel (30), who asks him to complete a painting left behind by someone else. The moment he first sees the painting, Vince feels a strange emotion, but ultimately agrees to take it on. Unaware where this decision will lead him.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

203946.description:
Despite being bound by a political marriage, Livenia and Heinrich form a bond and slowly become the family neither of them ever had. That is, until Livenia’s sudden death tears them apart. After being reborn into a new body, she vows to shed the cruel judgment she faced as a young duchess, but seeing Heinrich still trapped in the shadow of her death even 10 years later shakes her resolve. Will she embrace her new life or return to her former groom's side to keep the promise she once made?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: After My Death, My Little Groom
After I Died, My Childhood Husband

title.english: My Little Groom, Even After I'm Gone

203952.description:
"A-ha, such a good adult is clinging to a younger girl's body..." The world-famous student CEO isn't just good at her job, but good in bed, too!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Hot Sex with a Bratty Boss: How About You Blow Off Some Steam with Me?
title.native: マセガキ社長と発情えっち～ウチのカラダでストレス発散していいよ？
title.romaji: Masegaki Shachou to Hatsujou Ecchi: Uchi no Karada de Stress Hassan Shite Ii yo?

3. Sanzun Kinren [Atsuko Fujita - Original Story: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm]

title.romaji: Manga Grimm Douwa: Bijo VS Busu-hen

203955.description:
Manami comes over to Tomo's place for a surprise visit. Tomo has a date planned with his girlfriend, so whatever happens has to happen quickly!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.native: 通いヅママ:また来ちゃった

203956.description:
Tomo introduces his girlfriend, Naoko, to his mom, but the more time he spends with Naoko, the more sure he is that she's not the girl for him. After sending Naoko home, he meets up with his mom to work through his feelings and figure it all out. It's time for Tomo to settle things properly and decide who he really wants to spend the rest of his life with!

Also includes the bonus short comic Mother Knows Best 2.5.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.english: Mother Knows Best 3: Mom vs Girlfriend
title.native: 通いヅママ対押し掛け彼女

203957.description:
Hatori is an average teen boy with no passions in life. One day he meets Furuta, a girl with a keen eye for the extraordinary that's hiding in the streets where they live... Small wonders can change the world in this (extra)ordinary coming of age series!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: Hatori and Furuta's Extraordinarily Ordinary Life
title.native: 羽鳥と古田の非日常茶飯事
title.romaji: Hatori to Furuta no Hinichijou Sahanji

203958.description:
Mysterious black towers have appeared all over the world. Inside them are monsters, danger, and the promise of power and fame. Only a select few are chosen to enter as players. Everyone calls it a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, but 25-year-old Ju-Hyeok Bong calls it a death sentence. He is a timid, anxious self-proclaimed “wimp,” perfectly content with staying under the radar… That is, until he is named as a player. Will he risk everything by entering the tower, or keep running from the one chance that could change his life?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: A Wimp’s Strategy Guide to Conquer the Tower
ไอ้กากผู้พิชิตหอคอย

203959.description:
Wakana is a modest office lady working at a bridal company. She lacks confidence and is shy, but one day she meets a man named Akiyama by chance, and he guides her through life, gradually changing her. She thought she would never see him again, but when Akiyama comes to her company as her boss, she meets him again, and Wakana's heart is drawn to him more and more. But Akiyama is married!? An unforgivable erotic story unfolds in the office.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 愛人・失格〜嘘をもう一つだけ〜
title.romaji: Aijin Shikkaku: Uso wo Mou Hitotsu Dake

203960.description:
Amid the chaos of war, young Rubian realizes a shocking truth: she’s trapped in a novel where the hero dies suddenly, plunging the world into disaster. Luckily, fate leads Rubian to enter the hero's household—giving her the perfect chance to stick close, prevent his death, and leave once the crisis passes. Yet the warmth and affection she receives from his family are unlike anything she's ever known, making it harder to remember that she’s there to stop a tragedy… not start a slice-of-life!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Youngest Hides a Lot of Things

title.english: The Youngest Has Much To Hide

203961.description:
In a world where implanted neural chips allow investigators to interrogate suspects through their own memories, detectives Kim Jin-Yeong and Seo Ji-Su prefer the old-fashioned method of chasing criminals on foot. Officially, they are colleagues-turned-lovers who divorced years ago; but off the record, they continue to seek each other out after work, haunted by a tangled relationship that neither has fully let go of. Then, one chilling Christmas night, Jin-Yeong disappears without a word. Exactly one year later on Christmas Eve, he returns and stands before Ji-Su as if nothing had happened. Where has he been, and what truth hides behind the silence of that missing year...?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: ゴースト・イン・ザ・タウン

203962.description:
Minseok is a hard-working marketing assistant at LS Cinema who knows how to navigate office life - except when it comes to his gorgeous boss, Jeong Suhee. She constantly gives him a hard time, but Minseok can’t help falling for her hidden warmth and stunning looks. Little does he know, Suhee secretly has a soft spot for her handsome, charming subordinate. When a business trip sends them away together, the professional boundaries dissolve, and a risky, forbidden office romance begins.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 触っただけでイく女 職場のババア先輩
title.romaji: Sawatta Dake de Iku Onna Shokuba no Baba Senpai

203964.description:
Betrayed and faced with death by the one he trusted, the Demon Emperor meets his end. Having always longed for death, he welcomes his final moments with a sense of peace. However, 66 years later, he awakens in an unfamiliar body. To his surprise, this body is referred to as a 'hero'? The Demon Emperor never meant to exist for the sake of peace! Eventually, he embarks on a journey once again, not to seek happiness, but to embrace death...

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: The Demon Emperor Desires a Hero

203965.description:
Bring back the cruelty of the corrupt, power-hungry nobles! A classic dark fantasy begins! In a world where it's common for nobles to oppress captives, Rain is a genius magician who was born a captive and earned the title of "Great Sage." However, his magic, the status and honor he gained, only made him an eyesore and a target for elimination to the nobles. After being trapped and brutally killed, Rain uses his own magic to duplicate his own soul. Reincarnated as the heir to his sworn enemy, he vows revenge on the nobles who killed him! Now it's time for the purge.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 復讐の転生貴族～全てを奪われた大賢者、己を【複製】して二度目の生を得る～
title.romaji: Fukushuu no Tensei Kizoku: Subete wo Ubawareta Dai Kenja, Onore wo [Fukusei] Shite Nidome no Sei wo Eru

203966.description:
Rose, the second princess of the Kingdom of Gridoll, has spent her life shunned by her family. One day, she has a vivid dream of boarding the luxurious cruise ship Princess Lea, only to be offered to Crown Prince Raphael of the Great Martin Empire as a substitute for her missing older sister, Lea, and condemned to a future as the "Neglected Consort." Just days later, Rose is ordered by her father to board the very same ship from her dream. Terrified, as each event begins to unfold exactly as she foresaw, Rose desperately tries to change her tragic fate. But her actions cause the future she saw to change, and Raphael appears to take an unexpected interest in her...!?

A sweet, slow-burn romance filled with doting affection, where one prophetic dream changes everything, begins!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

title.english: I'm Supposed to Become a Neglected Consort in the Future, but Something Strange is Happening…
title.native: 未来で冷遇妃になるはずなのに、なんだか様子がおかしいのですが…
title.romaji: Mirai de Reiguu-hi ni Naru Hazunanoni, Nandaka Yousu ga Okashii no Desu ga...

title.native: 触手プレイxディセミネーション

203969.description:
Hui-Wol, a poor high school student. Her beauty makes her the target of daily flirtations, but her only interest lies in studying! Mock exams! One day, a transfer student suddenly shows up and asks her to marry him?!

(Source: Comica, translated)

title.romaji: Osake no Sei ni wa Shimasen kara: Yuri × Inshu Anthology

203971.description:
Jae-Dong, who changes girlfriends every month. Min-Han, who can't even make eye contact with his girlfriend. They may seem different, but they're both at the same age, with some accustomed to being around others and others just learning something new.

This is the story of these two boys gradually coming to understand love.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

203972.description:
Tali, a girl on leave from school who works part-time all day, and a mysterious neighborhood unemployed man who walks around like a freeloader, doing nothing. Their individual circumstances and encounters.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

203973.description:
After her sister’s suicide, Bi-Do blames Mr. Shin, the man named in her suicide note. She approaches him at the funeral expecting a cruel monster, but instead finds he feels unexpectedly like her savior. He takes her from her suffocating small town to Seoul, the place she once dreamed of living with her sister. The more time she spends with him, the more conflicted she feels about the man she thought she was supposed to hate.

(Source: WEBTOON)

203974.description:
Condescending from a princess to a Cinderella and falling down from the cloud all of a sudden, Tong Xin Wan had no choice but to ask her fiance for help. Unfortunately, she was not only refused, but also failed to meet the so-called fiance... Anyway, she indescribably came across her fiance’s uncle, and there should be a taboo love between them. What’s going on?! Tong Xin Wan: "I really need to slow down..."

(Source: WebComics)

203975.description:
His mother entrusted him with obtaining the Martial God's Hammer, but young Xi Zitang wasted ten years trying to lift it and gained superhuman strength instead. Ten years later, he returned with the hammer, forging a path of supremacy while gaining the favor of many beauties!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Pull Out the Hammer Zi Xitang

title.native: ゲームをしていると思ったらいつの間にか異世界にいた
title.romaji: Game wo Shiteiru to Omottara Itsunomanika Isekai ni Ita

203977.description:
The legendary con artist in the pleasure city of Ardel, Sue Rolanne, is hired by an aloof duke to pull off the ultimate grift: deceive the king. To infiltrate high society, the pair stage a sham marriage and what began as a “contract couple” turns into a high-stakes, kingdom-wide con.

(Source: WEBTOON)

203978.description:
Violetta, the daughter of a duke, witnesses her fiancé, Ivan, and her best friend, Thérèse, having sex. The night he breaks off their engagement in broad daylight... "I can't take this anymore!!!!" In despair, Violetta drinks to drown her sorrows, but a man appears before her... zzzz. She wakes up to find a naked, handsome man standing next to her!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: やけ酒をしたら女嫌いの公爵に溺愛されました
title.romaji: Yakezake wo Shitara Onnagirai no Koushaku ni Dekiai Saremashita

203979.description:
The protagonist, Kagari, is determined to find a girlfriend, but when he enters a high school, there is only one girl there...

Disappointed, Kagari enters his classroom only to find that everyone there is cute except for him...!?

A boy-meets-boy coming-of-age drama begins!!

6-8. King Cobra (킹 코브라) [Cuke Soap]

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

203982.description: Note: Originally self-published, was then compiled by Ichijinsha for commercial release.

203983.description:
Top star Kang Beom thinks he has it all until an unknown drink in his idol dressing room knocks him out completely. When he regains consciousness, he finds himself helpless and at the mercy of Song Ui-geon, an enigmatic and sinister figure. Ui-geon uses the horrifying encounter as leverage, forcing the prickly idol into an absolute submission pact filled with increasingly outrageous orders. Caught in a web of coercion, Beom tries to hold onto his pride and career while trapped under Ui-geon's complete control. Now, the top idol must decide how far he will go to survive his captor's twisted demands.

(Source: Lezhin US)

203984.description:
The deposed Crown Prince Leopold, who fell victim to his half-brother's schemes in the succession struggle. He is subjected to the humiliation of being developed into a “male bride” and sold at auction in a lewd state... Paris, the Western Merchant Guild Leader, Dmitri, the Eastern Mage Tower Lord, and Ian, the Northern Grand Duke...

Amidst these three men approaching Leopold with differing intentions, who will ultimately become the master of the “male bride”?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.
synonyms: [Rubidan Bonneunggaebal Team] Eojeui Hwangtaejaneun Oneurui Sukeotsinbu

203985.description:
Thierry, the young master who seems kind and foolish, yet is loaded with money. Blanche tried to swindle him by pretending to be his lover, but he ends up feeling true love from the affectionate Thierry. His fleeting desire to live an ordinary life by his side once this was overwas short-lived.

"Congratulations, Blanche. You've become my beloved toy."

He ends up imprisoned as a toy by Thierry and his identical twin brother, Ardo...

The real con artists and madmen were the two young masters.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

203986.description:
Cha Hyun, a spy infiltrating the Blue Dragon faction for the Red Dragon faction, it's been two years already. An unusually swift promotion to officer made things seem to be going smoothly, but... A Blue Dragon faction tattoo scrubbed off by a scrub brush...? Fucked. With the erased Blue Dragon faction tattoo sticker, Cha-hyun is instantly cornered and dragged to the interrogation room...

“I thought you had no experience with men, but you're quite talented, aren't you?”

So this interrogation... was sexual torture..?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

title.native: ヒノマルライズ～伊藤博文立志伝～

203988.description:
Starting as friends and teasing each other for seven years, Tae-Rang and Jun-Hui clearly like each other now, yet their relationship hasn't progressed. Frustrated by Jun-Hui's passive attitude, Tae-Rang boldly tries to kiss him only to suddenly get a nosebleed.

'Why now of all times!'

He curses his tendency to get nosebleeds, but Jun-Hui's reaction is strange...?

Looking down, he sees Jun-Hui's excited, somewhat embarrassed expression and a vigorously erect member greeting him. His momentary embarrassment quickly turns to gratitude that Jun-Hui has a nosebleed fetish. With each trickle of blood, he resolves to seduce Jun-Hui...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

203989.description:
Ice, space, power, and wind. A continent guarded by witches who inherited the four Great Magic Stones. When the 7th generation who inherited "Wind" dies, summons are issued to select a successor,and the candidates gather at Winfred Academy. The disaster "Erosion" spreads. And Anzu, a boy who conceals the power of his cursed blood. Who did the wind choose? The story of Anzu, a boy who lives his life guided by the wind.

(Source: Naver, translated)

203990.description:
Charles, the marquis’ son, lost his mother and coldly treated his father’s new wife and his younger stepbrothers, Jade and Lien. This leads to his tragic and untimely death in a chain of misfortune. However, when he awakens after his supposed death, he finds himself back in the past, before meeting his stepbrothers. Determined not to follow the same miserable path, he decides to cherish them this time. As a result, his stepbrothers become deeply devoted to him—!?

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)
synonyms: As the Hated One, I Flatter My Stepbrothers in a World Where I Get a Second Chance

title.native: 嫌われ者の俺はやり直しの世界で義弟達にごまをする
title.romaji: Kirawaremono no Ore wa Yarinaoshi no Sekai de Giteitachi ni Goma wo Suru

203991.description:
Gungnir, the most feared killer in the criminal underworld, decides to retire from his profession to keep a promise he made to the love of his life. But on the night of his final job, his partner betrays him, and he and his lover are shot. He survives by an apparent miracle, only to wake up in the body of a high school student. Determined to uncover the truth behind the betrayal, he vows that in this second life he will seize the happiness he was denied.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: มหาเทพมือสังหาร

203992.description:
Baal and Levi belong to a warrior race known as the horned people. The boss of an assassination familia took them in and raised them from a young age, expecting them to become loyal protégés. Instead, he now spends every waking moment trying to survive their chaotic idea of “family bonding.” They’d gladly kill for him—and with their terrifying destructive power and loose morals, they just might kill him by accident! Baal and Levi love their boss, but the boss just wants them gone! Love collides with deadly bloodlust in this makeshift-family battle comedy made up of literal monsters and heartless killers!

(Source: Manga UP!)

Note: Originally published as a one-shot in Gekkan Shounen Gangan December 2024 issue, was then picked up for serialization.
synonyms: キラーズ ファミリア

メイ・アイ・ヘルプユー？
